### About the event

Octaloop's India Blockchain & AI Tour 2026 is the fifth edition of a national event series connecting developers, founders, investors and enterprise teams working on Web3 and AI. The tour lists ten cities, including the Metamorphosis flagship in Hyderabad and stops in Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Goa, Delhi, Jaipur, Lucknow and Chandigarh. Each city has its own

## Edge City India 2026

- Record: `curated-edge-city-india-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-11
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://www.edgecity.live/india26>

### About the event

Edge City India is a three-week popup village in Mandrem, North Goa, from October 11 to November 1, 2026. Founders, researchers, engineers and creators live and work around The Circle's beach-facing coworking hub. The program includes coworking, talks, workshops, salons and demo days.

The first week, October 11 to 17, focuses on new urbanism, energy, food systems and education. October 18 to 24 covers longevity and consciousness. The final week, October 25 to November 1, focuses on deep tech, AI, decentralized technologies, governance, policy and hackathons.

The announced Web3-related programs include Cross Margin Labs' Aqua0 DeFi residency, Hacker House Goa with 2:47PM Studio from October 28 to 31, and an October 30 Project Odin workshop with the Ethereum Foundation Funding Coordination team on sustainable funding for open-source software and digital infrastructure. Light DAO and SingularityNET also host a residency. These programs sit within the wider village rather than replacing its full date range.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Accepted applicants receive a ticket-purchase link, and payment confirms their place. Tickets include village programming, coworking and community activities, but not accommodation or most meals. Joining a residency is optional. Tickets are non-refundable; the organizer allows date changes or transfers to another attendee. Daily clock times are not confirmed for the village as a whole.

## Field Station Rajasthan 2026

- Record: `curated-field-station-rajasthan-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-23
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://logos.co/field-station>

### About the event

Logos and Zu-Grama run Field Station at Dhun, a 500-acre regenerative site in Rajasthan, from October 23 to 31, 2026. The residency brings scientists, engineers, cryptographers, developers and community organizers together to build prototypes. The organizer's page specifies the October dates; the Devcon 8 calendar supplies the 2026 year. No daily start or finish time has been confirmed.

The program selects 30 residents. Scholarships cover eight nights of accommodation, food and drinks, on-site activities and the closing summit on October 30. Applicants can request domestic travel assistance. Rooms are shared, with five to seven people in single-sex rooms. The published application window was September 11 to 26.

Participants choose among the Logos Civic Prize, Logos Sovereignty and Privacy, Zu-Grama d/acc, and a non-builder track for activists, community organizers and artists. Technical work includes privacy-preserving blockchain, decentralized governance, censorship-resistant storage and secure payments. Creatives, designers and testers can also apply.

The schedule includes stand-ups, mentoring, dedicated build time, workshops and demos. Residents present prototypes at the closing summit. The strongest Logos-track prototypes are eligible for milestone-based grant funding. Applicants are asked to install Logos Basecamp, add its blockchain module and note the block height; an existing demo or prototype is helpful but not required.

## India Blockchain & AI Tour 2026 - Mumbai

- Record: `premier-ibt-mumbai-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-31T12:00:00+05:30

### About the event

Octaloop hosts the Mumbai edition of the India Blockchain & AI Tour 2026 on Friday, October 31, from 10:00 to 17:00 IST. The day-long conference explores the intersection of decentralized technology, machine learning, and digital public infrastructure in India

### What to expect

The summit features keynote presentations, panel sessions, and technical product showcases:

High-level panels examining the convergence of decentralized computing, decentralized physical infrastructure (DePIN), and sovereign AI.

- Architecture sessions covering AI agent coordination on EVM chains, zero-knowledge inference, and cryptographic verification for autonomous models.
- Institutional discussions on regulatory policy, digital asset compliance, and Web3 enterprise integration in Bharat.
- Networking breaks, sponsor exhibitions, and executive roundtables connecting founders with venture capital funds

### Who should attend

The event is designed for software engineers, blockchain architects, AI researchers, Web3 founders, enterprise technology executives, and angel investors active in the Indian tech ecosystem

Venue and schedule

The conference takes place at a premier hospitality auditorium in Mumbai on Friday, October 31, 2026, running from 10:00 to 17:00 IST

Registration and admission

Tickets and registration passes are available through the official India Blockchain Tour portal. Early registration is recommended to guarantee admission and access to conference recordings.

ShanHaiWoo hosts the Mumbai Devcon Extension from Sunday, November 1, through Friday, November 6, 2026. The week-long residency and community pop-up connects international builders, cypherpunks, and digital nomad researchers visiting India for Devcon

### What to expect

The extension serves as an open collaboration space and cultural bridge:

Pop-up technical salons discussing crypto-native culture, network states, public goods funding, and open-source cryptographic libraries.

## India Blockchain Week 2026

- Record: `premier-indiabw-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-01
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://www.indiablockchainweek.com/>

### About the event

Hashed Emergent hosts the fourth India Blockchain Week Conference at Fairmont Mumbai on November 1 and 2, 2026. The official week schedule lists 10:00 to 19:00 IST on both days. The conference brings together blockchain developers, founders, protocol teams, investors and institutional and policy participants. Independently organized side events run elsewhere in Mumbai during the week.

### Announced speakers

The organizer's 2026 speaker lineup includes:

Eli Ben-Sasson, co-founder and CEO of StarkWare.

Keone Hon, GM and co-founder of the Monad Foundation.

SB Seker, head of APAC at Binance.

Aishwary Gupta, global head of payments and RWA at Polygon Labs.

Ashish Singhal, co-founder of CoinSwitch.

Sumit Gupta, co-founder of CoinDCX.

Marcin Kazmierczak, co-founder and COO of RedStone Oracles.

Doug Hsu, investor at CMT Digital.

Abdulfatai Suleiman, co-founder and CEO of Blockradar.

Prabal Banerjee, co-founder of Avail.

Tobias Bauer, general partner and co-founder of TBV (TB Ventures).

Chibuotu Amadi, CEO and co-founder of Paycrest.

Harshit Tiwari, VP of growth at the NEAR Foundation.

Ronak Jethava, UAE head at Startale Group.

- Dr. Dipesh Shah, executive director of IFSCA.

The organizer is still finalizing the session agenda.

### Passes and admission

Priority + Tangem adds a three-card Tangem hardware wallet pack, with the two-day lunch buffet and eligibility to apply for the Institutional Forum.

VIP includes Priority benefits and access to the Grand Terminus VIP Lounge. VIP Night access remains subject to confirmation.

Executive VIP adds one night at Fairmont and dedicated airport transfers to the VIP benefits.

- General includes both conference days, tea, coffee and snacks. Lunch is excluded.
- Priority adds the Fairmont lunch buffet on both days and eligibility to apply for the Institutional Forum.
- Student includes General benefits, priority workshop access and hackathon eligibility.

The prices displayed on October 15 are ₹1,749 for General, ₹3,999 for Priority, ₹3,749 for Priority + Tangem, ₹29,999 for VIP, ₹59,999 for Executive VIP and ₹999 for Student, before applicable taxes. The site also flags an October 15 price increase; the organizer's checkout supplies the price payable when booking.

Every IBW2026 pass, including one already purchased, qualifies its holder to purchase a separate Devcon ticket for US$99 through October 25, 2026. The organizer sends the redemption code by email. Devcon admission requires that additional purchase.

Institutional Forum seats require a separate application and selection. Its application page asks Priority, VIP and Executive VIP holders to secure their conference pass before applying; the programming team reviews applications and emails its decision.

## Ethereum Cypherpunk Congress #3

- Record: `premier-cypherpunk`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-02T04:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/spsnos9t>
- Original page: <https://congress.web3privacy.info/>

### About the event

Web3Privacy Now hosts Ethereum Cypherpunk Congress #3 at Yashwantrao Chavan Centre in Nariman Point, Mumbai, on November 2, 2026, from 10:00 to 19:00 IST. Registration is free through Luma.

The event brings together digital-rights advocates, free and open-source software contributors, cryptographers, developers, researchers, artists and legal practitioners. Its 2026 theme, The Ancestral Fork, examines inherited technological and social assumptions about privacy and digital autonomy, with participation from the Global South

Topics and participation formats

The 2026 program themes cover open-source AI and shared AI resources; responses to internet censorship using tools such as mesh networks and cross-border digital currencies; community-led interactive experiences; and privacy and data-protection questions around Aadhaar, UPI and DigiLocker. Other themes address accessible privacy for inexpensive phones and nontechnical users, and sustainable funding for privacy technology and free software.

The speaker announcement also identifies confidential computation, encrypted mempools, secure messaging, privacy-preserving identity, self-hosted nodes, stealth-address wallets, Kohaku wallet privacy and alternatives to centralized collaboration software as areas of work represented at the event. These are subject areas, not a timed session schedule.

The registration page describes a track where privacy-hackathon developers discuss their experience and an activation track proposing demonstrations of Fileverse, Rotki, Fluidkey, Radicle and GnosisVPN

## Alchemy Meetings at Devcon Mumbai

- Record: `curated-alchemy-devcon-meetings-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-03
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://www.alchemy.com/events/devcon-2026>

### About the event

Alchemy hosts dedicated partner and developer meetings during Devcon week in Mumbai from Tuesday, November 3, through Friday, November 6, 2026. The sessions offer one-on-one technical architecture consultations with Alchemy's core engineering and product leadership

### What to expect

These private meetings provide direct access to Alchemy specialists:

- Architecture review and node infrastructure optimization for high-throughput decentralized applications and decentralized finance protocols.
- Technical guidance on implementing Smart Account modular infrastructure, account abstraction (ERC-4337), and session keys.
- Strategic consultations regarding custom Rollup infrastructure, Subgraphs, webhooks, and developer tooling integrations.
- Direct feedback channels with Alchemy product managers to influence roadmap priorities and enterprise support tiers

### Who should attend

Meetings are open to CTOs, engineering leads, protocol architects, and senior developers currently building or scaling Web3 projects who need tailored infrastructure advisory

Venue and schedule

Meetings take place across multiple hospitality suites near the Jio World Convention Centre in Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), Mumbai, from November 3 to 6

Registration and admission

Builders must submit a meeting request form specifying their project details, technical stack, and specific discussion topics. Alchemy's team coordinates confirmed calendar slots and private suite access.

### About the event

The Ethereum Foundation hosts Devcon 8 at Jio World Centre in Mumbai's Bandra Kurla Complex from November 3 to 6, 2026. The four-day conference is for developers, researchers, open-source contributors, designers, artists and community organizers working on Ethereum and decentralized systems. Curious beginners are welcome as well as experienced contributors

The 2026 program

Devcon has nine tracks:

Core Protocol covers Ethereum research, its roadmap, consensus and staking, including the protocol's longer-term development.

Privacy & Consent examines digital identity, self-sovereign identity and consent, alongside the effects of these systems on the communities using them.

Security focuses on threat modeling, formal verification and operational security.

Futures Worth Building considers coordination, public goods and open source, and how builders, communities and artists can influence technological choices.

Users, Builders & Agents addresses wallets, account abstraction and user experience, with attention to security and privacy for people and agents using Ethereum.

Rights, Freedoms & Governance uses case studies to examine human rights, DAOs and digital self-governance, including where these tools have failed.

Applied Cryptography looks at practical uses of zero-knowledge proofs, multiparty computation and fully homomorphic encryption.

Permissionless Networks covers peer-to-peer infrastructure, censorship resistance and connectivity under hostile network conditions.

Open & Verifiable Stack examines open hardware, firmware and software, and how to verify the systems beneath an application.

Published session formats include five-minute lightning talks with two minutes for questions, 20-minute talks with five minutes for questions, 25-minute AMAs, fireside chats or roundtables, and hour-long hands-on workshops. Community hubs provide topic-focused educational spaces alongside coworking, art, music and interactive experiences. Announced speakers include Vitalik Buterin, Audrey Tang, Justin Drake, Roger Dingledine, Sandeep Nailwal, Hart Montgomery, Zachary Williamson and Fatemeh Fannizadeh. These tracks and formats describe the program; they are not a day-by-day session timetable

Tickets and attendance

General-admission tickets are sold in limited-quantity waves with purchase windows. The homepage currently lists US$499 when paying in ETH and US$999 in fiat, including 18% GST. Standard inclusions are four-day access, catering, hot drinks and event merchandise, with exceptions for some ticket types. Current availability and inclusions should be checked in the official ticket shop.

Community discounts require eligibility verification and a self-claimed discount code. They cover qualifying Indian residents and Ethereum or open-source contributors and participants. Review-based applications include student and Sanctuary Tech Builder tickets; approved applicants receive a voucher to purchase a ticket. The student route requires enrollment in an accredited degree program and relevant academic or community involvement. Short courses, bootcamps and online-only programs do not qualify. The FAQ lists October 23 as the final student application deadline, with responses by October 30.

General-admission tickets are transferable, can be purchased for someone else and allow entry with a QR code. Orders are limited to two tickets. Discounted tickets are non-transferable, must be claimed by the attendee and require ID at registration. Attendees under 16 must come with a parent or guardian who also holds a Devcon ticket.

The venue is accessible to attendees with disabilities. Sessions will be recorded and streamed on the organizer's YouTube channel. Devcon overlaps with Diwali travel, and the official travel guide includes accommodation and transport information.

### About the event

WebZero Events and Zcash host Free Society Hackathon at True Tramm Trunk BKC in Mumbai on 4 and 5 November 2026, during Devcon. The organizers are selecting 75 in-person builders to develop working products using Zcash, with an Agentic Commerce track from Bitrefill

Who can take part

Engineers, developers, product people, marketers and founders can apply, including people without a technical background or prior Zcash experience. The program starts with a tooling walkthrough, and mentors from Zcash projects provide workshops and one-to-one guidance throughout the build day.

Teams can have one to four people. Bring a team or find teammates at the venue. A project can enter both tracks if it meets each track's requirements

Tracks and prizes

The organizers advertise USD 5,000 in cash prizes. The published breakdown includes USD 4,800 in competition awards and USD 200 in conditional follow-up bonuses:

The Zcash Privacy track awards USD 1,300 to the top project, two second prizes of USD 300 each and two third prizes of USD 200 each, totaling USD 2,300 across five projects.

The Bitrefill Agentic Commerce track requires projects to use Bitrefill. It offers USD 1,000 for the most innovative project, USD 800 for second place, USD 600 for third and USD 100 for the best feedback, totaling USD 2,500.

Both USD 300 Privacy track winners are also named Zcash Ecosystem Prize winners. Each can earn a further USD 100 by agreeing on a milestone relevant to their submission and delivering it publicly. Those two milestone-dependent bonuses account for the remaining USD 200 in the advertised total

### Schedule

All times are IST (Asia/Kolkata). Luma lists the event from 11:00 on Wednesday 4 November to 15:00 on Thursday 5 November 2026.

### Wednesday 4 November is the hack day

- : welcome and tooling walkthrough.
- : building begins, with workshops and mentors.
- Midnight at the end of hack day, listed as 00:00: submissions close.

Judges score every project overnight and select the teams that will demo on stage.

### Thursday 5 November is demo day

- : top teams announced.
- : demos and winners announced on stage

Food and facilities

Breakfast, lunch and dinner on hack day, plus an afterparty, are included. The venue provides hacking areas, fast internet and group seating. The organizers also advertise merchandise and describe the location as a short tuk-tuk ride from the main Devcon venue

After the hackathon

Winning teams will be paired with an ecosystem partner to agree, deliver and publicly share one small milestone within 30 days, with mentorship and support. The organizers say the same milestone-based follow-up is open to builders who do not win

Registration and venue

The Hacker Pass is free, but registration requires host approval. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis for the 75 selected places. Participants must be in Mumbai in person on Wednesday 4 November; remote participation is not available.

The public venue is True Tramm Trunk BKC, G2-B, Ground Floor, Trade Centre Bkc, opposite MTNL, G Block, MMRDA Area, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400098, India.

## ETHGlobal Mumbai 2026

- Record: `premier-ethmumbai-2026`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-05
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://ethglobal.com/events/mumbai>

### About the event

ETHGlobal Mumbai is an in-person hackathon from November 5 to 7, 2026, at Jio World Convention Centre, G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra East, Mumbai.

The program combines project building with technical mentorship, workshops and feedback sessions

Participation and project tracks

Applications are assessed individually.

Hackers may work solo or in teams of up to five, but every member must be accepted and confirm their own place.

The organizer's public registration data lists November 3 at 23:59 IST as the application deadline.

Accepted hackers confirm attendance with an ETH commitment stake.

For an in-person event, its return requires official check-in, physical attendance and a project submission before the deadline; incomplete projects can still qualify for the stake return.

ETHGlobal says returns normally take up to four weeks after the event.

Applicants unable to stake because of financial constraints can contact the organizer about alternatives.

There are three ways to build:

Classic / From Scratch: Project-specific code, designs and assets must begin during the hackathon.

Public libraries and starter kits are allowed.

Extend Open Source: Teams add substantive new work to an existing open-source codebase and identify what predates the event.

- Ship a Feature: Teams add new functionality to an existing product, including a private or commercial product.

New parts submitted through the continuity tracks must remain open source, and partner-prize eligibility depends on the relevant track rules.

Teams must disclose pre-existing work in writing to ETHGlobal, document it in their submission and maintain a meaningful version-control history.

AI tools are allowed with attribution: submissions should identify AI-assisted code or assets, retain meaningful human contributions and include the specifications, prompts and planning files used in spec-driven workflows.

Event Discord channels support announcements, team formation and mentorship.

During the hackathon, mentors help with technical problems and project feedback.

Participants under 18 need a separately submitted parent or guardian agreement.

In-person attendees must check in and wear their event wristband throughout the event

Submission and judging

Projects are due through the Hacker Dashboard by November 7, 2026, at 09:00 IST; late submissions are not accepted.

The submission includes a title, description and repository or equivalent project files, with new work distinguished from reused material.

An optional demo video must be two to four minutes long and at least 720p.

The organizer's video rules prohibit sped-up recordings, mobile-phone recordings, AI voiceovers and music-and-text-only explanations.

Teams can choose finalist judging plus partner prizes, or partner prizes only.

They may select up to three partner prize programs; multiple tracks from one partner count as one program.

Finalist judging requires a live presentation with four minutes for the demo and three minutes for questions.

Judges consider technical difficulty, originality, practical completeness, usability and the project's distinctive qualities.

The detailed judging guide says partners assess submitted materials and that booth presentations are optional for feedback.

Partner winners are announced during the closing ceremony

Announced partner awards

The prize page lists World at US$12,500; ENS at US$10,000; 1inch at US$7,000; Definitive and Chainlink at US$5,000 each; and 0G, Uniswap Foundation, Arc, Hedera, Arkiv, Whitechain and Ethereum Foundation at US$15,000 each.

These are announced partner prize allocations, with awards subject to each partner's requirements.

Most partners have not yet published their detailed criteria.

1inch has published an Aqua application challenge for a DeFi position demonstrated through test scripts or a user interface.

Its main US$5,000 pool is split into US$2,500, US$1,500 and US$1,000 awards.

A separate continuity-track pool offers US$1,500 and US$500.

Entries must use official Aqua/SwapVM contracts, demonstrate onchain token transfers in the final demo and provide a proper Git history; local forks and modified SwapVM redeployments are allowed.

Projects using SwapVM receive additional judging consideration.

Definitive offers US$2,500 for a social trading application using Flash advanced orders and a separate US$2,500 continuity-track award for a creative Flash integration.

Examples include copy trading, shared signals, agent-operated products, multi-agent workflows and voice or chat trading interfaces.

Both challenges require a working trading flow through Flash API or Flash MCP advanced orders and onchain execution in the final demo.

Entrants must also share a short product video on Discord and X, tagging @DefinitiveFi on X.

The continuity award considers originality, technical creativity and the quality of the demonstration.

The [Mumbai submission guide](https://ethglobal.com/events/mumbai/info/details), [partner prize requirements](https://ethglobal.com/events/mumbai/prizes) and [ETHGlobal rules](https://ethglobal.com/rules) give the participation and award conditions.

Aeternum organizes Unchained Summit India on November 5 and 6, 2026, at Courtyard by Marriott Mumbai International Airport in Andheri East. The conference is for institutional finance teams, investors, founders, developers, exchanges, policymakers and advisers working with digital assets and Web3

Two-day program

November 5 focuses on markets, finance and digital assets. Its announced topics are regulation and policy, tokenization and real-world assets, trading and markets, institutional adoption, stablecoins and payments, wealth and portfolio management, capital markets, and custody, liquidity and prime services.

November 6 focuses on Web3 infrastructure and emerging technology. Its announced subjects are AI and agentic systems, DeFi, blockchain scaling and infrastructure, security and digital trust, staking and network economics, consumer Web3 applications, emerging technologies, and interoperability and chain abstraction.

Across the program, the organizer's topic descriptions also cover India's digital-asset regulation, taxation and compliance; tokenized funds, securities and commodities; payment rails for settlement, remittances, treasury and commerce; machine payments and decentralized intelligence; and enterprise blockchain uses in settlement, trade, identity, data and tokenization

Aishwary Gupta, Global Head of Business at Polygon Labs; Kunaal Patel, Head of Institutional for Asia and MENA at Ondo Finance; Haley Lowy, Chief of Staff at SingularityNET; and Dinesh Dahiya, Vice President at OpenZeppelin.

Punit Agarwal, Founder and CEO of KoinX; Jaideep Reddy, Partner at Trilegal; and Uttam Singh, Senior Developer Relations Engineer at Alchemy.

- S B Seker, Head of APAC at Binance; Praneeth Srikanti, Partner at Ethereal Ventures; and Prabal Banerjee, Co-Founder of Avail.

The organizer maintains the [full India speaker roster](https://unchainedsummit.com/india/speakers)

Unchained Pitch Challenge

The Pitch Challenge takes place on November 5 within the summit. It accepts applications from Web3 startups under five years old, including protocols, DeFi projects, tokenized real-world asset projects and cross-chain tools. Teams may be at any funding stage. Applications should demonstrate product or technical strength, together with traction or an innovative roadmap.

Applicants submit a pitch deck for advisory-panel review. Only selected finalists are invited to pitch on stage, and winners are announced during the summit. The organizer describes press exposure and potential investor introductions as benefits; the page does not promise investment or a cash award.

The [pitch application page](https://unchainedsummit.com/india/pitch-competition/) contains conflicting cutoffs: its timeline says applications close October 25, with finalist selection on October 30, while its application callout says October 30. Applicants should confirm the cutoff with the organizer rather than rely on the later date

Tickets and attendance

Early-bird tickets are listed at US$149 for Standard and US$229 for VIP through October 26, 2026, with tax included. Standard includes conference sessions, networking and exhibition areas, lunch and coffee breaks. VIP adds access to the VIP and speaker lounge. The published last-chance prices are US$199 and US$299 respectively.

Only registered ticket holders may attend the summit and its networking events, and payment secures the booking. Registration may remain available until the first day if capacity allows. The FAQ specifies prior written authorization 90 days before the summit for ticket substitutions. The event is conducted in English without translation services, and the organizer encourages business-formal or smart-casual dress.

Personal audio/video recording is permitted. Publishing or transmitting recordings requires permission, with an exception for clips under one minute used in blogging or press coverage.

The venue address is C.

S. No. 215, Andheri Kurla Road, Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400059.

### About the tour

India Blockchain & AI Tour 2026 is the fifth edition of the India Blockchain & AI Tour - Octaloop's most ambitious journey through the heart of the world's fastest-growing Web3 economy. As the global spotlight turns to India for Devcon 2026, the tour returns to 10 cities to bridge the gap between global innovation and local grassroots talent. It is the biggest year yet, designed to connect 15,000+ builders, founders, and leaders across Tier 1 and Tier 2 hubs - not just a set of events, but a distribution layer for the Indian ecosystem.

### Why attend

Architect networking: with 65%+ decision-maker attendance, IBT is where global protocol founders meet India's institutional capital.

Market penetration: bridge the gap between global tech and India's 500M+ digital natives across 10 strategic cities.

Talent integration: engage with the world's densest pool of Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon developers via curated talent showcases.

Elite VIP access: from private HNI dinners to exclusive Whale Lounges, experience the highest tier of Indian business hospitality.

### Flagship event

The IBT26 flagship event is Metamorphosis Hyderabad. Metamorphosis is the crown jewel of the India Blockchain Tour: a high-impact convergence of global protocols and India's leading AI x Web3 innovators. Over two days in Hyderabad, the program moves beyond panels to outcomes - from curated investor roundtables to the Founder Demo Day, this is where the industry's next $100M ideas get mapped out.

### Who should attend

Founders & CXOs: connect with global protocols and local venture capital to turn an MVP into a market leader.

Institutional investors: access a high-density pool of vetted Web3 startups and the developers behind India's most successful dApps.

Global ecosystems: deploy a GTM strategy across 10 strategic nodes and integrate with the world's largest Web3 workforce.

Policy & enterprise: engage with regulators and industry titans to lead the institutional adoption of blockchain in Bharat.

### About the event

Bitcoin Events hosts the eighth Crypto Fest in Cape Town, South Africa, on November 20, 2026. Set against the backdrop of Workshop17 Watershed, the event brings together over 30 global innovators, founders, investors, and blockchain enthusiasts to explore cryptocurrency, decentralized finance (DeFi), and the convergence of AI with Web3.

The 2026 theme, Decentralised Intelligence: The Convergence of AI, Web3 & Data, examines how autonomous intelligence and decentralized protocols intersect across emerging markets. South Africa represents one of the fastest-growing crypto ecosystems in Africa, having approved over 248 CASP licenses under FSCA regulation alongside the implementation of Financial Intelligence Centre Directive 9 for Travel Rule compliance. The conference features keynote presentations, panel sessions, interactive workshops, and an exhibition floor showcasing licensed CASPs, fintech solutions, and institutional tools.

### About the event

No slides. No agenda. Just good food, good wine, and the people who shape how markets are understood.

Some of the best conversations in this industry never make it onto a stage!

On 27th November, CoinMarketCap is hosting an intimate lunch in Bangkok for a small group of journalists and media partners from the crypto and financial publications we read and respect.

There's no presentation, no product pitch, and nothing to file. We'd simply like to put faces to bylines, trade notes on where markets are heading, and get to know the people behind the stories over a long, unhurried lunch.

Joining you from CoinMarketCap: our CEO, CMO, Head of Product, Head of Research, and PR manager.

The conversation is held under the Chatham House Rule, and the guest list is kept deliberately small. We'd be grateful if you didn't share this invitation. If you know a colleague who would be a wonderful addition, tell us and we'll do our best to make room.

Date: 27 November, 2026, 12:00pm - 3:00pm

Venue: Exact location shared once the application is approved.

Dress: Smart casual

RSVP: By 23 November, 2026. Seats are limited.

We'd love to see you at the table!

### See what the teams have been building

Protocol Camp's Cohort 10 teams are bringing their latest work to Bangkok.

Join us for an afternoon of project presentations, product demos and expert feedback, featuring Protocol Camp teams alongside builders from Team1.

Teams will share the problems they're tackling, what they've built so far and the questions shaping their next steps.

Mid Demo is a checkpoint in the building process. For fellow builders, founders, investors and product teams, it's an opportunity to get a closer look at emerging projects and hear how the teams are developing and testing their ideas.

### What to expect

- Team presentations & product demos: See the projects taking shape across Protocol Camp Cohort 10 and the participating Team1 builders.
- Expert questions & feedback: Hear judges discuss the teams' products, development progress, user validation and opportunities for improvement.
- A look at what comes next: Learn how teams are using feedback to decide what to test, refine and build next.

### Tentative agenda

13:00-13:30 | Check-in & seating

13:30-13:45 | Welcome, program introductions & judge briefing

Additional introductions: 13:45-13:55 | Team1 introduction (reserved slot; speaker and use to be confirmed). 13:55-14:05 | Tangem introduction.

14:05-15:05 | Pitch Block 1: Protocol Camp (6 teams)

15:05-15:15 | Break

15:15-16:05 | Pitch Block 2: Protocol Camp (5 teams)

16:05-16:15 | Break

16:15-17:15 | Pitch Block 3: Team1 (6 teams)

17:15-17:20 | Closing feedback & next steps

17:20-17:25 | Group photo

17:25-17:30 | Buffer / program close

All times are in Bangkok time: ICT, UTC+7. The schedule is tentative. The final team line-up and presentation order will be announced.

### Event details

Date: 28 November 2026 Program: 13:30-17:30 ICT Check-in: From 13:00 Venue: District X, FYI Center, Bangkok

Please register in advance. Attendance is subject to approval, and you'll receive a confirmation email once your registration is approved.

### Continue the conversation

Next Builders: Bangkok Afterparty (https://luma.com/wr25zqb6) takes place later that evening at Citycup BKK, from 18:00 to 21:00 ICT.

Join the evening gathering to continue conversations with builders and project teams.

Please register separately through the afterparty event page.

### About Protocol Camp

Protocol Camp is a 12-week Web3 and AI builder bootcamp co-hosted by ShardLab and Hashed, running since 2022. Fully sponsored from start to finish, the program pairs every builder with a mentor, puts teams in front of VCs rather than a crowd, and sends them out with a product rather than a certificate. Cohort 9 is the program's largest Asia-wide batch to date.

### About ShardLab & Hashed

ShardLab is the innovation arm of Hashed, a leading global digital asset venture capital firm. Established through the strategic partnership between Hashed and SCBX, Thailand's leading financial technology group and the parent company of Siam Commercial Bank, ShardLab researches, builds, and scales frontier technologies through R&D, venture building, and ecosystem development.

By connecting founders, enterprises, researchers, and institutions, we transform bold ideas into real-world innovation. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption of AI, digital assets, and emerging technologies while building a more connected and innovative future across Asia.

Hashed partners with the founders shaping the next paradigm in blockchain, AI, and content, joining them from the earliest moments as technology redraws the boundaries of industries.

Headquartered in Seoul and operating from five global hubs across San Francisco, Singapore, Bangkok, Bangalore, and Abu Dhabi, Hashed provides the capital, networks, and on-the-ground execution that help founders move beyond a single region and reach meaningful scale in global markets.

About Team1 - Co-host Avalanche Team1 is a global community network that helps builders get started and grow in the Avalanche ecosystem. Its local communities run workshops, hackathons, and meetups where developers and creators can learn, connect, and build together. Learn more (https://www.team1.network/)

About Tangem - Partner Tangem makes self-custody crypto wallets, including hardware cards and rings that pair with a smartphone. Users can manage their digital assets in the Tangem app while keeping their private keys on the hardware device. Learn more (https://tangem.com/en/help-center/introduction-to-tangem-wallet/wallet-types-mobile-vs-hardware/)

About Tokenomist - Partner Tokenomist is a tokenomics analytics platform that tracks token unlocks, vesting schedules, allocations, and emissions. Its dashboard and API help researchers and builders understand how token supply changes over time. Learn more (https://tokenomist.ai/)

About Bitkub Capital Group Holdings - With support from

Bitkub Capital Group Holdings is a Thailand-based technology group building digital infrastructure that connects traditional finance with the digital economy. Its companies work across digital asset services, blockchain technology, and education.

Learn more (https://www.bitkubcapital.com/)

About the organiser: ShardLab is the innovation arm of Hashed, a leading global Web3 venture capital firm based in Asia.

Kenny is Co-Chairman and Co-Founder of KainoQ Capital, a private investment firm seeding founders of innovations in Asia. He co-founded KainoQ Capital with two veteran investors and scientists from Two Sigma and Goldman Sachs.

Kenny is also currently a Board Member of Two Sigma Asia. He was formerly Two Sigma Asia's CEO and Chairman of Two Sigma China. Two Sigma is one of world's largest hedge funds. Two Sigma China is the second largest global hedge fund in China.

Earlier in his career, Kenny was Global Partner of McKinsey & Company and a co-leader of its Asia Financial Institutional Practice. Kenny was one of the fastest rising partners ever of McKinsey, elected as a global partner six years from his start as an analyst.

Kenny has a few public roles. He is a Member of the Board of Advisors of The Wharton School,The School's most senior board and was formerly Chairman of the Executive Board of the Wharton School in Asia. He is Vice-Chairman and Trustee of the Asia Pacific Council of The Nature Conservancy. He is Co-Founder and Co-Chairman of Melo Foundation, one of the largest youth empowerment NGOs in Asia.

Kenny graduated with a finance degree from the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania and a law degree from Oxford University. He was the first ever Chinese to be awarded the Joseph Wharton Scholarship. He is a best-selling published author in China with his recent book "Choices" reaching No.4 in e-book sales in China in 2023.

## Consensus Miami 2027

- Record: `premier-consensus-miami-2027`
- Source: [curated-events.json](sources/curated-events.json)
- Starts: 2027-05-04T09:00:00-04:00
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://consensus.coindesk.com/>

### About the event

CoinDesk's Consensus Miami 2027 is a three-day gathering for participants in crypto, finance, technology and policy. Its announced themes cover crypto at scale, institutional integration and agentic commerce. The current program highlights include a fireside conversation with CZ, a keynote by Michael Saylor, a fireside conversation with Chairman Selig and a session on crypto payment rails and open protocols for agentic commerce. Consult the official program for updated times and speaker details.

Vivek Raman is the Co-Founder and CEO of Etherealize, where he is building the global settlement network for tokenized assets on Ethereum. Etherealize is the only company ever funded by the Ethereum Foundation to serve as its institutional arm, and is backed by Paradigm, Electric Capital, and Vitalik Buterin. Prior to founding Etherealize, Vivek spent fifteen years on Wall Street and in digital assets. He traded high-yield bonds, distressed credit, leveraged loans, and credit default swaps at Morgan Stanley, UBS, Deutsche Bank, and Nomura.

He went on to serve as Managing Director and Head of Digital Assets at BitOoda, a regulated digital asset investment bank, and built a real estate portfolio of 100+ homes and land parcels - where the industry's inefficiency drove his interest in blockchain. In June 2025, Vivek testified before the U.

S. House Financial Services Committee in support of the CLARITY Act, making the case that decentralized blockchain networks represent critical infrastructure for the next generation of American capital markets. He has also engaged directly with the SEC's Crypto Task Force and serves on the CFTC's Industry Advisory Committee on the regulatory framework for tokenized assets. At Etherealize, Vivek has assembled a team of over thirty spanning Wall Street veterans and Ethereum's most accomplished engineers and has raised $40 million to bring institutional assets fully on-chain. He is a graduate of Yale University, where he studied economics.

### About the event

The Bridge Between TradFi and Digital Assets. The Institutional Summit for Digital Assets. Paris, July 6-7, 2027

What it is

Signal Week is the summit for the institutional digital-assets sector, set in Paris. It succeeds seven years of Paris Blockchain Week as its elevation for the decade ahead: where Paris Blockchain Week built credibility as Europe's leading institutional digital asset conference, Signal Week positions it for the decade ahead

Audience

The organizer inherits an audience with more than 70% C-suite or investment decision-makers, 36,000-plus facilitated networking meetings, $50 trillion-plus in assets under management represented, and 389 government officials and policymakers. It is built for banking and financial services, asset management, enterprise, digital-asset native firms, traditional finance, infrastructure providers and family offices

### Speakers

Past stages have hosted Changpeng Zhao (Binance), Jeremy Allaire (Circle), Lily Liu (Solana Foundation), Silvio Micali (Algorand), Charles Hoskinson, Joseph Lubin (ConsenSys), Tim Draper, Jan Van Eck (VanEck), Yoni Assia (eToro) and Arianna Simpson (a16z), alongside French ministers Anne Le Henanff, Clara Chappaz and Marina Ferrari. Featured faces for 2027 include Adam Back, Nikhil Sharma (BlackRock), Kara Kennedy (JP Morgan), Amy Oldenburg (Morgan Stanley), Ben Slavin (BNY), Christian Rau (Mastercard) and Daniel Seifert (Coinbase)

Participation

Participants span digital-asset native builders, TradFi and fintech institutions deploying at scale, AI-for-finance providers and ecosystem partners. Founding partnerships for Signal Week 2027 are open.

## WebX 2027 Tokyo

### About the event

WebX is one of Asia's largest global conferences, planned and operated by CoinPost, Japan's leading crypto asset and Web3 media platform. Held in Tokyo, the event attracts a diverse audience from Japan and around the world. WebX comprehensively covers a wide range of Web3-related topics, including cryptocurrencies, blockchain technology, Web3 infrastructure, NFTs, DeFi, and AI. Major enterprises, technology companies, financial institutions, investors, developers, media organizations, experts, and general attendees gather to explore the latest technological trends, industry applications, and community culture.

### Our concept

"Connecting the Nodes Beyond the Screen" is not just a slogan. it is a commitment for the future. At WebX, every industry, company, and individual is connected beyond digital boundaries, like nodes connected in blockchains, transforming the world through the power of advanced technology. WebX is also the only conference where attendees can interact with a broad spectrum of government organizations, established companies, IP companies, and Web3 companies.

### Sponsors and partners

WebX brings together sponsor tiers including title, platinum, gold, silver, stage, media, and support partners. from Japanese exchanges, banks and financial institutions such as bitFlyer, Bitbank, SBI Holdings, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Mitsubishi UFJ Asset Management, Binance Japan, and Metaplanet to global Web3 companies such as Binance, Fireblocks, Ripple, BlackRock, Franklin Templeton, Circle, Solana Foundation, Polymarket, and Avalanche.

### Industry and community associations

The conference is supported by Japanese industry bodies including the Japan Cryptoasset Business Association (JCBA), Japan Blockchain Association (JBA), JVCEA, the Blockchain Collaboration Consortium (BCCC), the Japan Security Token Association, and the Japan Digital Distributed Finance Association (JDFA).

Bitcoin Asia returns to Hong Kong on 26-27 August 2027, with the organisers describing it as the meeting point where the exchanges, builders, allocators and the wider Bitcoin community across Asia come together under one roof

Passes The 2027 General Admission pass is listed at $69 and covers two-day access to the Main Stage and Side Stage sessions, the Expo Hall, the Art Gallery hosting Asia's largest Bitcoin digital art showcase, and the official event app for planning the agenda. The General Admission Plus pass is $129 and adds the Deal Flow Zone for one-to-one business meetings, in-app meeting-table booking, BTC+ networking app access, priority Main Stage seating and a dedicated check-in desk.

The Whale Pass is $1,499 and includes backstage deep sessions with speakers, all-inclusive food and drinks, access to Whale Night side events and the after-party, The Deep private lounge, priority seating and a VIP gift bag.  Groups and companies can request a tailored package

Past speakers Previous editions featured CZ, Balaji Srinivasan (CEO and founder, Network School), Dr Hon Johnny Ng and Kit Chong MH (Hong Kong Legislative Council), David Bailey (CEO and chairman, Nakamoto Inc.), Simon Gerovich (CEO, Metaplanet), Justin Sun (advisor, WBTC), Aj Scaramucci (founder and CEO, Treasure Trove), Jack Kong (founder and board member, Nano Labs and Hong Kong Cyberport), Bonnie Chang (founder and host, Bonnie Blockchain) and Bilal Bin Saqib (chairman, Pakistan Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority). ### About the event

ProbeLab, the Ethereum Foundation, HOPR and Optimum host the P2P Networking Hub at Devcon 8 on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, from 10:00 to 17:00 IST in Mumbai. The full-day collaborative unconference focuses on peer-to-peer protocols, decentralized transport, and network layer resilience

### What to expect

The hub features an interactive program organized into technical presentations, hands-on debugging clinics, and open breakout sessions:

- Peer discovery and DHT performance across discv5, Kademlia, and gossipsub networks.
- Transport protocols and privacy, highlighting libp2p enhancements, mixnets, and traffic analysis resistance.
- Ethereum client networking benchmarks, examining bandwidth optimization, latency Reduction, and message propagation bottlenecks.
- Interactive clinics where client teams review telemetry data, diagnose live testnet connection issues, and workshop next-generation transport specifications

### Who should attend

This unconference is intended for P2P protocol researchers, client core developers (Geth, Nethermind, Besu, Lighthouse, Prysm), network infrastructure engineers, and developers building decentralized storage and messaging applications

Venue and schedule

The event takes place inside the Jio World Convention Centre in the Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), Mumbai, within the Devcon Impact Space, on November 4 from 10:00 to 17:00 IST

Registration and admission

Access is free for Devcon 8 attendees. Advance registration on Luma is encouraged to receive schedule updates, presentation slides, and clinic agenda materials.

Astralane and hosts Sujith Sizon, Manan Indir Singh, and Dhruvraj Solanki present MeV Sangam in Mumbai on Monday, November 2, 2026, from 18:00 to 22:00 IST. The off-the-record gathering convenes quantitative researchers, searchers, and block builders exploring maximal extractable value

### What to expect

MeV Sangam is conducted under Chatham House Rule to encourage transparent, candid discussion on the frontier of MEV research:

Proposer-Builder Separation (PBS) dynamics and inclusion lists across Ethereum Layer 1 and rollups.

High-frequency arbitrage, statistical cross-chain arbitrage, and algorithmic liquidation risks.

- Solana searcher latency wars, Jito auction mechanics, and priority fee markets.
- Orderflow auctions, private mempools, and fair-sequencing mechanisms.

The presentations are followed by a private networking dinner with craft beers, cocktails, and food

### Who should attend

Attendance is limited to active MEV searchers, quantitative trading engineers, block builders, relay operators, and protocol economists specializing in mechanism design

Venue and schedule

The dinner takes place at a private dining venue in G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), Mumbai, on Monday, November 2, running from 18:00 to 22:00 IST

Registration and admission

Registration is strictly approval-based with limited seating. Applications are reviewed based on active contributions to MEV research and trading infrastructure. Confirmed guests receive confidential venue coordinates.

### About the event

Get Tech Vibes. Get Connected. Get Funded. Free to attend, happy hour prices all night, and a free beer for the first guests through the door. Arrive before 6 PM. Vancouver's founders, angel investors, creators, and Web3 builders in one room. Hear from two serial founders with multiple exits, meet angel investors, and keep the night going with a live DJ.

### What to expect

- 5-6 PM: Doors + networking. Grab your free beer and appetizers early arrivals and meet founders, investors, and operators.
- 6-7 PM: Founder AMA2 (starts sharply at 6). Real stories and straight answers from Hussein Hallak and Mike Nabavi, with angel investors on hand. Bring your questions.
- 7 PM-close: Live DJ + networking. Keep the conversations going. On stage: Hussein Hallak is the author of the Amazon bestseller, The Dark Art of Life Mastery, and a serial entrepreneur with two exits and 22 businesses built across Damascus, Dubai and Vancouver. His first tech company was acqui-hired by Spacetoon, the Disney of the Middle East. He co-founded CreativeArab, the world's first and largest online marketplace of Middle Eastern art, built award-winning creative agencies, and led product, sales and strategy teams serving brands like P&G, Unilever, Universal and Disney. He was General Manager and Head Mentor of Launch Academy, Vancouver's largest startup hub, whose 6,500+ founders have gone on to raise over $2.5 billion. He spent two seasons on the tech panel of Our City with Kirk LaPointe on RoundHouse Radio, and was tech lead on MBC's No. 1 morning show, watched by 40 million viewers. Today he is founder and CEO of Next Decentrum and editor of The Streetlight on Substack. Mike Nabavi, six-time founder. He sold his first company, started in university, after growing it past 35 people. He drafted the business plan behind Guest-Tek's TSX IPO, consulted at Deloitte, ran a tech startup for a decade before exiting, and has since backed numerous startups. His payments venture LavaPay had a pipeline nearing $9M a month when its banks shut it down, which led to Omnieon, infrastructure for federated finance. Today he works as an interim or fractional executive for early-stage and owner-operated companies. Ask Mike anything, including what he got wrong. Who should come: founders looking to raise, investors looking for deal flow, and operators and creators building in Vancouver. Register to save your spot, and arrive early: capacity is limited and the free keg of beer goes to early guest arrivals. Presented by The Art Party (AV, sound, live DJs)

The Basement (160 capacity)

Hastings Crossing BIA

Vancouver News Livestream with support from Impresario Partners, a consulting and VC firm, (this event will be livestreamed to 10,000+ viewers)

Micro Media Solutions for photography

Canadian Allied Services for financial advice

Bringing new audiences into the Hastings corridor. Hastings Crossing BIA is an organization that takes a leadership role in managing change and shaping a more resilient, inclusive and sustainable local economy here in the Downtown Eastside. Through collaboration with its business members, grassroots, government, private sector and non-profit partners we bridge the needs of local businesses with the capacity of community focused organizations to foster a vibrant, healthy and diverse area for all - whether you're here every day or just for the afternoon.

This event brings new energy to the Hastings corridor and supports the Hastings Crossing BIA's work to grow local business and entrepreneurship pathways. More info: https://gettechvibes.com/

Join Us 19 - 22 NOVEMBER 2026 PENDULUM HOTEL, MANCHESTER WHAT IS BITFEST? Bitfest is the UK's flagship Bitcoin festival. The 2026 edition is a four-day Bitcoin festival in Manchester, taking place from 19-22 November 2026. It brings together Bitcoiners, builders, communities, artists, families and newcomers for talks, workshops, an expo, art, cinema, gaming, live music, Nostr and freedom technology. So... is it a conference? Well, yes and no. Bitfest is a space where people from all walks of life can come together for a weekend powered by Bitcoiners. It's about community as much as it is about technology: a place to connect, learn, explore, and actually experience Bitcoin culture in action.

While talks and panels are part of the programme, Bitfest goes far beyond a traditional conference - incorporating talks, discussions and hands-on workshops covering not just Bitcoin, but other freedom-adjacent topics. Our inaugural event, Bitfest 2025, featured 5 events and 8 themed zones across 3 days, with 60+ speakers and artists, all hosted across multiple nearby venues. And now Bitfest is back for 2026. Bigger, louder and with even more to explore! This year's programme brings together a staggering 8 events and 9 zones, creating an even bigger celebration of Bitcoin, freedom technology, creativity and the communities building the future.

Bitfest is designed for everyone - whether you're deep in the space or just getting started. It's family-friendly too and so bring the kids along! Day 0 also features Nostrshire, the UK's first full-scale conference dedicated entirely to Nostr. EVENTS Bitfest isn't just one event - it's a whole weekend of them. From Nostr and Bitcoin conferences to live music, internet culture, social events and everything in between, each event has its own character, community and reason to be here. Explore the events that make up Bitfest 2026. THERE'S MORE TO EXPLORE ZONES Across the festival you'll find nine themed zones, each bringing a different side of Bitcoin and freedom technology to life.

From talks and hands-on workshops to gaming, music, art, business and a place for the kids, there's plenty to explore beyond the main stage. CONFERENCE TALKS & PANELS Hear from leading Bitcoin professionals, builders and people advocating for Bitcoin and Nostr. WORKSHOP / HACK ZONE DIY Build, learn and collaborate across two days of workshops, unconference sessions and the Bitfest 2026 Hackathon. Explore the Hackathon EXHIBITION PROJECT AND BUSINESS EXPO Discover and catch up with the latest projects and businesses building on Bitcoin. GALLERY BY PEPE.

X BITCOIN ART EXHIBITION A visual celebration of Bitcoin culture, digital art, memes and creative experiments, bringing the weird, wonderful and wildly creative side of the internet into the real world. FREEDOM FEST FREEDOM & SOVEREIGNTY TECH Explore privacy, digital rights, civil liberties and freedom technology through Freedom Fest - a distinct event running alongside Bitfest on Saturday. FREEDOM FEST GAMING GAMES & COMPETITIONS Enter the gaming zone to discover Bitcoin-powered games and participate in competitive gaming sessions. MUSIC NEW MUSIC ECONOMY & VALUEVERSE Entertainment led by musicians utilising New Music Economy tooling in the Valueverse.

NETWORKING DRINKS, FOOD & BANTER Mix and mingle networking zones in both the Pendulum Café during the day and The Shack NQ in the evening. KIDS BITCOIN JUNIORS A safe, supervised space for kids to play, create and have fun, with DBS-checked staff so parents can leave them safely and catch a talk, explore the festival or grab a bit of peace and quiet.

PRE-PARTY BITFLIX & PRE-EVENT RECEPTION 4:30pm - 1am - 19 NOVEMBER - PENDULUM HOTEL/THE TAP HOUSE Kick off the Bitfest weekend with The Six Billion Dollar Man, Eugene Jarecki's award-winning documentary exploring Julian Assange, WikiLeaks and the price of truth. Fittingly, when traditional gatekeepers blocked the film, it found a route to audiences through the Bitcoin community. Full Bitfest ticket holders can then join our exclusive pre-event drinks reception to meet fellow Bitcoiners and get the weekend started. HACKATHON 20-21 NOVEMBER

MOMENTUM SUITE BUILD SOMETHING BITFEST HACK ZONE + HACKATHON More than 24 hours of building across Nostrshire + Bitfest. The Bitfest Hack Zone combines an open-format Bitcoin & Nostr Hackathon with participant-led workshops, demos, talks and unconference sessions. Bring an idea. Find a team. Join a build. Or just come and learn. 2 DAYS Friday + Saturday 24+ HOURS From kick-off to submission OPEN FORMAT Bitcoin and/or Nostr Supported by EXPLORE THE HACK ZONE DAY 0 NOSTRSHIRE 9am - 6pm - 20 NOVEMBER - PENDULUM HOTEL Nostrshire is the UK's first full-scale Nostr conference, bringing together builders, developers, creatives and enthusiasts under one roof, all in one day.

We would have added freedom fighters to the list, but we would say that all these people are on the cutting edge of freedom, privacy and decentralisation technology. With 5 events and 8 zones Bitfest was created to be a bastion of Bitcoin education, culture and community for the UK. Bitcoiners together strong! Read More 2025 GALLERY Check out some of the action from Bitfest 2025. SEE MORE FAQ What is Bitfest? Bitfest is the UK's flagship Bitcoin festival, bringing together Bitcoin, Nostr, freedom technology, music, art, culture, workshops, gaming, businesses and communities for one packed long weekend in Manchester. When is Bitfest 2026? Bitfest 2026 runs from 19-22 November 2026, with different events taking place across the long weekend. Where is Bitfest?

Bitfest's main venue is The Pendulum Hotel in Manchester, with events taking place at nearby venues throughout the weekend. Do I need to know about Bitcoin to attend? Absolutely not. Bitfest is for everyone - from people who have been running nodes for years to people who have only just heard about Bitcoin. Come curious, ask questions and get involved. How do I get to Bitfest? Driving From the North - M6 / M61 Follow the M6/M61 towards Manchester, then join the M60 following signs for Stretford. Take M60 Junction 12 and join the M602 towards Salford/Manchester. At the end of the M602, follow the A57 towards Manchester.

Continue onto the A57(M) Mancunian Way and take the second exit, then immediately follow the slip road signed University/Sackville Street. The Pendulum is on Sackville Street. From the South & Midlands - M6 Follow the M6 north and leave at Junction 19, taking the A556 towards Manchester. At the Bowdon roundabout, take the third exit onto the M56 towards Manchester Airport/Manchester. Continue to the end of the M56 and follow the A5103 towards Manchester. At the roundabout beneath the road, take the third exit following A57(M) / Sheffield signs, then take the second exit up the ramp onto the A57(M).

Take the next exit signed University and immediately fork left onto the slip road for University/Sackville Street. The Pendulum is ahead on Sackville Street. From London - M40 / M42 / M6 Follow the M40 north, then the M42/M6 towards Manchester. Continue on the M6 north and leave at Junction 19, then follow the South & Midlands directions above via the A556 and M56. From Manchester Airport - M56 Take the M56 towards Manchester. At the end of the motorway, continue onto the A5103 towards Manchester and follow the same route as above: take the third exit at the roundabout following A57(M) / Sheffield, then the second exit onto the A57(M).

Take the next exit signed University and follow the slip road for University/Sackville Street. Public Transport From Manchester Piccadilly: The Pendulum is around a 10-15 minute walk from Manchester Piccadilly station, or a short taxi ride. From Manchester Oxford Road: The Pendulum is only a few minutes' walk from Manchester Oxford Road station. From Manchester Airport: Direct trains run from Manchester Airport to Manchester Piccadilly, normally taking around 20 minutes. From Piccadilly, The Pendulum is a short walk or taxi ride. Manchester is also well connected by rail from cities across the UK, including London, Birmingham, Leeds, Liverpool and Sheffield. Is there parking nearby? Yes.

There are several car parks within walking distance of The Pendulum, including NCP Circle Square on Oxford Road, which is just a couple of minutes from the hotel. We'll add further details, including any Bitfest/Pendulum parking discounts or codes, here once confirmed. What does my ticket include? There are several ticket options depending on how much of the festival you want to experience. A Full Bitfest Ticket gives you access across the main festival programme and includes the exclusive Bitflix Pre-Event Reception. Can I buy a One Day Pass? Yes.

A One Day Pass can be used for Nostrshire on 20 November or Bitfest on 21 November, and includes access to all zones and the relevant afterparty. What is Bitflix? Bitflix is our Bitcoin Film Zone, returning this year as a pre-festival event. It kicks off the festival with a screening of The Six Billion Dollar Man, followed by the Bitflix Pre-Event Reception. It's a chance to start the weekend with a great film, good conversation and the wider Bitfest community. Who can attend the Bitflix Pre-Event Reception? The Pre-Event Reception is an exclusive benefit for Full Bitfest Ticket holders. One Day Pass and Afterparty-only tickets do not include access to the reception.

Are children welcome at Bitfest? Yes. Bitfest is family-friendly, and children are welcome. For ticketing purposes, a child is anyone under 16. Can I leave my children in the Kids Zone? Yes. The Kids Zone is a supervised play space for children during the festival where they can play safely while parents enjoy the event. It is not intended as a formal childcare or day-care service. The team are DBS checked and appropriate safeguarding procedures are in place. Where can I see the full agenda? The full agenda, including timings, speakers, workshops, performances and other programme details, will be published separately as we get closer to the festival. Can I pay for my ticket with Bitcoin?

Yes. Bitfest tickets are available to purchase in Bitcoin or fiat. I've never been to a Bitcoin event before. Will I fit in? Definitely. Bitfest is deliberately broader than a traditional Bitcoin conference. Whether you're a hardcore Bitcoiner, a Nostr user, a builder, artist, musician, entrepreneur, parent or simply curious about what all the fuss is about, you're welcome. Are there any discount codes for accommodation? Yes. We've secured a discounted accommodation rate at The Pendulum Hotel, our main venue in Manchester city centre - Sackville Street, about a 5-minute walk from Piccadilly Station. Book at the Bitfest rate using code BITFEST - Book now.

If the Pendulum is full, there are several other hotels within a few minutes' walk of the venue. The closest are the ibis Manchester Centre (Princess Street) and the Maldron Hotel Manchester City Centre, both on Charles Street. Also nearby: Motel One Manchester-Piccadilly, Premier Inn Manchester City (Piccadilly), Travelodge Manchester Piccadilly and Malmaison Manchester. We're still confirming rates and discount codes with other local hotels - anything we secure will be added here. I have a different question. How can I get in contact? Complete the form below and we'll be in touch as soon as possible.

## Global Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit 2026

- Record: `curated-global-bitcoin-circular-economies-summit-2026-11-19`
- Source: [verified-discovery.json](sources/verified-discovery.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-19
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://www.bitcoinbeach.com/summit-blog/bitcoin-circular-economies-summit-2026>

### About the event

Two years ago, the Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit was a closed room: leaders from circular economies around the world comparing notes and figuring out together what actually works when you try to make Bitcoin a daily medium of exchange instead of a speculative bet. Quiet work - the kind nobody tweets about while it's happening. On November 19-20, 2026, the Global Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit becomes a public conference for the first time, and it's happening in El Zonte. Not San Salvador. Not a hotel ballroom somewhere convenient.

El Zonte, the same stretch of sand where this whole story started, where people were paying for pupusas and surfboards in sats years before anyone outside the country had heard of Bitcoin Beach. It's the first conference of its kind this town has ever hosted, and there's really only one thing it could be about: Bitcoin is money, and the circular economies are the proof.

### Two years of building toward this

For two Summits, the focus was internal. Builders talking to builders. Communities in El Salvador, Africa, Southeast Asia, and Latin America comparing what worked, what failed, what scaled. It turned into a real global conversation, even if most people never saw it happen. The 2026 edition finally opens that conversation to everyone who's been curious from the outside: leaders, merchants, educators, developers, and honestly, anyone who wants to see what Bitcoin adoption looks like when it's not a headline but a Tuesday afternoon at a market stall.

### What two days actually look like

This isn't a stage with slides and a Q&A at the end. It's workshops, panels, and fireside chats built around the questions that actually define where Bitcoin adoption goes next:

Bitcoin is money: the case from on-the-ground reality

Circular economies: what's working, what's scaling, what's next

Bitcoin for merchants: practical adoption at the point of sale

Education: onboarding the next million users

Adoption: pathways from curiosity to daily use

Tools: the infrastructure powering real-world Bitcoin commerce

Every session wraps before sunset. This is El Zonte, after all, and nobody organizing this event forgot that the ocean is right there.

### Who's already confirmed

The lineup is still growing, but a few names are already locked in, and they set the tone for what this Summit is actually about:

Jeremy Almond (@jeremyalmond), Co-Founder & CEO of Paystand

Alexandra Navarro (@alex_navarro0), also from Paystand

Gerardo Linares (@GR_Linares1), driving Bitcoin adoption through education and real-world circular economies with Bitcoin Berlin SV and Bitcoin La Laguna

Evelyn Lemus (@Evelynlemus2906), building and educating communities through the same two projects

Not a single one of them is on this list because of a headline they made. They're here because they took Bitcoin out of theory and put it directly into the hands of people who never had financial access before. That's the thread running through this whole event.

### A beach, not a backdrop

Come for the panels, but stay for the reason this movement exists in the first place. You're going to hear it straight from the people who built it: why Bitcoin is money, why it matters for the people who've been failed by every other financial system, and why freedom and fairness aren't abstract words when you've watched them play out in a small coastal town. And between sessions, there's still surf if you want it, and still that particular warmth of Bitcoin Country that doesn't translate to a conference center anywhere else. This isn't a Bitcoin summit that happens to be near a beach. It only makes sense on this one.

### November in El Salvador is getting busy

This isn't even the only Bitcoin event on the calendar this month, and that alone says something about where this country is right now:

November 10 - Bitcoin Capital Summit

November 11-12 - Bitcoin Historico, San Salvador

November 18-19 - EmTech AI Conference

November 19-20 - Global Bitcoin Circular Economies Summit, El Zonte

Four events, one month, in a country that used to make headlines for very different reasons. Now it's builders, educators, and investors filling flights to come see what's actually being built here.

### We're genuinely looking forward to this one

Every year this Summit has been a working session behind closed doors. This year, for the first time, everyone gets to be in the room, and that shift feels like a real milestone - not just for the event but for the movement it represents. El Zonte earned this. The people who built circular economies from nothing, in El Salvador and around the world, earned a stage. Seats are limited, and this is the first time El Zonte has hosted anything like it. If you want to hear, in their own words, why Bitcoin is money, this is the place to be.

## Money in Motion: The Future of Cross-Border Payments

- Record: `ibw-luma-evt-YVm4KRLRsBEK4un`
- Source: [ibw-side-events.json](sources/ibw-side-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-30T11:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/z10bdk0l>

### About the event

The infrastructure powering global payments is undergoing a fundamental shift.

Digital assets, emerging financial technologies, and evolving regulatory frameworks are creating new possibilities for how money moves across borders. As traditional financial systems converge with digital asset infrastructure, new opportunities and challenges are emerging for businesses, financial institutions, and investors.

Beyond the promise of faster and more efficient transactions, important questions remain. How can innovation operate within existing regulatory frameworks? What does it take to build reliable, scalable cross-border payment infrastructure? And where do the most compelling opportunities lie for founders and investors?

LedgerPe Labs and Chambers of Rachana Rautray invite you to Money in Motion, an exclusive industry gathering exploring the intersection of regulation, financial infrastructure, digital assets, and venture capital.

The evening will feature a focused industry discussion followed by an opportunity to connect with fellow founders, investors, and professionals shaping the future of global finance.

### The Conversation

One Panel. Multiple Perspectives.

The discussion will explore four interconnected themes:

Regulation & Compliance

Understanding the evolving regulatory landscape for cross-border payments, with a focus on India-UAE corridors, digital asset frameworks, and the responsibilities of financial intermediaries.

Infrastructure & Execution

Examining the practical challenges of building reliable cross-border payment systems, including liquidity, settlement, banking partnerships, interoperability, and operational resilience.

Investment & Opportunities

Exploring emerging business models, opportunities for innovation, and what makes financial infrastructure companies commercially sustainable, scalable, and attractive to investors.

The Road Ahead

Discussing the future of institutional adoption, the convergence of digital assets and traditional finance, and the next generation of global payment infrastructure.

### Evening Agenda

5:00 PM. 6:00 PM | Panel Discussion & Audience Q&A

A moderated conversation exploring the regulatory, technological, and commercial realities of cross-border payments.

6:00 PM. 7:00 PM | Networking & Refreshments

Continue the conversation over refreshments and connect with founders, investors, fintech executives, and professionals working across financial services and digital assets.

### Event Details

Date: Friday, 30 October 2026 Time: 5:00 PM. 7:00 PM IST Venue: Spotlight Strategic Partners, Andheri East, Mumbai Format: Industry Panel & Networking

Community Partner: Spotlight Strategic Partners

An evening bringing together the people building, enabling, and investing in the future of cross-border finance.

Limited seats. Registration is subject to approval.

## IBW Future Asset Forum 2026

- Record: `ibw-official-future-asset-forum-2026`
- Source: [ibw-side-events.json](sources/ibw-side-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-01
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://indiablockchainweek.com/future-asset-forum>

### About the event

Hashed Emergent and Mugafi convene Future Asset Forum at Fairmont Mumbai on November 1 and 2, 2026, within India Blockchain Week. The invitation-only forum examines ownership and financing in sports, entertainment and media as AI changes production, localization and distribution. The page lists a 09:00 IST start and describes cross-registration with the Institutional Forum

Working program

The organizers plan 18 sessions and have published twelve working titles across four parts:

- Asset value: the financial limits of buying only successful titles; the different underwriting problems of franchises, catalogues and production slates; and the legal and commercial treatment of voice and likeness rights.
- Ownership and financing: debt-based participation, institutional investment in US leagues and Indian franchises, and financial instruments that could support these assets in India.
- Connecting the assets: a live look at disconnected fan datasets, the wider economics of a stadium event, and Indian law concerning provenance.
- Production and demand: AI's effect on production budgets, the business of physical venues and live attendance, and prospective buyers of these assets in 2031.

The proposed discussion format asks each panelist to commit in writing to sharing one previously unpublished figure in the room, off the record. Speaker names are published after the organizers receive written confirmation

Participation

Seats are allocated by participant category rather than sold as public tickets. The intended allocation is 40% rights holders and media operators, 20% AI and technology companies, 20% capital providers and family offices, 10% distribution and platforms, and 10% policy, legal and press participants. These are the organizers' allocation targets.

The planned participants include studio principals, franchise and league heads, catalogue owners, personality-rights lawyers, streaming and exhibition operators, venue and live-event businesses, ticketing and payments teams, fan-data platforms, AI companies, structured-finance specialists, insurers and institutional capital providers.

The [forum page](https://indiablockchainweek.com/future-asset-forum#apply) links applications for partners, sponsors and speakers. The stated process is an application followed by a 30-minute conversation about objectives and category fit, then a tailored proposal within a week. Partnership formats include keynote participation, panels or masterclasses, roundtables or workshops, and demonstrations on the partner floor; availability and pricing are by inquiry.

## IBW Institutional Forum

- Record: `ibw-official-ibw-institutional-forum-11-02`
- Source: [ibw-side-events.json](sources/ibw-side-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-01
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://www.indiablockchainweek.com/institutional-forum>
- Original page: <https://indiablockchainweek.com/institutional-forum/apply>

### About the event

Hashed Emergent convenes the IBW Institutional Forum at Fairmont Mumbai on November 1 and 2, 2026. This invitation-only, closed-door forum is a dedicated room within India Blockchain Week Conference, planned for 100 to 120 senior leaders. The format combines keynotes, expert panels and fireside conversations about institutional blockchain adoption.

The intended participants include Indian banks, NBFCs, payments and capital-markets firms, global financial institutions, enterprise technology and tokenization teams, regulators and policy advisers. The organizer seeks C-suite and director-level participants, including heads of digital assets or blockchain, technology and digital officers, payments and settlement leaders, and treasury and capital-markets product heads

Discussion areas

CBDCs and programmable money: conditional disbursements, offline payments and moving the programmable rupee beyond pilots.

Capital-markets infrastructure: DLT-based covenant monitoring and regulatory sandbox pilots.

Institutional DLT: production systems used by enterprise technology providers across Indian institutions.

AI and blockchain: autonomous agents and verifiable onchain infrastructure.

- Tokenization and real-world assets: fractional equities, tokenized funds, custody, infrastructure and applicable rules.
- Trade finance and settlement: letters of credit, e-way bills and cross-border settlement on shared systems.

Discussions follow the Chatham House Rule. Participants may use information from the room without identifying the speaker or their organization.

Attendance requires selection by the programming team. The [delegate application](https://indiablockchainweek.com/institutional-forum/apply) reserves seats for IBW2026 Priority, VIP and Executive VIP pass holders and asks applicants to buy their pass first. The team reviews each application and confirms participation by email. A qualifying pass does not itself secure a forum seat.

The organizer also accepts proposals to speak, partner or sponsor through the forum page. The names displayed as speakers from previous IBW editions are historical examples, not the forum's confirmed 2026 lineup.
