### About the event

SuperPioneros - Encuentro #139

Lunes 16 de noviembre - 17:30h

Madrid Innovation Lab - Madrid

Durante años hemos hablado de las posibilidades de Blockchain. Pero ahora que empresas, instituciones y desarrolladores empiezan a construir soluciones reales, surge una nueva pregunta:

¿Qué aporta realmente una Blockchain regulada frente a otras infraestructuras?

El próximo 16 de noviembre celebramos nuestro Encuentro #139 de SuperPioneros, donde reuniremos a empresas, instituciones, emprendedores y builders para debatir sobre el papel de las nuevas infraestructuras Blockchain L1 reguladas y las oportunidades que abren para el ecosistema.

Y lo haremos junto a ISBE, la iniciativa de Alastria para impulsar una infraestructura Blockchain pública permisionada, diseñada para facilitar el desarrollo de casos de uso empresariales

### LOS PROTAGONISTAS

Contaremos con:

Miguel Calero, Director Ejecutivo de ISBE, quien compartirá la visión del proyecto, su evolución y las oportunidades que ofrece a empresas y desarrolladores.

José Luis Cáceres, CEO de NWC10 y SuperPioneros, quien conducirá el encuentro y conectará el debate con los desafíos y oportunidades de nuestra Comunidad.

Próximamente anunciaremos nuevos invitados y empresas con casos de uso reales

### ¿DE QUÉ HABLAREMOS?

Queremos abrir una conversación que vaya más allá de la tecnología.

Blockchain regulada vs. otras infraestructuras. ¿Qué ventajas ofrece realmente y cuándo tiene sentido utilizarla?

Empresas e instituciones. ¿Qué necesitan para adoptar Blockchain con confianza y seguridad jurídica?

Tokenización y nuevos modelos de negocio. ¿Qué oportunidades aparecen para sectores como finanzas, inmobiliario, energía o industria?

Casos de uso reales. ¿Qué están construyendo las empresas y qué barreras encuentran para llevar sus proyectos a producción?

Talento y oportunidades. ¿Cómo conectar a las empresas que necesitan soluciones con los builders capaces de desarrollarlas?

No queremos únicamente escuchar presentaciones.

Queremos generar debate, compartir experiencias y descubrir qué podemos construir juntos

### DEL DEBATE A LA CONSTRUCCIÓN

Con Bit2Me como desafío número 1 de SuperPioneros, seguimos impulsando una Comunidad de más de 80.000 innovadores que conecta talento, empresas, instituciones e inversores alrededor de la IA, Blockchain, Web3 y las tecnologías emergentes.

A través de nuestros desafíos 444, queremos ayudar a que las empresas encuentren dentro de la Comunidad los recursos, conocimientos y conexiones necesarios para avanzar hacia sus objetivos durante los próximos cuatro meses.

Y este encuentro representa una oportunidad para conectar infraestructuras como ISBE con empresas que tienen necesidades reales y builders que quieren construir soluciones.

Porque el futuro de Blockchain no dependerá únicamente de la tecnología.

Dependerá de los problemas que seamos capaces de resolver con ella.

Lunes 16 de noviembre de 2026

17:30h

Madrid Innovation Lab - Madrid

¿Qué aporta una Blockchain regulada?

El 16 de noviembre abrimos el debate.

What if your 3D printer could do more than manufacture objects? What if it could mine Bitcoin at the same time?

Join us for a preview of Proof of Print (https://www.proof-of-print.com/), a new 3D printer that combines the power of 3D printing and Bitcoin mining. ## SC Ventures Lab Crawl Panel 4: Policy Rewiring: When AI Moves Money

- Record: `luma-crypto-omFX3gMHWVKnFST`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-17T05:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/obk2oqvj>

### About the event

About Event AI agents are no longer just recommending payments. With stablecoins and programmable rails, they can initiate and settle them too. That raises questions existing rules weren't written for. What should an agent be allowed to do on its own, when does a human need to approve, and who is accountable when something goes wrong? This session brings together banking, blockchain and regulatory perspectives to look at the permissions, oversight and safeguards needed before agents can be trusted to move real value. On th

:

From recommend to execute: what changes when an AI agent can actually move money

Delegated authority: spending limits, approved counterparties and the thresholds that should trigger human approval

Know your agent: how agents are identified, authenticated and tied back to the person or business they act for

When things go wrong: liability for errors, fraud or a compromised agent, and what happens when a stablecoin transaction can't be reversed

Compliance by design: building sanctions screening, AML checks and audit trails into the transaction itself

Are current rules fit for purpose, or does agentic finance need a new rulebook? Speakers:

Rohan Juneja, Product Director, Digital Assets, Standard Chartered Bank

Aishwary Gupta, Global Head of Business, Polygon

Grace Chong, Head, Financial Services Regulation, Drew & Napier

Kenneth Bok, Director, Digital Assets, SC Ventures (Moderator) This panel is one of several sessions at SC Ventures Lab Crawl, a full-day event. Subscribe to our calendar to see the full lineup and RSVP: https://luma.com/scventures

## Digital Assets Developments & Opportunities

- Record: `luma-crypto-cCUb419pwiogfrQ`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-17T07:00:00.000Z

### About the event

Two-Part Programme for Private Bankers and Family Office Practitioners in Asia Format: Two sessions of 90 minutes each The programme moves from "what's changing" to "what to do about it." Singapore and Hong Kong are the anchors, as the main booking centres and family office hubs for this audience, with Japan, the Gulf and other markets brought in where they matter to Asian clients

Part 1: The Global Tokenisation Landscape Title: From Pilot to Production: Markets, Infrastructure and Regulation in 2026 and beyond Tokenisation is moving from pilot projects into regulated commercial activity across several jurisdictions, marking an important inflection point for digital assets in 2026.

With Singapore and Hong Kong serving as key financial and family office hubs in Asia, developments in tokenised real-world assets, stablecoins and financial market infrastructure are creating new opportunities and considerations for financial institutions, private bankers, family offices and investors.  RHTLaw Asia invites you to join our industry and legal experts as we examine the global tokenisation landscape, focusing on the transition from experimentation to commercial implementation, and the regulatory, market and legal developments shaping its future

Key Discussion Topics 1. Global Policy Developments: The Industry View An examination of regulatory and policy developments across the United States, Singapore, Hong Kong and the UAE, including stablecoin legislation, tokenised securities and the growing need for cross-border regulatory recognition and interoperable standards. 2. Market and Infrastructure Reality Check A closer look at the rise of tokenised securities and institutional products, including tokenised investment funds and private credit.

The discussion will examine infrastructure choices, public versus permissioned blockchains, settlement systems, interoperability risks and the liquidity challenges facing tokenised private assets. 3. Legal Implications for Investors Tokenisation does not change the underlying legal character of an asset. We will examine the distinction between tokens representing direct ownership rights and synthetic exposure, together with the legal considerations and potential risks for issuers and investors.

4.  Panel Discussion and Q&A An interactive discussion bringing together industry and legal perspectives on the opportunities and challenges of tokenisation, and what these developments mean for the future of digital assets in Asia

Coming Up: Part 2. Tokenised Assets: The Investor's Playbook From Insight to Action: Access, Ownership, Risk and Legacy 3 December 2026 | 3:00 pm. 5:00 pm Building on the global developments covered in Part 1, the second session will focus on how private investors and family offices can participate in tokenised assets, including product structures, custody arrangements, investor protection, legal ownership, tax considerations and succession planning. From understanding what's changing to exploring what to do about it. We look forward to welcoming you.

### S. EQUITIES REGULATORY FORUM

NEW YORK Inaugural Global Launch Conference of WDAD. World Digital Asset Day AI REVOLUTION

### REGULATORY INNOVATION

INTELLIGENT HARDWARE Connecting Wall Street with Digital Finance. Bringing Together Global Technology and Capital Leaders. Exploring New Opportunities in Financial Innovation and the Digital Economy in the Age of Artificial Intelligence. THE GLOBAL FINANCIAL TRANSFORMATION Artificial Intelligence is reshaping the global economic and industrial landscape. Digital assets, stablecoins and Real-World Assets (RWA) are driving deeper integration between traditional financial systems and blockchain technology, while asset tokenization is creating new opportunities for global capital markets. Following the U.

S. midterm elections, global markets will continue to focus on developments in U.

S. economic policy, capital markets and the evolving regulatory framework for digital finance. Based in New York, one of the world's leading financial centers, this summit will bring together industry leaders, experts, scholars and innovative enterprises from the fields of finance, technology, investment and the digital economy to explore global economic trends in the age of AI, tokenized U.

S. equities, digital asset compliance and financial technology innovation. ABOUT WORLD DIGITAL ASSET DAY (WDAD) On January 3, 2009, the Bitcoin Genesis Block was created, marking a historic milestone in the evolution of digital assets. To commemorate this historic event and promote global digital asset education, industry collaboration, academic exchange and international dialogue, the World Digital Asset Day (WDAD) initiative proposes January 3 as an annual day of recognition and exchange for the global digital asset community.

This New York summit will officially launch WDAD's global outreach and international cooperation initiative, bringing together global industry organizations, technology companies, financial institutions and ecosystem partners to jointly advance innovation in digital assets and the global digital economy. KEY TOPICS 1. U.

S. Economic Policy and Global Capital Markets Following the Midterm Elections 2. The AI Revolution and the New Global Digital Economy 3. Tokenized U.

### About the event

About Event Geopolitical shifts are changing how capital, goods, data and talent move around the world. As markets fragment, new trade corridors are opening, cross-border commerce is changing shape, and traditional models of trade finance and financial intermediation are under pressure. This panel looks at how data, intelligent agents and new financing models can improve efficiency, visibility and trust across borders. It also covers how financial institutions, technology providers and policymakers can help businesses manage more complex trade ecosystems and build more resilient, connected economies. On th

:

Trade in a fragmented world: how geopolitics is redrawing trade corridors, and what that means for businesses and their financing

AI in trade finance: using data and intelligent agents to speed up documentation, credit decisions and risk assessment

Unlocking working capital: alternative financing models for suppliers and SMEs that traditional trade finance struggles to reach

Digital assets on the trade rails: where tokenisation and stablecoins can improve cross-border settlement and liquidity

Building trust across borders: data sharing, visibility and compliance when counterparties sit in different regulatory regimes

Funding regional connectivity: who finances the infrastructure behind the next generation of trade corridors Speakers:

Amelia Ng, CEO, Olea

Rachel Qiu, COO, HashKey

Madhivanan Periannan, CEO, TASConnect

Megha Gupta, Portfolio Management, SC Ventures (Moderator) This panel is one of several sessions at SC Ventures Lab Crawl, a full-day event. ## Hyperliquidとオンチェーンファイナンスの歴史

- Record: `luma-crypto-yMTLSDFnA7KsGZH`

### About the event

English follows Japanese 「あたらしい経済」と「KudasaiJP」が共同運営する企業向けWeb3コミュニティ「Web3 Business Hub（WBH）」では、Web3ビジネスの発展に参考となるセミナーを毎月開催しています。 11月のテーマは「Hyperliquidとオンチェーンファイナンスの歴史」です。 ブロックチェーンを活用した金融サービスは、BitcoinやEthereumの登場を経て、DEX、レンディング、ステーブルコイン、デリバティブなど、さまざまな領域へと発展してきました。特に2020年のDeFi Summer以降、スマートコントラクトによる金融機能の実装が急速に進み、従来の金融機関や中央集権的な取引所を介さない、新しい金融市場の可能性が示されてきました。 その進化を象徴するプロジェクトの一つが、オンチェーンのデリバティブ取引を中心に成長してきた Hyperliquid です。独自のLayer 1ブロックチェーン上で、高速な取引処理とオンチェーンのオーダーブックを実現し、従来の中央集権型取引所（CEX）に近い取引体験を提供することで、分散型金融の新たな可能性を切り拓いています。さらに、HyperEVMによるアプリケーションの拡張など、単なる取引プラットフォームを超えた金融エコシステムへの発展も注目されています。 一方で、オンチェーン金融の発展には、流動性の確保、価格形成、セキュリティ、分散性、ガバナンス、規制対応など、さまざまな課題も存在します。DeFiはこれまでの歴史の中で何を実現し、何を課題として残してきたのでしょうか。そしてHyperliquidのような新しいプラットフォームは、従来の金融市場や暗号資産取引所のあり方をどこまで変えるのでしょうか。 今回のWeb3 Business Hubでは、DeFiの誕生からDeFi Summer、DEXやオンチェーンデリバティブの進化、そしてHyperliquidの成長に至るまで、オンチェーン金融の歴史を振り返ります。あわせて、Hyperliquidの仕組みや成長の背景、既存の金融サービスとの違い、今後の事業機会と課題についても整理します。 金融サービスは、どこまでオンチェーンで実現できるのか。 Hyperliquidを通じて、オンチェーン金融の現在地と、金融機関・Web3事業者・一般企業にとっての新たな可能性を、ゲストの藤田氏と参加者の皆さまと一緒に考えます。 藤田拓也氏プロフィール Hyperliquid Japan 技術渉外 / SubEtha Founder 筑波大学社会工学類卒。HashHubでブロックチェーンエンジニアとして経験を積み、MycelやHiveFiなどのWeb3プロジェクトに参画。クロスチェーン、DeFi、AI×ブロックチェーン領域の開発に携わり、ETHGlobal、HackAtom、Colosseumなどのハッカソンで受賞。Cosmos JapanのAdminとしてコミュニティ運営に携わり、現在はHyperliquid JapanのAdmin・技術渉外として活動。自ら立ち上げたAIエージェント向けプライバシー決済プロトコル「SubEtha」では、代表としてプロダクト開発を進めている。 セミナー概要 Hyperliquidとオンチェーンファイナンスの歴史 日時：2026年11月18日（水）19:00 開場／19:30 開始（20:30〜ネットワーキング、21:30 イベント終了予定） 会場：幻冬舎3号館 3F Hub（WBH）」について「あたらしい経済」と「KudasaiJP」が共同運営する、企業向けWeb3コミュニティです。現在以下の会員限定コンテンツを企業様にご提供しております。ぜひご参加ください。 [実施内容] ・イベント開催（毎月1回以上/リアル or オンライン） ・ネットワーキングイベント開催（四半期毎/リアル） ・スポットコンサルティング機会の提供（毎月/指定日に参加いただける方） ・会員限定レポートの配信（毎月1本以上） ・「あたらしい経済」実施企画（記事・ポッドキャスト・YouTube）へ参加の優先案内（都度） ・「KudasaiJP」実施企画への参加の優先案内（都度） ▶ WBHの詳細・入会はこちら https://www.neweconomy.jp/wbh (https://www.neweconomy.jp/wbh) ▶WBHの過去のイベントやレポート https://www.neweconomy.jp/features/wbh ---- The "Web3 Business Hub (WBH)", a corporate-focused Web3 community jointly operated by Atarashii Keizai and KudasaiJP, hosts monthly seminars designed to provide practical insights for advancing Web3 business initiatives.

The theme for October is "Hyperliquid and the History of Onchain Finance" Blockchain-based financial services have evolved significantly since the emergence of Bitcoin and Ethereum, expanding into various areas such as decentralized exchanges (DEXs), lending, stablecoins, and derivatives. In particular, since DeFi Summer in 2020, the rapid development of smart contract-based financial applications has demonstrated the potential for new financial markets that operate without relying on traditional financial intermediaries or centralized exchanges.

One of the projects representing this evolution is Hyperliquid, which has gained significant attention through its focus on on-chain derivatives trading. Built on its own Layer 1 blockchain, Hyperliquid combines high-speed transaction processing with an on-chain order book, offering a trading experience comparable to that of centralized exchanges (CEXs) while exploring new possibilities for decentralized finance. With the expansion of its ecosystem through HyperEVM, Hyperliquid is also evolving beyond a trading platform into a broader on-chain financial ecosystem.

At the same time, the development of on-chain finance continues to face challenges, including liquidity, price discovery, security, decentralization, governance, and regulatory compliance. What has DeFi achieved throughout its history, and what challenges remain unresolved? To what extent can emerging platforms such as Hyperliquid transform traditional financial markets and the role of cryptocurrency exchanges? For this edition of Web3 Business Hub, we will explore the history of on-chain finance, from the early days of DeFi and DeFi Summer to the evolution of DEXs and on-chain derivatives, culminating in the rise of Hyperliquid.

We will also examine Hyperliquid's architecture, the factors behind its growth, how it differs from traditional financial services, and the opportunities and challenges that lie ahead. How much of the financial system can ultimately move on-chain? Through the lens of Hyperliquid, we will explore the current state and future potential of on-chain finance, as well as the new opportunities it may create for financial institutions, Web3 businesses, and enterprises.  Seminar Overview Hyperliquid and the History of Onchain Finance

### About the event

Penn Blockchain is hosting Tangem at Penn for an evening talk on The Rise of Crypto in the AI Era. AI agents are starting to transact, models are getting cheaper, and questions about who owns data and value keep getting louder. Jalon from Tangem will talk about where crypto fits in all of this, and why keeping control of your own keys and assets matters more now, not less. Tangem is a Swiss company that makes hardware wallets the size of a bank card. You tap the card to your phone to sign a transaction. ## REWIRED: A Forum on Stablecoins and Agentic Payments

- Record: `luma-crypto-79xnpm1WrGGSqxH`

### About the event

19 November 2026 - - 12:30-17:00 SGT

Lunch provided

Approval within 24 hours Feeling lucky? Several Fitbit Air trackers are up for grabs, plus the new Fitbit Edge, launched just weeks ago. Intro This year's Singapore FinTech Festival looks at the forces rewiring global finance. Payments is where that rewiring is most visible: AI agents are starting to spend real money, more of it settles in stablecoins, and the rails are arriving faster than the controls. REWIRED brings together the people building and running payments to work out what comes next:

Who authorises an agent to pay?

What stops the payment when the agent is compromised?

Where does the margin sit when software pays software? Speakers Featuring speakers from AWS, Visa, Mastercard, BVNK, BlockSec, FXC Intelligence, Sunrate and Cobo You make the calls

Run the incident. MAS's SAFR framework proposes that no agent action executes until it has been declared, authorised and assessed. Test that idea on a live case: an agent with payment authority has been manipulated and transfers are queued. Vote on what stops the money, then put the panel on the spot.

Pick the rails. Card networks are piloting agent checkout across APAC, and Visa already settles in stablecoins at a US$7 billion annualised run rate. Cards, stablecoins or both: argue who owns checkout when the buyer is software.

Settle the bank question. Everyone agrees you need a bank to cash out. Beyond that, decide whether banks still own anything when agents pay: programmable money, accountability for the agent, or 24/7 settlement. Ask in English or Chinese on Slido at any time.

Who should attend Anyone building, running or investing in payments, stablecoins or AI-driven commerce. Agenda (SGT)

### About the event

As quantum computing accelerates toward cryptographically relevant milestones, the digital asset ecosystem faces an architectural reckoning. Public blockchains like Ethereum are charting multi-year post-quantum cryptography (PQC) roadmaps and custody providers are testing PQC in practice, but protecting distributed ledgers, critical infrastructure and cross-border digital economies requires coordinated action across industry, regulators and government agencies. This afternoon brings them into one room.

We open with Project Eagle, a live PQC pilot co-led by Safeheron and the Responsible Fintech Institute, in which banks and regulators across multiple jurisdictions test quantum-resistant multi-party computation (MPC) signing on a public testnet. A panel of leaders from law, law enforcement technology, smart-city jurisdictions and quantum security then examines signature scheme migration, systemic risks to custody and key management, and the public-private standards needed before Q-Day. We close with Ethereum's post-quantum roadmap and what it means for institutions, followed by networking.

## Designing Trust in the Digital Economy

- Record: `luma-crypto-CNZg5fqDLOWqAgl`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-20T10:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/xk2rbumg>

### About the event

Introduction As AI reshapes how we build, create, and transact, trust has become the currency that matters most.

Join us for an event on using AI to build trust across the new money era, content, and AI itself with keynotes, a hands-on AI skills challenge, and networking to wrap up the evenin

: Keynote talks from industry voices Live Q&A with speakers Community networkin

Speakers Peter Zheng is Head of Design at OKX, where his team designs the products more than 120 million customers use to trade, pay and save. Over 20 years, his career has taken him from East to West, through agencies including W+K, TBWA\Media Arts Lab and Ogilvy, and in-house at Google, Samsung and Meta. Working across cultures has taught him that good ideas start with listening. As AI changes how products get made, he is helping his team move from designing screens to designing systems, with people at the center. Topic Intro: More of our financial lives now happen on a phone, at any hour, and soon with AI doing some of the work for us.

None of that matters if people don't feel safe enough to use it. Crypto gave us new ways to prove things. Anyone can check a transaction on a blockchain, and exchanges publish reports showing they hold customers' funds. Yet people still hesitate before they hit "confirm." Proof and protection are different things, and design has to close the distance between them. In this session, Peter shares how OKX designs for trust, from showing people how they're protected to helping them understand what they're agreeing to before it's final. He'll also look at what changes when we start handing some of those decisions to an AI agent.

Pearly Tan is Content Systems Director at OKX, where she is leading the shift from content design as a service to content as a scalable system for global digital products. She previously led Global Content Design at OKX and led the build of award-winning experiences across Meta Reality Labs, TikTok Shop and Bank of Singapore. Topic intro: As digital products expand, users face more opportunities, choices and information. They also face more uncertainty, emotion and risk. Trust must be built throughout the experience, especially when people are deciding whether to explore, act, or ask for help.

Doing this at scale requires a shift from relying on specialists for every decision to building systems that make trustworthy choices easier across the organisation. This session explores how content systems can: Give users the information they need, when they need it Build trust with transparency that is relevant and proportionate Direct expertise to moments where uncertainty carries real consequences Help every team make sound, responsible decisions at scale Pearly will discuss OKX's content transformation and how AI-enabled systems can help more people become responsible trust builders.

Ben Bowes is the Director of Product Design at Open Government Products (OGP), where he helps teams make government products effective, enjoyable and worthy of people's trust. He thinks public service is where the best designers belong, making everyday life better for the people around them. As AI reshapes how we build and create, Ben believes people must remain at the heart of what we design and why. Topic intro: When AI can make almost anything look and sound convincing, how do we know what's real and who to trust? From everyday encounters to government services, design shapes how trust is built, tested and sometimes exploited.

With so much uncertainty, how can public institutions earn our trust?  Maybe a little doubt is part of what makes trust possible

Who should attend Designers who are curious about how AI is reshaping trust in technolog

### Event info

Registration: RSVP required (limited capacity)

Location: 12 Marina Boulevard, Marina Bay Financial Centre #13, Singapore 018982.

围绕 Agentic Economy,邀请正在探索 Agentic 商业实践、Stable Payment、Onchain Finance 乃至做 GEO 和 Growth 的小伙伴都聚到一起。 上麦分享,台下畅聊。 你也可以来听听别人为什么这样做,交换一个视角,认识几个不同方向的同行。正在构建的东西可以在这里得到新的反馈。 下一次合作,甚至一个还没开始的项目,也可能从这里的一段聊天开始。 欢迎自荐上麦,也欢迎推荐你觉得应该被听见的人。 选择你的参与方式: > Speaker Ticket: 分享你的业务、产品、想法,以及背后的经历、选择和吐槽。 > Audience Ticket: 来听故事、聊业务、交换想法、认识同行。台下的交流,同样是这场聚会的重要部分。 带上你的 Backstory,也来认识下一段故事里的同行的小伙伴

由 MoneyinMotion (https://x.com/moneyinmotion26) × ACTUALLY YOU KNOW (https://x.com/ActuallyUKnow) 联合主办,感谢 WIDTH (https://x.com/WidthGRC)与 DogPay (https://x.com/DogPay_) 对新加坡专场的鼎力支持。 Where Builders Take The Mic. Some of the things that matter most are hard to explain at first. No polished deck. No grand narrative. And no place for them on the usual stages. But the demand is real. And so are the users. So we're setting up a stage of our own: 草台 (Caotai). Share an honest take, something you're building, a lesson learned the hard way, or an opportunity you think others haven't spotted yet. You don't have to tell the whole story. You don't have to have it all figured out. Just keep it real.

This edition of 草台 Open Mic explores the Agentic Economy, bringing together people working on agentic business applications, Stable Payment, Onchain Finance, and GEO and Growth. Come share the business or product you're working on, along with a story behind it: a key decision, an unexpected discovery, some trial and error, or something you still want to vent about. Share onstage. Chat offstage. You're also welcome to come and listen, hear why others made the choices they did, swap perspectives, and meet people working in different fields.

You (https://fields.You) can get fresh feedback on what you're building. Your next collaboration - or a project you haven't started yet - could begin with a conversation here. Put yourself forward to speak, or recommend someone you think deserves to be heard. be part of what comes next.

As Singapore Blockchain Week draws to a close, BAMBITZ (https://bambitz.io/), together with its partners, invites the community to celebrate an inspiring week of innovation, collaboration, and new opportunities.

### About the event

Wie is Satoshi Nakamoto? Het is een van de grootste onopgeloste raadsels van onze tijd, en op zaterdag 21 november duiken we er samen in. De Dutch Bitcoin Embassy nodigt je uit voor een besloten vertoning van Finding Satoshi in Flora Filmtheater in Den Haag, met popcorn bij de film en een borrel na afloop

Over de film Finding Satoshi (2026) volgt onderzoeksjournalist William D. Cohan en privédetective Tyler Maroney tijdens een forensisch onderzoek van vier jaar naar de herkomst van Bitcoin. Onderweg spreken ze mensen uit het hart van de sector, onder wie Michael Saylor en Joseph Lubin. De film gaat net zo goed over de ideeën achter Bitcoin als over de vraag wie het heeft bedacht. Regie: Matthew Miele en Tucker Tooley - 101 minuten - Engels gesproke

Wat is inbegrepen Toegang tot de besloten vertoning in de filmzaal van Flora Popcorn bij de film Borrel na afloop met twee drankjes Een middag met Bitcoiners, ondernemers en nieuwsgierigen Popcorn en drankjes worden je aangeboden door onze sponsor Blockrise

Programma 13.30 uur: inloop 14.00 uur: welkom en start film Rond 15.45 uur: einde film Aansluitend: borrel bij Flora, tot ongeveer 17.30 uu

Voor wie Voor iedereen: of je al jaren in Bitcoin zit, net begint of gewoon nieuwsgierig bent. Na de aftiteling praten we verder tijdens de borrel. Neem gerust iemand mee

Praktisch Flora Filmtheater, De Constant Rebecquestraat 55, Den Haag (Regentessekwartier). Openbaar vervoer: RandstadRail 3 en tram 11 op vijf minuten lopen, RandstadRail 4 op tien minuten. Parkeren kan in de wijk en je fiets zet je voor de deur. De film start stipt om 14.00 uur, dus kom op tijd

Tickets Early Bird €35 - Regulier €42 Inclusief film, popcorn en twee drankjes. De zaal telt 50 stoelen, dus wees er op tijd bij

Over de Dutch Bitcoin Embassy De Dutch Bitcoin Embassy brengt ondernemers, bouwers en nieuwsgierigen rond Bitcoin samen in Den Haag. Na de uitverkochte vertoning van DirtyCoin in 2025 is dit onze tweede filmmiddag. We kijken ernaar uit je (weer) te zien. Vragen? Mail info@dutchbitcoinembassy.co

In English Private screening of Finding Satoshi, followed by drinks. Saturday 21 November 2026, doors 13:30, film starts 14:00, Flora Filmtheater, The Hague. The film is in English. Your ticket includes the screening, popcorn and two drinks at the reception afterwards, courtesy of our sponsor Blockrise.

Web3DC hosts a community discussion focused on the state of American crypto policy, the evolving regulatory landscape, and what the digital asset ecosystem can expect heading into the next legislative cycle.

As Washington prepares for a new Congress, builders, investors, entrepreneurs, and industry leaders need to understand where federal policy stands, what's changing, and what opportunities lie ahead.

This session offers a plain-English breakdown of U.

S. crypto policy, with practical insights into legislation, regulatory developments, and the broader implications for innovation, investment, and adoption.

Expect an interactive format featuring policy updates, industry perspectives, networking, and an open Q&A. Our goal is to connect the dots between Washington's policy decisions and the businesses building the future of digital assets.

Topics Covered

The State of U.

S. Crypto Policy: Where digital asset legislation and regulation stand today.

The CLARITY Act & Companion Legislation: Legislative developments and what comes next.

SEC & CFTC Oversight: Understanding regulatory jurisdiction and its implications for the industry.

The Post-Election Landscape: What the next Congress could mean for digital asset policy in 2027.

Stablecoins, DeFi & Tokenization: How policy developments could shape innovation and institutional adoption.

The DMV Opportunity: What Washington, D.

C., Maryland, and Virginia builders, investors, and businesses should be paying attention to.

### Event Details

When: Monday, November 23, 2026 Time: To be announced (ET) Where: Bronson BierHall, Arlington, VA Cost: Free, registration required Hosted by: Web3DC

### Who Should Attend?

Innovators, Ai founders, investors, policymakers, legal professionals, fintech operators, entrepreneurs, and anyone interested in understanding how Washington's decisions could shape the future of digital assets.

No political spin. No unnecessary jargon. Just meaningful conversations, informed perspectives, and actionable insights.

Join Web3DC as we connect policy, capital, technology, and community to help shape the next chapter of digital asset innovation.

Light food and refreshments provided.

- Starts: 2026-11-24T05:00:00.000Z

### About the event

As digital assets transition from pilot experiments (STOs and RWAs) into institutional finance, KYC and AML compliance are no longer merely back-office burdens - they are the core trust infrastructure and prerequisites for new business. Ahead of South Korea's full implementation of the Travel Rule (effective February 2027) - which lowers exemption thresholds and tightens rules on unhosted wallets and cross-border transfers - this seminar brings together regulators, law enforcement, financial institutions, and global tech leaders to bridge statutory requirements with operational industry practice. Event Highlights

Legislative Challenges & Risk Control

Legal issues in the full implementation of the Travel Rule and risk-based control practices for strengthening financial governance

Global Infrastructure & Tech Demonstration

Sumsub's compliance model supporting 2,000+ global clients and a remittance PoC case study integrating foreign national KYC

Public-Private Joint Panel Discussion

Strategies for operationalizing regulatory requirements into industry practice, featuring regulatory authorities, law enforcement, Korean financial institutions, and global experts

## 実用の先へ、安全とともに。ーAI・デジタルアセット・サイバーセキュリティの現在地ー

### ーAI・デジタルアセット・サイバーセキュリティの現在地ー

AIやデジタルアセットの活用が加速する中、テクノロジーの進化を支える「サイバーセキュリティ」の重要性が改めて問われています。

利便性や効率性、新たなビジネス機会を追求する一方で、サイバーリスクへの対応、デジタル資産の保護、そして社会やユーザーからの信頼をどのように確保していくのか。これらは、テクノロジーを実社会で活用していくうえで避けては通れないテーマです。

本イベントでは、AIとデジタルアセットの最前線を見据え、サイバーセキュリティを取り巻く現状や課題、今後求められる考え方について議論します。

技術の進化を一過性のトレンドで終わらせず、安全で持続可能な活用へ。

そのために必要な視点を共有する機会をお届けします。

◾イベント概要

- 主催: Gate Japan株式会社
- 共催: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
- 日時：11月24日(火)18:00-20:30 （開場は17:45）
- 会場: Gate Japan オフィス (東京)
- 形式: Keynote speech/パネルディスカッション
- 完全招待制 (事前登録および当日に本人確認あり)
- 運営ポリシー: 発言内容の引用は可能ですが、発言者及び所属組織を特定できる形での引用は禁止します。録画・録音・ライブ配信は行いません。

◾共催企業について

Amazon Web Services（AWS）は、世界で最も包括的かつ幅広く採用されているクラウドサービスです。世界有数の取引所、ブロックチェーンプロトコル、Web3分野の開発者から信頼され、安全性、拡張性、可用性に優れたインフラストラクチャを提供しています。

ノードのホスティングやブロックチェーンデータの管理から、生成AIや自律型AIエージェントまで、AWSはWeb3分野のイノベーターが開発を加速し、グローバルに事業を拡大するとともに、最高水準のセキュリティおよびコンプライアンス基準を満たせるよう支援しています。

◾タイムテーブル

17:45-18:15　受付・ウェルカムドリンク

18:15-18:25　開会挨拶(Gate JapanおよびAWS)

18:45-19:00　セッション①：「AIの矛」に対抗する「AIの盾」――非対称な攻防の時代における決済セキュリティ／Netstars - Chuck Chen - CTO

19:00-19:15　セッション②：63億ドル規模のハッキング事件の全貌：国家支援型のサイバー脅威への防御／Fireblocks - 牧野剛 - Sales Director

セッション終了後には、ご参加の皆さま同士の交流をお楽しみいただけるネットワーキングタイムをご用意しております。

厳選したワインをはじめ、Thanksgiving Dayにちなんだローストチキンや彩り豊かなオードブルなど、さまざまなお料理やお飲み物をご用意いたします。

美味しいお食事とともに、登壇者や参加者の皆さまと交流を深め、新たなつながりやビジネスの可能性が生まれるひとときをお楽しみください。

### ーThe State of AI, Digital Assets, and Securityー

As the adoption of AI and digital assets continues to accelerate, the importance of security as a foundation for technological progress is coming increasingly into focus.

While businesses pursue greater convenience, efficiency, and new opportunities, critical questions remain: How can we address evolving cyber risks, safeguard digital assets, and maintain the trust of society and users? These are essential challenges that cannot be overlooked as emerging technologies become part of our everyday lives and business operations.

In this event, we will explore the forefront of AI and digital assets, examining the current security landscape, the challenges we face, and the perspectives needed to navigate the future.

Moving beyond technological trends toward safe and sustainable adoption.

Join us as we share insights and perspectives on what it takes to build a more secure digital future.

◾ Event Overview

Organizer: Gate Japan K.K.

Co-host: Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Date & Time: Tuesday, November 24, 18:00 - 20:30 (Doors open at 17:45)

Venue: Gate Japan Office (Tokyo)

Format: Keynote Speech / Panel Discussions

Admission: Invitation only (Advance registration and ID verification required upon entry)

Event Policy: Non-attribution policy (Quotations of remarks are permitted, but speakers' identities and affiliations must not be disclosed). No recording, live streaming, or broadcasting will be conducted.

◾Co-host Introduction

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud, trusted by leading exchanges, blockchain protocols, and Web3 builders to run secure, scalable, and highly available infrastructure. From node hosting and blockchain data to generative and agentic AI, AWS helps Web3 innovators build faster, scale globally, and meet the highest standards of security and compliance.

◾ Networking Reception

Following the sessions, we invite you to join us for a networking reception, offering an opportunity to connect and exchange ideas with fellow attendees.

Enjoy great food and drinks while connecting with our speakers and fellow attendees, building new relationships, and exploring potential business opportunities.

### GIWA GASOK NIGHT

Five Projects. One Ecosystem. One Night.

GIWA 생태계를 만들어가는 다섯 프로젝트가 한자리에 모입니다!

### CALLPUT × GIWATER × AMMORA × STEPUP × GIWA ECO

트레이딩부터 DeFi, 온체인 유동성, Web3 라이프스타일, 생태계 커뮤니티까지.

GIWA 위에서 새로운 가능성을 만들어가는 다섯 팀이 GIWA GASOK NIGHT에서 여러분을 만납니다.

프로젝트를 직접 만든 빌더들의 이야기, 현장에서 즐기는 인터랙티브 프로그램, 그리고 GIWA 커뮤니티와 함께하는 네트워킹까지!

GIWA의 현재를 만나고, 다음을 함께 만들어갈 밤.

Whether you're a builder, trader, degen, or simply curious about Web3, join us for a night celebrating the growing GIWA ecosystem.

### Meet the Projects

CALLPUT (https://giwa.callput.app/)

CALLPUT은 주식, ETF, 암호화폐 등 다양한 자산을 대상으로 온체인 옵션 및 예측 거래 경험을 제공하는 트레이딩 플랫폼입니다.

복잡한 금융시장에 보다 직관적으로 접근할 수 있도록 설계된 CALLPUT을 통해, 기존 금융자산과 온체인 트레이딩이 만나는 새로운 방식을 만나보세요.

Official X: https://x.com/CallPutApp

GIWATER (https://www.giwater.finance/)

GIWATER는 GIWA 생태계의 온체인 유동성 인프라를 구축하는 DeFi 플랫폼입니다.

자산 스왑부터 유동성 공급, 수익 전략, 포트폴리오 관리까지 하나의 플랫폼에서 연결하며, GIWA에서 자산이 더욱 자유롭고 효율적으로 움직이는 환경을 만들어갑니다.

Official X: https://x.com/GiwaterFinance

AMMORA (https://ammora.org/)

Ammora는 GIWA 생태계에서 토큰 발행과 거래, 유동성 공급을 지원하는 DeFi 프로젝트입니다.

개발자와 프로젝트는 Ammora SDK로 토큰을 발행하거나 런치패드-거래 서비스를 구축할 수 있으며, 이용자는 토큰 거래와 유동성 공급에 참여할 수 있습니다.

Official X: https://x.com/AmmoraHQ

### STEPUP

STEPUP은 일상 속 움직임과 블록체인을 연결하는 GIWA 기반 Web3 러닝 플랫폼입니다.

사용자의 달리기 활동을 디지털 리워드 경험으로 연결하며, 누구나 일상생활에서 자연스럽게 Web3를 경험할 수 있는 서비스를 만들어갑니다.

DeFi와 트레이딩을 넘어, 블록체인이 우리의 일상 속으로 들어오는 새로운 방식을 STEPUP과 함께 만나보세요.

Official X: https://x.com/GiwaStepUp

GIWA ECO (https://giwa.eco/)

GIWA ECO는 GIWA 생태계의 프로젝트와 활동을 한곳에서 발견할 수 있도록 돕는 커뮤니티 플랫폼입니다.

### About the event

Toronto Blockchain Week 2026 is one of Canada's premier gatherings for digital assets, institutional finance, and Web3 technology, taking place November 24-25, 2026 in Toronto, Ontario. Over two days, the summit unites leaders from finance, government, policy, blockchain infrastructure, and venture capital.

### Tuesday, November 24. Digital Asset Summit

- **Time:** 9:00 AM. 5:00 PM EST
- **Focus:** A full-day summit bringing together decision-makers from government, financial institutions, capital markets, and the digital asset industry.
- **Key Themes:** Stablecoin adoption, real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, regulatory frameworks, cross-border payments, and institutional market infrastructure.

### Tuesday Evening. VIP Executive Dinner

- **Audience:** An exclusive evening for speakers, sponsors, institutional investors, and ecosystem executives to connect and discuss strategic market initiatives.
- **Access:** Included with VIP conference passes.

### Wednesday, November 25. Build The Future Canada

- **Time:** 9:00 AM. 5:00 PM EST
- **Focus:** A dedicated builder day shifting the spotlight to the founders, protocol engineers, and developers creating next-generation architectures.
- **Key Themes:** Blockchain infrastructure, on-chain AI agents, DeFi protocols, smart contract security, and venture capital financing for early-stage Web3 startups.

### Why Attend

Toronto Blockchain Week provides an essential forum for builders, institutional investors, and policymakers navigating Canada's evolving digital financial landscape. Attendees gain direct access to regulatory dialogues, high-signal developer networking, and emerging technology showcases across Canadian and global ecosystems.

### About the event

Ideas, conexiones y oportunidades alrededor de una mesa

Martes 24 de noviembre - 20:00-22:00 h Madrid - Almagro Plazas limitadas - Acceso bajo aprobación

¿Qué ocurre cuando reunimos alrededor de una mesa a personas que están construyendo el futuro de la Inteligencia Artificial, Blockchain y Cripto?

El próximo 24 de noviembre organizamos una nueva experiencia presencial de SuperPioneros en Madrid: una cena de fundadores, emprendedores y builders que están desarrollando ideas, proyectos y empresas alrededor de las tecnologías disruptivas.

Esta vez cambiamos el escenario.

Sin escenario, sin ponencias y sin presentaciones comerciales.

Solo una mesa, buenas conversaciones y personas con ganas de construir.

### ¿CÓMO FUNCIONARÁ?

Queremos que todos los participantes tengan la oportunidad de conocerse y descubrir posibles sinergias.

Conoce a los demás fundadores. Cada participante compartirá brevemente quién es, qué está construyendo y qué necesita para avanzar.

Descubre proyectos e ideas. Conoceremos iniciativas relacionadas con IA, Blockchain, Cripto y otras tecnologías emergentes.

Encuentra oportunidades. Buscaremos conexiones entre talento, proyectos, empresas e inversores que puedan ayudarse mutuamente.

Conecta con los VIP de SuperPioneros. Participarán miembros de nuestra Comunidad que ya están impulsando sus propios desafíos y construyendo nuevas soluciones.

### ¿A QUIÉN VA DIRIGIDA?

A fundadores, emprendedores, profesionales e inversores interesados en participar activamente en el ecosistema de innovación.

Especialmente a quienes:

Están construyendo una startup o desarrollando una idea.

- Trabajan en proyectos de Inteligencia Artificial, Blockchain o Cripto.
- Buscan talento, colaboradores, clientes o socios.
- Quieren conocer a otros fundadores y compartir experiencias.
- Forman parte de SuperPioneros y desean acelerar sus desafíos.

No importa tanto el tamaño de tu proyecto como tus ganas de construir y colaborar.

### UNA CENA, MUCHAS OPORTUNIDADES

En SuperPioneros creemos que las mejores conexiones aparecen cuando compartimos nuestros desafíos con las personas adecuadas.

Por eso organizamos este encuentro en un formato reducido, donde todos puedan conversar y participar.

Queremos que cada asistente termine la cena habiendo conocido a nuevas personas y descubierto al menos una oportunidad para avanzar en su proyecto.

### INSCRIPCIONES

Miembros VIP SuperPioneros: 35 €

No miembros: 55 €

Las plazas son muy limitadas y todas las solicitudes estarán sujetas a aprobación, buscando reunir perfiles complementarios y favorecer las oportunidades de colaboración.

Martes 24 de noviembre de 2026 20:00-22:00 h Madrid - Almagro

¿Con quién te gustaría sentarte a cenar para acelerar tu próximo gran proyecto?

## WhitePaper Reading Taipei #5 - Road to Hegota Upgrade

- Record: `luma-crypto-im1Rjs7hJPKwAMz`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-25T10:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/4ynxok99>

### About the event

🇹🇼 Whitepaper Reading Club 台北・第五場來了!

之前我們讀過 EF Mandate,聊「抗審查」為什麼是以太坊的底線。這次我們把鏡頭拉近到協議本身:接下來的升級,以太坊打算怎麼重新設計「誰來出塊」

主題:從 ePBS 到 FOCIL:以太坊前進 Hegota 之路

為什麼是現在: 今天以太坊大多數區塊,是透過鏈下 relay 交給少數 builder 打包的。

即將到來的 Glamsterdam 升級,主角是 ePBS(EIP-7732):把 proposer 和 builder 之間的交接直接寫進協議,不再需要信任中間的 relay。

下一個升級 Hegotá,主角則是 FOCIL(EIP-7805):由驗證者委員會指定「必須上鏈」的交易,builder 不照做,區塊就拿不到支持。EF 已把它列為 must ship,寧可延後整個升級也不拿掉。

一個把 builder 收進協議,一個限制 builder 不能審查。這晚,我們把兩者放在一起讀。

Discussion Lead:Nic Lin Protocol Researcher | Smart Contract Engineer 專注 L2、MEV 與安全協議設計,參與過帳戶抽象、Rollup、MEV aware DEX 等以太坊核心基礎設施,持續發表研究並參與開源工具開發,也常在全球以太坊大會分享。目前正在探索 universal account、L1/L2 互通性,以及抗審查。

這晚我們會一起辯論:

ePBS 拿掉了對 relay 的信任,但 MEV 和 builder 集中的問題真的解決了嗎?還是只是換個地方集中? ePBS 和 FOCIL 怎麼搭配?如果只有其中一個,以太坊會長什麼樣子? 當初 ePBS 先上、FOCIL 排到下一輪,這個先後順序合理嗎? Hegotá 另一個主角 Frame Transactions 把帳戶抽象寫進協議,對錢包和用戶體驗意味著什麼? 終極問題:協議該把多少權力從 builder 手上拿回來?抗審查值得讓整個 roadmap 等它嗎?

活動流程

活動前會先發研究資料,讓大家提前閱讀!現場也會提供整理好的 1 至 2 頁 summary,幫你快速抓住重點!

當天大家會圍坐成一圈,由 moderator 帶大家討論~不過更多的學習、洞見與精華,往往是在彼此交流的過程中迸出來的,那才是最好玩的部分!

特別感謝 White Paper Reading Club、台北以太坊社群協助舉辦,以及 imToken 提供場地支持

誠摯邀請大家一起來這場 nerdy night

什麼是 Whitepaper Reading Club(WPRC)? 一個聚集 800+ builders、engineers、researchers 的全球社群,橫跨 Singapore、Kuala Lumpur、San Francisco、Lagos、Bangkok、New York,每月聚在一起,圓桌式硬啃最新的 blockchain 項目和研究論文!

WPRC 獨立於任何生態,三年來活動完全由會員支持,已主持超過 100 場閱讀會。

Luma:luma.com/whitepaper X Twitter:@WPReadingClub ▶ YouTube:WhitepaperReadingClub

*This event will be conducted mainly in Chinese, but everyone is warmly welcome to join!

- Record: `luma-crypto-zLGm4NrGbR5C2zT`

### About the event

Most decentralized exchanges rely on Automated Market Makers (AMMs) as traditional central limit order books (CLOBs) are difficult & expensive to run on-chain (high gas fees, slow block times), and latency make real-time order matching impractical on general-purpose blockchains.

We disucss how Hyperliquid solves these architectural bottlenecks from the ground up. We'll explore its:

Custom Layer-1 design, the HyperBFT consensus mechanism

- How it achieves CEX-level throughput and sub-second finality without sacrificing self-custody
- The mechanics behind its protocol-native liquidity vaults (HLP).

Whether you're a DeFi builder, trader, or systems enthusiast, join us for a deep dive into the engineering trade-offs making fully on-chain order books possible.

Paper / source: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1kpeQYXjkeouIyhzwbsgggqatEXT0MV7R8VCLmLmmxlI/edit?usp=sharing

### Format

Moderator-led discussion with no promotions.

- Short introduction and context setting to start.
- A short walkthrough of the paper and its key ideas.
- Questions and discussion grounded in the original source.

### Session Guides - David Kurniawan (Sr. Product Manager D3Labs)

A Senior Product Manager at D3 Labs, where he oversees the company's blockchain and its connections to other networks. He previously led product at Delman and was the head of product. He holds an MBA from INSEAD, a master's in information systems management from Carnegie Mellon University, and a bachelor's in mechatronics engineering from Swiss German University.

### About Whitepaper Reading Club

We are a community of founders, researchers, and builders across Singapore, Malaysia, San Francisco, Bangkok, New York, Lagos, Taipei, and Hong Kong. We meet in person every month to read, discuss, and pressure-test the latest blockchain papers, protocols, and technical ideas.

Learn more: Website (https://wprc.club) - Summaries (https://www.wprc.club/papers) - Calendar (https://luma.com/whitepaper)

We create detailed, easy-to-understand summaries for each paper and have held 80+ sessions since June 2023, covering Account Abstraction, Parallel Chains, EIPs, the Bitcoin ecosystem, and AI x Crypto. We are ecosystem-agnostic, not for profit, and focused on projects with technical, product, or social innovation.

### Meet the Czech Solana Builders

3 Teams. 3 Ideas. One Solana Community.

The Czech Solana ecosystem is growing, and there's a lot more happening locally than you might think!

Next Wednesday, we're bringing together three Czech teams that participated in the Colosseum Hackathon to introduce their projects, share what they're building and connect with the SolanaCZE community.

From financing real-world robotics to automated DeFi portfolios and new approaches to managing financial risk, we'll explore three very different use cases for Solana.

Meet the Teams

Uptime Robotics Finance (URF)

Bringing real-world robotics financing on-chain. URF enables investors to pool USDC on Solana to finance robot fleets, with repayments coming from robotics operators' customer contracts.

Markowitz Finance

Automated portfolio management on Solana. Build diversified portfolios, choose your own asset weights or use a portfolio optimizer, and earn trading fees while your portfolio automatically rebalances. https://markowitz.finance/

Resu Protocol

A new approach to DeFi risk and yield. Resu lets users choose their risk exposure through Junior, Middle and Senior tiers, with different levels of protection and potential returns.

### What to Expect

Each team will introduce their project, explain the problem they're solving and share their experience building in the Solana ecosystem.

After the presentations, we'll have an open Q&A, discussions, drinks and plenty of time to connect with the founders and other community members.

J.

R. Mahon's Public House & Brewery, Dublin Wednesday, 25th November 6:00-9:00pm onwards

The fund stays the same. The rails don't.

Money market funds sit at the centre of how institutions manage cash. They're also where tokenisation is gaining real traction: same product, same regulation, new ways to issue, hold, settle and move fund shares.

The real shift is distribution. Reach new investor segments, offer 24/7 liquidity and enable re-use of fund shares.

Our last Dublin evening opened the conversation on tokenisation. This time we go a layer deeper, into one of the fastest-moving corners of the funds industry.

What's happening

No slides. After a quick intro, Pete Townsend (Norio Ventures) and Ian Mitchell are joined by Ruth Fairclough from Irish Funds and another special guest, to be announced, for a 15-20 minute chat on where tokenised funds are heading.

After that, the night is yours. Networking, catching up & the conversations that run on at the bar.

If you work in funds, asset management, fund admin, custody, compliance, ops, tech or professional services, this one's for you. The same goes for the crypto OGs who were onchain long before it became a funds conversation, and for anyone curious and a little sceptical.

You don't need a background in any of this to follow the conversation.

Powered by CryptoMondays Ireland, part of a global grassroots community for people who care about the future of money, technology & ownership. Founders meet fund managers. Innovators meet institutions. Builders meet boardrooms.

- Record: `luma-crypto-UBy8TpgwCahoaN7`

### About the event

BNB Chain is developing a next-generation, high-performance EVM-compatible Layer 1 designed for high-frequency trading, real-time payments, privacy, and AI agents.

Goal: 100,000+ TPS, sub-second finality, and approximately 20ms transaction pre-confirmation, the new architecture aims to push blockchain performance closer to centralized systems while preserving on-chain execution.

What We'll Discuss: Privacy through native shielded transactions using zero-knowledge proofs. We'll explore the proposed architecture, challenge its design decisions, and discuss its potential implications for the broader blockchain ecosystem.

Components of the New L1 chain:

Architecture & Consensus: Enhanced Parlia, BLS fast finality, and asynchronous execution.

Performance: Parallel EVM execution, 200ms block intervals, and LtHash-based storage.

Transaction Ordering: Pre-confirmations, direct-to-proposer transaction routing, and Multi-Lane reserved capacity.

Native Account Abstraction: Gas sponsorship, session keys, passkeys, and transaction batching.

The Bigger Picture: Why build another L1 instead of scaling BSC? What are the technical trade-offs?

Who Should Join? Everyone is welcome, from curious beginners to experienced Web3 developers. No presentation required, just bring your curiosity, questions, and perspectives!

Reading Material:

Main Docs: https://docs.bnbchain.org/newl1/

Forum: https://forum.bnbchain.org/t/introducing-the-new-l1-native-privacy-layer/5481

### Format

Moderator-led discussion with no promotions.

- Short introduction and context setting to start.
- A short walkthrough of the paper and its key ideas.
- Questions and discussion grounded in the original source.

### Session Guides

Sky is a blockchain tech founder and BNB Chain DevRel Ambassador based in Kuala Lumpur.

He co-founded YOLO Protocol, supported by Uniswap and Base, and GIVE Protocol, supported by Bybit's Blockchain for Good Alliance. He is currently building PAYtience, a Solana-based trading platform.

He also leads the Whitepaper Nerd Club, bringing curious minds together to explore blockchain ideas. Always excited to meet fellow nerds, share knowledge, and make new friends. Come nerd out with us!

### BNB Hackathon

There's also the BNB Chain Hackathon happening on Nov 25-27 and Demo Night (Nov 27), with something for everyone: (i) Developers: Build a project from scratch and bring your ideas to life. (ii) Founders: Pitch your project to VCs and connect with potential investors. (iii) Web3 enthusiasts: Discover emerging projects and explore the latest innovations.

### BNB Chain

Decentralized blockchain ecosystem designed for high-speed, low-cost Web3 applications. Originally launched by Binance, it operates as a multi-chain network powered by its native BNB token.

### About Whitepaper Reading Club

We are a community of founders, researchers, and builders across Singapore, Malaysia, San Francisco, Bangkok, New York, Lagos, Taipei, and Hong Kong. We meet in person every month to read, discuss, and pressure-test the latest blockchain papers, protocols, and technical ideas.

Learn more: Website (https://wprc.club) - Summaries (https://www.wprc.club/papers) - Calendar (https://luma.com/whitepaper)

We create detailed, easy-to-understand summaries for each paper and have held 80+ sessions since June 2023, covering Account Abstraction, Parallel Chains, EIPs, the Bitcoin ecosystem, and AI x Crypto. We are ecosystem-agnostic, not for profit, and focused on projects with technical, product, or social innovation.

## OtterSec in Seoul 🇰🇷

### Web3 보안 전문팀 OtterSec이 서울에 옵니다!

OtterSec은 Web3 보안 분야에서 상당한 기술적 깊이와 독보적인 연구 역량을 보여주고 있는 팀입니다. Solana 생태계의 핵심 인프라인 Anchor v2부터 Prop AMM과 같은 프로토콜의 리버스 엔지니어링, 실제 시스템에서의 취약점 발견까지, 기존의 접근 방식에 머무르지 않고 다양한 영역에서 새로운 기술적 시도를 이어가고 있습니다.

이번에는 그 OtterSec 팀을 서울에서 직접 만나볼 수 있는 자리를 마련했습니다. 팀이 최근 어떤 연구를 진행하고 있는지, 어떤 흥미로운 문제들을 파고들고 있는지, AI를 보안 연구와 감사에 어떻게 접목하고 있는지, 그리고 AI가 앞으로 Web3 보안의 방향을 어떻게 바꿔갈지 직접 들어볼 수 있습니다. 평소 관심 있게 지켜봤던 분들은 물론, 새로운 기술과 연구에 관심 있는 분들에게도 좋은 기회가 될 것 같습니다.

### 1. Presentations & Speakers

이번 행사에는 Zcash 취약점 제보로 7자리 수 규모의 버그 바운티를 받은 OtterSec의 한국인 보안 연구원 GSS1(강상수)을 비롯해 OtterSec의 다른 보안 연구원들이 발표자로 참여합니다.

주요 발표 주제는 다음과 같습니다.

OtterSec이 현재 연구하고 개발 중인 기술과 프로젝트

Web3 보안의 새로운 도전 과제와 앞으로의 방향

- 실제 취약점 발견 사례와 보안 연구 과정
- 프로토콜 리버스 엔지니어링과 새로운 감사 기법

각 발표 후에는 Q&A 시간이 이어집니다. 발표는 영어로 진행됩니다.

Joining us will be GSS1, the Korean OtterSec auditor behind a seven-figure Zcash bug bounty, alongside other OtterSec auditors.

Topics will include:

- Interesting vulnerability discoveries and real-world security research
- Protocol reverse engineering and novel auditing techniques
- What the OtterSec team has been researching and building
- Emerging challenges and directions in Web3 security

Presentations will be followed by an open Q&A. Talks will be conducted in English.

### 2. Schedule

November 26, 2026 (Thu.) | 18:30-22:00

- 18:30-19:00 - 참가자 등록 및 입장
- 19:00-20:30 - 기술 발표 및 Q&A (Details TBA)
- 20:30-22:00 - OtterSec 팀과의 네트워킹

November 26, 2026 (Thu.) | 18:30-22:00

- 18:30-19:00 - Arrival & Check-in
- 19:00-20:30 - Technical Presentations & Q&A (Details TBA)
- 20:30-22:00 - Networking with the OtterSec Team

### 3. Who Should Attend?

스마트 컨트랙트 개발자, 보안 연구자, 감사 전문가, 프로토콜 엔지니어 등 Web3 보안에 관심 있는 분들이라면 누구나 환영합니다.

특히 실제 취약점 분석이나 리버스 엔지니어링에 관심이 있거나, 다른 보안 연구자들과 기술적인 이야기를 나누고 싶은 분들에게 좋은 기회가 될 것입니다.

발표를 듣는 것뿐 아니라 OtterSec 팀원들과 직접 이야기를 나누고, 국내 개발자 및 보안 연구자들과 교류하는 시간도 가져보세요.

Whether you're a security researcher, smart contract auditor, blockchain developer, protocol engineer, or simply interested in how Web3 systems work under the hood, you're welcome to join.

If you're interested in vulnerability research, reverse engineering, protocol security, or meeting others working in the space, this is a good opportunity to exchange ideas and get to know the people behind the research.

Come for the talks, stay for the conversations. Meet the OtterSec team and connect with Seoul's blockchain security community.

### Hosted by

OtterSec × Decipher × Four Pillars

서울에서 만나요!

OtterSec × Decipher × Four Pillars

See you in Seoul!

### OtterSec is coming to Seoul!

OtterSec has built a reputation for technically ambitious work at the forefront of Web3 security research. From its work on core Solana infrastructure such as Anchor v2 to reverse engineering protocols like Prop AMMs and uncovering vulnerabilities in live systems, the team is constantly exploring new approaches to understanding and securing blockchain infrastructure.

We're bringing the OtterSec team to Seoul for an evening of technical talks and conversations. Hear directly from the team about what they've been working on, the interesting problems they're tackling, how they're incorporating AI into their security research and auditing workflows, and how they see AI shaping the future of Web3 security. Whether you've been following their work or are simply curious about what's happening at the cutting edge of blockchain security, we'd love to have you join us.

A ideia é simples: trazer seu projeto, suas dúvidas e seus bloqueios e conversar diretamente com quem pode ajudar a destravar o próximo passo.

## Agentic Finance x AI Security — Bangkok Side Event

- Record: `luma-crypto-UbES7ipbJiGHspw`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)

### About the event

Event Overview

As autonomous agents move from demos to holding keys, routing capital, and settling on-chain, two questions decide who wins: what can agents actually do with money, and how do we keep them - and the rails beneath them - safe. Agentic finance is moving fast, but the infrastructure for agent-held assets, agent-to-agent payments, and verifiable agent behavior is still being built, and the security assumptions behind it are being tested in real time.

This side event brings both sides of that question onto one stage. We convene the builders defining agentic finance and the teams securing it - for an opening keynote, two moderated panels on Agentic Finance and AI Security, and a closing Braindates session - as a Binance Blockchain Week Bangkok 2026 side event.

### Agenda

13:30 - 14:00 Registration + Welcome Drinks

14:00 - 14:10 Keynote 1: dLife

14:10 - 14:20 Keynote 2: Junto

14:20 - 15:00 Panel Discussion 1: Agentic Finance

15:00 - 15:10 Break

15:10 - 15:50 Panel Discussion 2: AI Security

15:50 - 17:00 Braindates & Networking

Welcome drinks will be provided.

Organizers Introduction

Host

Junto

Junto is an AI-first trading terminal that brings US-stock perpetuals, crypto, meme scanning, and paper agents into one conversational workspace. It is built for traders who want to turn a market idea into a rule, backtest it, and see what actually happened - with every decision, order, and fill auditable.

dp.life (https://dp.life)

dp.life (https://dp.life) is a Web3 super app that blends a decentralized wallet, discover, AI analysis, and social into one identity, connected to the compliant world through a centralized account system. It brings on-chain and off-chain life together, lowering the barrier for everyday users to enter Web3.

Profitech Securities

Profitech Securities Limited is a Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission licensed corporation (CE No. BOA307), licensed for Type 1, 4, 6, and 9 regulated activities. It connects traditional capital markets with the digital asset economy, bringing regulated-market discipline to the agentic finance conversation.

### Co-Host

Pharos

Pharos is a high-performance, EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain built as global infrastructure for real-world assets, founded by former Ant Group blockchain executives. Its modular, full-stack parallel architecture targets 30,000 TPS with sub-second finality, serving institutions bringing financial assets onchain and the AI agents that hold and move them.

Blockin Ventures

Blockin Ventures is a venture capital firm focused on blockchain and Web3, backing early-stage teams building the infrastructure and applications of the onchain economy. It supports founders from inception with capital, network, and hands-on guidance.

ZeroDrift

ZeroDrift is building AI offensive security for enterprise software. Our AI agents run penetration tests and code reviews the way a real attacker would, and our security researchers verify every finding and help teams ship the fix. ZeroDrift has published CVEs in Apple, Google and Microsoft software, works with partners including Infini, BNB Chain, Sign and Flap, and is backed by YZi Labs.

Roostoo

Roostoo is building autonomous AI trading agents. Every agent is tested in live paper-trading competitions on our platform, where it builds a verifiable track record, and users can then select the agents they trust to deploy real capital on decentralized exchanges. Roostoo is backed by YZi Labs.

Andes Ventures

Andes Ventures is a Web3 venture capital firm and accelerator focused on blockchain infrastructure and related fields, having invested in dozens of projects across Europe and the United States. It backs world-class teams driving sustainable and inclusive innovation across consensus, middleware, DeFi, gaming, and social.

### ACPX

ACPX is a Web3 project building at the intersection of digital assets and onchain infrastructure. It works with builders across the ecosystem to bring new products and experiences to users in the agentic finance era.

dLife

dLife is an AI4Sci project incubated by BNB Chain's MVB10. We use cryptography and smart contracts to protect and utilize personal biological data, return genome ownership to individuals, and build decentralized longevity infrastructure, with the tools the AI era demands for data security and privacy.

Techub News

Techub News is a Hong Kong-based technology media outlet covering AI, Web3, and the cross-border digital economy, with a bilingual Chinese-English newsroom and editorial teams across Asia. It brings a Hong Kong perspective on the fast-moving Web3 landscape to builders, investors, and everyday readers across the region.

### About Event

Solana Student Bootcampは、AIを活用しながら、自分のアイデアをSolanaブロックチェーン上のプロダクトとして形にしていく、学生向け・全4回の実践プログラムです。

「AIを使って、自分でも何かつくってみたい」「ブロックチェーンが、実際にどんな場面で使われているのか知りたい」その興味を、開発の第一歩につなげます。

いま注目されている領域を知り、実際に手を動かすことで、技術への理解を深めていきます。

AIとブロックチェーンの今を、つくりながら学ぶ

AIが目覚ましく進化する今、ブロックチェーンの活用やプロダクト開発は、どのように変わっているのでしょうか。

本プログラムでは、業界で注目されている領域や実際の活用について学びながら、Solana上での開発に取り組みます。

学んだことを、自分のアイデアで試してみる。AIを活用して実装し、動きを確かめ、改善する。講義と開発を行き来しながら、「知っている」を「つくれる」へと近づけていきます。

全4回の実践プログラムを通じて目指すのは、自分のアイデアをプロダクトとして開発する力を身につけること。授業や独学で得た知識も、まだ形になっていない発想も、実際に動くものへとつなげていきましょう。

現場で活躍する人の視点に触れる

実際の現場で活躍する方々を、外部講師としてお招きする予定です。技術の説明だけでなく、現場で何に取り組み、どのようにプロダクトをつくっているのか。その視点に触れることも、自分がつくりたいものを考えるヒントになります。

※講師や各回の詳しい内容は、順次ご案内します。

こんな学生におすすめ

Solanaやブロックチェーンの今を、実際に触りながら学びたい

- AIを使って、自分のアイデアをアプリやサービスにしてみたい
- 授業や独学で学んだことを、プロダクト開発に生かしたい
- 業界で活躍する人の話を聞き、自分の挑戦や進路のヒントを見つけたい

### About Event

Join Avalanche & Blockchain Game Alliance (BGA) for a closed roundtable at the House of Lords, UK Parliament.

The UK is laying down the rules for digital money, but the real test is whether these policies will actually work in practice.

Will the proposed caps and yield rules give sterling stablecoins a fighting chance, or will dollar-backed coins and tokenized bank deposits win out?

And once we look past crypto trading, how do stablecoins fit into actual everyday payments, autonomous AI agents, and cross-border remittances?

We're bringing together stablecoin issuers, banks, legal experts, and payment providers for an honest, practical discussion on where the market is really heading.

### About the Summit

The MECA CFO Summit 2026 brings together over 200 chief financial officers, corporate finance leaders, and investment strategists across the Middle East, Eurasia, and Central Asia. Convening at the Metropolitan Hotel Dubai along Sheikh Zayed Road, the summit centers on the evolving mandate of enterprise financial leadership in an era dominated by artificial intelligence, automated treasury operations, and digital asset adoption.

As global financial centers integrate digital asset infrastructure, regional CFOs face new imperatives around capital efficiency, regulatory compliance, and cross-border settlement. This full-day summit provides a dedicated forum for senior executives to exchange practical frameworks for financial transformation, risk mitigation, and long-term enterprise value creation.

### Summit Agenda & Key Themes

- 08:30 AM - Registration, Welcome Coffee & Executive Networking
- 09:30 AM - Opening Keynote: The CFO Agenda Beyond Traditional Finance
- 10:15 AM - Panel: Artificial Intelligence & Automation in Modern Treasury Operations
- 11:30 AM - Executive Discussion: Cross-Border Liquidity & Digital Asset Integration in the UAE
- 01:00 PM - Networking Luncheon & Strategic Partner Showcase
- 02:15 PM - Breakout Sessions: ESG Reporting, Capital Structuring, and Regional Tax Strategies
- 04:00 PM - Closing Roundtable & Leadership Reception

### Who Should Attend

Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and Vice Presidents of Finance

Corporate Treasurers and Heads of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Managing Directors and Investment Committee Members

Enterprise Technology Leaders evaluating finance automation and digital assets

### Venue & Registration Details

Venue: Metropolitan Hotel Dubai, Sheikh Zayed Road, Exit 41, Al Thanya Street, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

Access: Corporate registration is required via the official MECA CFO Global portal. Verified CFOs and institutional finance leaders receive priority access.

## SuiHub Lagos: The Stable Side of Sui with Zynta

- Record: `luma-crypto-d93uiPxQlMmlphP`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-28T11:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/9kudozci>

### About the event

Moving money across borders in Africa remains one of the hardest engineering and operational challenges in fintech. From navigating complex currency corridors to handling multi-jurisdictional compliance, building reliable payment systems requires solid rails and regulatory compliance.

Join Zynta and Sui for an intensive, 2.5-hour hands-on developer session in Lagos. We will explore how stablecoin infrastructure, multi-chain settlement rails, and unified API endpoints combine to power seamless cross-border transactions across Africa, Europe, and beyond.

Whether you are building a neobank, an enterprise payout platform, or an on/off-ramp product, this session will show you how to move from sign-up to your first live API call on production-grade payment infrastructure.

### What You Will Learn

Unified Infrastructure: How Zynta brings payment rails, merchant tools, and institutional liquidity into a single API integration.

On-Chain Settlement on Sui: How to leverage Sui's speed and low transaction costs for stablecoin settlement while Zynta handles fiat edges and compliance.

Go-To-Market Across Africa: Actionable strategies for selling tech across diverse African markets - including navigating regional monetary zones like WAEMU (XOF) and CEMAC (XAF).

- Licensing as a Moat: Why inheriting fully regulated compliance structures lets developers build faster without regulatory friction.

### What to Bring

Your Laptop & Charger: You will be writing code, testing API endpoints, and taking part in the live build challenge.

An Idea or Project: Bring questions about payment flows you are currently designing or scaling.

### Speakers

Peace Audu-Ukpoju - Chief Product Officer at Zynta Peace leads product strategy, partnerships and regulatory work, and helps build the rails businesses use to move money across Africa and beyond. Before Zynta, she worked on payments at Relm, a cross-border crypto and fiat platform, and led product teams at companies in Lagos and Abuja.

Agbakwuru Oluchi, Head of Engineering at Zynta Oluchi leads engineering at Zynta and works with businesses as a solutions engineer to help them integrate Zynta's payment rails, from the first API call to live production. She focuses on building reliable cross-border infrastructure that combines stablecoin settlement with fiat payouts across Africa and beyond

Elohor Lauretta Isiakpere, Head of Sales-Nigeria at Zynta At Zynta, she helps businesses simplify cross-border payments with stablecoin infrastructure and is known for building trust with both C-suite and technical buyers, and showing businesses how better money flows turn into revenue. Before Zynta, she was Acting Head of Enterprise Accounts at Nomba (YC-W17), where she grew the enterprise customer base and scaled team productivity.

### Is Your Bitcoin Safe in the Age of AI? / AI時代、あなたのBitcoinは安全ですか?

A side event of Bitcoin Japan 2026 (https://btc-jpn.com/) / (https://btc-jpn.com/)Bitcoin Japan 2026 (https://btc-jpn.com/) のサイドイベント

Bitcoin Japan 2026 brought the Bitcoin world to Tokyo, but there were not many sessions in English. So Tokyo Bitcoin Base is opening its doors to everyone who wants to hear from international speakers and see presentations in English.

Don't speak English? You are just as welcome. All presentations will be translated into Japanese, so everyone can follow along. You're also free to come and go anytime, so feel free to join just for the sessions you're most interested in.

Hacks are changing the Bitcoin world. So what can we do about it? Three short talks, each followed by a panel, plus a fourth panel on Japan, with the builders on the front line: what really happened inside BTCPay Server, how decentralization can stop hacks before they happen, and how to protect your own keys with a DIY signer.

### Speakers

Nicolas Dorier (https://x.com/NicolasDorier), Creator of BTCPay Server

Anna (https://x.com/annahhodl), CEO of Hodl

DIY Pacman (https://x.com/DIYbitcoin), DIY signer

Jonathan Underwood (https://x.com/junderwood4649), bitbank

Kishin (https://x.com/btc_dakara), Japan Bitcoin Industry

Joe Miyamoto (https://x.com/joemphilips), Developer

Brad, MC

### Program (13:00-17:00, doors open 12:45)

Opening

Nicolas Dorier LT: What happened at BTCPay Server,

Panel 1: Security & Crisis

Anna LT: Hodl and decentralization

Panel 2: Centralized Exchanges

DIY Pacman LT: DIY signer

Panel 3: Hardware Wallets & Makers

Panel 4: Security in Japan

Networking

### Never been to TBB? Now's your chance

Tokyo Bitcoin Base is Tokyo's home for Bitcoiners. While you're here, take a look at:

- The event space, which you can book for your own meetups and events
- Shared offices and coworking spaces you can rent

During networking, the mic is open: feel free to present your own project to the room. Come for the talks, stay for the people, and leave knowing where Tokyo's Bitcoin community lives.

Ticket: Free

Tokyo Bitcoin Base, Yotsuya, Tokyo

English, with Japanese translation

### 日本語

Bitcoin Japan 2026では、英語で話す登壇者やセッションがあまりありませんでした。そこでTokyo Bitcoin Baseは、海外の登壇者の話を聞きたい方、英語のプレゼンテーションに触れたい方のために、会場を開くことにしました。

英語が話せなくても大丈夫です。すべてのプレゼンテーションは日本語に翻訳されますので、どなたでも安心してご参加ください。途中参加・途中退出も自由ですので、気になるセッションだけでもお気軽にお越しください。

ハッキングによって、Bitcoinを取り巻く世界は今まさに変わりつつあります。では、私たちに何ができるのか。BTCPay Serverで実際に起きたこと、分散化でハッキングを防ぐ仕組み、DIYサイナーで自分の鍵を守る方法について、3つの短い講演とそれぞれに続くパネル、そして日本についてのパネルで深掘りします。

### About the event

Garanti BBVA Kripto ve Team1 Türkiye kampüsüne geliyor! UniTour#3, blockchain teknolojisini kampüslere taşımayı, öğrencileri Web3 dünyasıyla tanıştırmayı ve yeni nesil kariyer fırsatlarıyla onlara ilham vermeyi amaçlıyor. UniTour#3'ün 4. etkinliği PRÜ Blockchain Kulübü'nün desteğiyle Piri Reis Üniversitesi'nde gerçekleşecek. Garanti BBVA Kripto'nun (https://www.garantibbvakripto.com.tr/?utm_source=luma) dijital varlık vizyonunu yakından tanıyacak, kripto cüzdanlarıyla varlıklarınızı nasıl güvenle saklayabileceğinizi ve kolayca yönetebileceğinizi keşfedeceksiniz.

Avalanche Cascade (https://go.team1.network/turkiye-cascade?utm_source=luma) ile Avalanche Ekosistemi'nin temellerini öğrenirken, Team1 Türkiye'nin (https://go.team1.network/turkiye?utm_source=luma) hem topluluk odaklı öğrencilere hem de geliştirici öğrencilere sunduğu fırsatları yakından inceleme şansı bulacaksınız. Etkinlik Akışı [Etkinliğin detaylı programı ve oturum saatleri çok yakında duyurulacaktır.] Etkinliğin sonunda katılımcılar, pizza ve içecekler eşliğinde keyifli bir networking (tanışma ve bağlantı kurma) oturumuna katılma fırsatı bulacak.  Ayrıca defter, kalem, tişört veya çanta gibi çeşitli promosyon ürünleri küçük hatıralar olarak dağıtılacak

Garanti BBVA Kripto Garanti BBVA Kripto (https://www.garantibbvakripto.com.tr/?utm_source=luma), Türkiye'nin en büyük özel bankalarından biri olan Garanti BBVA'nın iştiraki olarak, kripto varlık hizmetleri sunmak amacıyla Mayıs 2023'te kurulmuştur. Temel hedefi, kripto dünyasına adım atan bireylere yüksek kaliteli ve kullanıcı odaklı bir deneyim sunmaktır. Sunduğu hizmetler arasında kripto varlık saklama ve alım-satım işlemleri ön plana çıkmaktadır

Team1 Team1 (https://x.com/AvaxTeam1?utm_source=luma), Avalanche (https://www.avax.network/?utm_source=luma) ekosistemini büyütmeye odaklanan geliştiriciler, üreticiler, içerik oluşturucular, oyuncular ve topluluk liderlerinden oluşan küresel bir ağdır. 50'den fazla ülkede aktif olarak faaliyet gösteren Team1 (https://x.com/AvaxTeam1?utm_source=luma), yerel buluşmalar, hedef odaklı atölyeler, özel yan etkinlikler, içerik üretimi ve topluluk odaklı girişimler aracılığıyla Avalanche'ın benimsenmesini destekler ve ekosisteme yeni kullanıcılar ile projeler kazandırır. Çevrimiçi ve fiziksel topluluklar arasında köprü kurarak yerel inovasyonu güçlendirir ve Avalanche'ın farklı coğrafyalara ve kültürlere yayılmasını sağlar

Team1 Türkiye Team1 Türkiye (https://x.com/Team1TUR?utm_source=luma), Avalanche ekosistemini büyütmek ve Web3 dünyasına yeni yetenekler kazandırmak için çalışan resmi bir topluluk yapılanmasıdır. Bugüne kadar Türkiye genelinde 60'tan fazla etkinlik düzenleyerek 4.500 katılımcıya ulaşan Team1 Türkiye, 30'dan fazla üniversiteyle iş birliği yaparak Avalanche'ı kampüslere taşımış ve birçok öğrenci ile geliştiricinin ekosisteme ilk adımını atmasını sağlamıştır. Team1 Türkiye, yerel topluluklarla kurduğu güçlü bağlar sayesinde büyümeye devam ederken daha fazla öğrenciyi ve geliştiriciyi ekosisteme kazandırmayı hedeflemektedir

PRU Blockchain Kulübü PRU Blockchain (https://x.com/pru_blockchain), Piri Reis Üniversitesi'nde merkeziyetsiz teknolojilere meraklı öğrencileri bir araya getiren genç bir topluluk. Yeni kurulduk, ama heyecanımız büyük: eğitimler, teknik içerikler ve etkinliklerle birlikte öğreniyor, birlikte üretiyoruz. İlk hackathon birinciliğimizi şimdiden aldık; devamı için çalışıyoruz.

DWF Labs Haus: UAE Edition

Five years in the UAE. One night with the people who made it happen. On the eve of Eid Al Etihad, we're bringing our community together to mark five years of DWF Labs in the UAE.

Date: December 1, 2026

Time: 7-10pm

"Community" gets sprinkled around a lot. For us, it's a word we don't take lightly. Over five years, the founders, investors, protocols, institutions, and ecosystem partners across this region have all played their part in making us, us. The UAE has been pivotal to our journey, one marked by milestones and moments: over 65 HotDesk Wednesdays, 11 sponsored summits and conferences, and more. It's a place that has become a global hub for digital assets, and one where we've grown alongside those who share our belief that digital infrastructure should be liquid, fair, and built to last.

See you then.

### About the event

The Big Whale (https://www.thebigwhale.io/) is the leading Market Intelligence provider on Digital Assets, serving 150+ banks, asset managers, fintechs and digital asset companies. Join TBW (https://www.thebigwhale.io/), Morgan Stanley (https://www.morganstanley.com/), and other leading players for an exclusive Corporate After Bell event in New York City. Tokenized stocks, funds and bonds are now live, and issuance is no longer the bottleneck. The harder question is what happens after: where these assets trade, who provides liquidity, and how they move through custody, settlement and reporting. Most issuers earn their revenue at issuance and have little reason to build the secondary market.

That leaves the job to venues, broker-dealers and banks. Some will plug tokenized assets into the desks and systems they already run. Others will build new ones. The choice will decide who captures the flows. Thanks to Morgan Stanley for making this event possible. Attending? Share your presence with a dedicated visual here! ## AI x Strategy Workshop

- Record: `luma-crypto-3bE2t0WPLWeG41h`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-12-02T14:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/lr0deato>

### About the event

Build a strategy for your own business in 90 minutes, using what you already pay for.

Most people using AI are doing the same thing. One chat window, one question, one answer, close the tab. It works, it is mildly useful, and it is a fraction of what you are already paying for.

This session is for people past the beginner stage who have hit a ceiling. You know the tools. Nobody has shown you the shape they go in.

Your Host

Nabeel, from London now living in Abu Dhabi, runs Fifty Third Street, a consultancy working with pre-Series A startups, and is Managing Partner at Capital57. He has spent twenty years in startups and the last few building the AI systems he now runs his own businesses on.

What we do in the session

You bring your own numbers. Nothing theoretical, nothing from somebody else's case study.

In 90 minutes you work out where your business actually sits, what your competitors are really doing, and what it would take to move. You leave with a strategy document you wrote yourself, and a task that updates autonomously.

All of it on your own laptop, in your own account.

What you leave with

A one page strategy document for your business. A monthly task that keeps it current without you. Five prompts you can point at anything. A readiness score, taken at the start and again at the end. And a cheat sheet for your industry, in your inbox before you reach the car park.

What this is not

No slides about the future of work. No tools you have to go and buy. Everything we use is already inside a subscription you have.

Who it is for

Owners and senior people in small businesses who already use AI most weeks and suspect they are using a tenth of it.

Who it is not for

Anyone who has not used Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini before. You would spend the session watching rather than building. There will be a separate session for that.

How it works

By application. There is preparation to do in the week before, and it is the difference between a useful session and a wasted one. Sessions are recorded for our own notes, and applying counts as agreeing to that.

Three things you need before the day

1. A paid Claude account. The entry tier is enough. Free accounts cannot do the last half hour of this session.
2. The Claude desktop app, installed and signed in.
3. Signed in to the Google account you actually use for work, in the same browser.

And the preparation

Everything you build comes out of what you bring. Thin preparation, thin strategy document. Have these ready as files or notes:

- Your last three months of revenue, split by what you sell.
- Your top ten customers.
- Your current prices.
- Anyone you lost in the last six months, and why.
- Your team size and who does what.
- One page in your own words on what you think is going wrong.
- And the names of three competitors.

None of it leaves your own account or domain.

## L’écosystème fintech montréalais à l’heure de la tokenisation

- Record: `luma-crypto-EQlii8wBJKCDZbJ`
