### About the event

La tokenisation n'est plus une promesse technologique. Les cadres réglementaires convergent aux États-Unis, en Europe, à Hong Kong et au Canada. Les institutions financières s'organisent en consortiums, et les stablecoins s'imposent progressivement comme de véritables rails de paiement. Montréal possède solides atouts pour prendre part à cette transformation: un écosystème fintech mature, des talents spécialisés en finance et en technologies numériques, ainsi qu'une expertise reconnue en intelligence artificielle.

La métropole bénéficie également d'un savoir-faire concret dans les domaines de la chaîne de blocs, du Web3 et de la DeFi, avec des entreprises et des équipes capables de mener des projets d'envergure au Québec comme à l'international.

Lors de cet événement de la communauté CFI, Finance Montréal et T-RIZE présenteront les grandes tendances qui façonnent l'avenir de la finance numérique et discuteront du rôle que le Québec peut jouer dans le développement de l'économie tokenisée. À partir des faits saillants du Rapport Fintech Québec 2026 et d'une analyse des avancées récentes en matière de tokenisation, nous verrons pourquoi Montréal offre un environnement particulièrement favorable aux initiatives liées aux actifs numériques et aux infrastructures financières de nouvelle génération. Programme 1. Accueil et dîner 2. Présentation du Rapport Fintech Québec 2026 et portrait de l'écosystème fintech montréalais 3.

L'écosystème montréalais de la tokenisation 4.  Période de questions et échanges entre pairs Présentateurs

Bruno Séguin, directeur principal, Comptes stratégiques, Finance Montréal

Jean-Luc Pellerin, directeur, Écosystème et partenariats stratégiques, T-RIZE Ce que vous allez retirer de cet événement

Un portrait à jour de l'écosystème fintech montréalais, tiré du Rapport Fintech Québec 2026;

Un tour d'horizon des acteurs qui bâtissent l'infrastructure de tokenisation à Montréal. Un dîner sera servi sur place. L'événement est gratuit, mais les places sont limitées.

## Tokenizar valores en Europa: ¿España o Luxemburgo?

- Record: `luma-crypto-YXa85uH7PkyVuIJ`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-12-02T17:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/wh0tg09o>

### About the event

El régimen legal de Luxemburgo para la tokenización de valores ha suscitado interés en España durante los últimos años, aunque sus características siguen siendo desconocidas en buena parte del sector. En esta sesión, compararemos los dos marcos legales, el español y el luxemburgués, para entender las ventajas y desventajas de cada uno, con el apoyo de nuestros socios de Legal Node.

Nos centramos en la tokenización de instrumentos financieros (security tokens), a diferencia de los criptoactivos sujetos a MiCA.

De qué hablaremos

ERIR (España) frente a Control Agent (Luxemburgo): funciones y responsabilidades de cada figura.

Prendas, y garantías y su ejecución sobre instrumentos tokenizados.

Negociación secundaria y futuro de la regulación.

- ¿Qué instrumentos se pueden tokenizar en cada país y cómo (tokenización nativa frente a representación digital)?
- Límites legales y efectos sobre la propiedad.
- Estructuras legales para la de tokenización: fondos, vehículos de titulización y estructuras de financiación. Tokenizar el vehículo frente a tokenizar su deuda.

Ponentes

Ignacio Jiménez, socio de Legal Node

Miguel Calero, director ejecutivo de ISBE en Alastria

- Álvaro Garrido, socio de Legal Node

What makes an ETF a compelling structure for institutional BWhat makes an ETF a compelling structure for institutional Bitcoin exposure?

Hosted by BIT Asset Management in partnership with HUB+

Join BIT Asset Management in Geneva for a discussion on institutional Bitcoin exposure. Using BBIT, Switzerland's first Bitcoin ETF, as a practical example, we'll look at how a Swiss ETF provides direct exposure to Bitcoin and what its structure means for custody, oversight and access through SIX Swiss Exchange.

Avalanche Cascade (https://go.team1.network/turkiye-cascade?utm_source=luma) ile Avalanche Ekosistemi'nin temellerini öğrenirken, Team1 Türkiye'nin (https://go.team1.network/turkiye?utm_source=luma) hem topluluk odaklı öğrencilere hem de geliştirici öğrencilere sunduğu fırsatları yakından inceleme şansı bulacaksınız. Etkinlik Akışı [Etkinliğin detaylı programı ve oturum saatleri çok yakında duyurulacaktır.] Etkinliğin sonunda katılımcılar, pizza ve içecekler eşliğinde keyifli bir networking (tanışma ve bağlantı kurma) oturumuna katılma fırsatı bulacak.  Ayrıca defter, kalem, tişört veya çanta gibi çeşitli promosyon ürünleri küçük hatıralar olarak dağıtılacak

Garanti BBVA Kripto Garanti BBVA Kripto (https://www.garantibbvakripto.com.tr/?utm_source=luma), Türkiye'nin en büyük özel bankalarından biri olan Garanti BBVA'nın iştiraki olarak, kripto varlık hizmetleri sunmak amacıyla Mayıs 2023'te kurulmuştur. Temel hedefi, kripto dünyasına adım atan bireylere yüksek kaliteli ve kullanıcı odaklı bir deneyim sunmaktır. Sunduğu hizmetler arasında kripto varlık saklama ve alım-satım işlemleri ön plana çıkmaktadır

Team1 Team1 (https://x.com/AvaxTeam1?utm_source=luma), Avalanche (https://www.avax.network/?utm_source=luma) ekosistemini büyütmeye odaklanan geliştiriciler, üreticiler, içerik oluşturucular, oyuncular ve topluluk liderlerinden oluşan küresel bir ağdır. 50'den fazla ülkede aktif olarak faaliyet gösteren Team1 (https://x.com/AvaxTeam1?utm_source=luma), yerel buluşmalar, hedef odaklı atölyeler, özel yan etkinlikler, içerik üretimi ve topluluk odaklı girişimler aracılığıyla Avalanche'ın benimsenmesini destekler ve ekosisteme yeni kullanıcılar ile projeler kazandırır. Çevrimiçi ve fiziksel topluluklar arasında köprü kurarak yerel inovasyonu güçlendirir ve Avalanche'ın farklı coğrafyalara ve kültürlere yayılmasını sağlar

Team1 Türkiye Team1 Türkiye (https://x.com/Team1TUR?utm_source=luma), Avalanche ekosistemini büyütmek ve Web3 dünyasına yeni yetenekler kazandırmak için çalışan resmi bir topluluk yapılanmasıdır. Bugüne kadar Türkiye genelinde 60'tan fazla etkinlik düzenleyerek 4.500 katılımcıya ulaşan Team1 Türkiye, 30'dan fazla üniversiteyle iş birliği yaparak Avalanche'ı kampüslere taşımış ve birçok öğrenci ile geliştiricinin ekosisteme ilk adımını atmasını sağlamıştır. Team1 Türkiye, yerel topluluklarla kurduğu güçlü bağlar sayesinde büyümeye devam ederken daha fazla öğrenciyi ve geliştiriciyi ekosisteme kazandırmayı hedeflemektedir

IstanbulChain İstanbulChain (https://x.com/istanbulchain?s=11), İstanbul Üniversitesi merkezli, Web3, blokzincir ve finansal teknolojilere odaklanan bir öğrenci topluluğudur. Workshoplar, sektörel buluşmalar ve networking etkinlikleriyle öğrencilerin proje geliştirmelerini, sektörün öncü şirketleriyle bağlantı kurmalarını ve Web3 ekosisteminde aktif rol almalarını hedeflemektedir

Girişim Hub Girişim Hub, İstanbul Üniversitesi öğrencilerini girişimcilik, inovasyon ve teknoloji ekosistemiyle buluşturan bir öğrenci topluluğudur. Eğitimler, atölyeler, networking etkinlikleri, yarışmalar ve sektör iş birlikleriyle öğrencilerin kişisel ve profesyonel gelişimlerini desteklerken, fikirlerin projelere ve projelerin somut etkiye dönüşmesini hedeflemektedir.

## Bitcoin meetup #30: Bitcoinové dědictví: jak předat bitcoiny další generaci

- Record: `luma-crypto-F2Xabi0c6pHFKZV`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-12-03T17:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/ji03ut7a>

### About the event

Co se stane s vašimi bitcoiny, až tu jednou nebudete?

Self-custody nám dává kontrolu nad vlastními bitcoiny. Zároveň ale přináší důležitou otázku: jak zajistit, aby se k nim v budoucnu dostali naši blízcí?

Na dalším pražském meetupu Jednadvacet přivítáme Michaela Haase, seniorního produktového designéra v Trezoru. Společně se podíváme na bitcoinové dědictví, nástroje, které Bitcoin nabízí, a kompromisy mezi bezpečností, soukromím a jednoduchostí.

Probereme:

Proč je dědictví důležitou součástí self-custody.

- Časové zámky, multisig a podmínky pro utrácení bitcoinů.
- Jak připravit přístup pro blízké, aniž bychom jim předali kontrolu příliš brzy.
- Jak dědický plán udržovat při změně peněženky, klíčů nebo rodinné situace.

Čekají vás praktické příklady, technický kontext a prostor na otázky. Univerzální řešení pro každého neexistuje, proto se budeme bavit i o omezeních a dlouhodobé správě takového plánu.

Čtvrtek 3. prosince 2026 18:00-21:30 Cafe DECADA, Vacínova 876/10, 180 00 Praha 8-Libeň (Palmovka)

Na akci je potřeba registrace.

### About the Organizers

OneCloud

OneCloud Technology Solutions is a global cloud services and technology solutions provider headquartered in Dubai and Kuala Lumpur. With 1,000+ clients across traditional industries, the internet sector, and Web3, OneCloud works with leading public cloud providers and technology partners to deliver secure, scalable, and tailored cloud solutions worldwide.

Cloudflare Global Network

Cloudflare's network connects directly with virtually every service provider and cloud provider, reaching 95% of the world's internet users within approximately 50 milliseconds. One of the world's largest networks - powering all services across data centers and delivering unmatched performance, security, and reliability. Every service runs in every data center. Settle in and watch the iconic Hong Kong skyline change colors and light up the night, all while we unpack the hypes, crashes, and survival tactics of the modern financial era with a healthy dose of humor.

The Panel: Surviving the Cycles: Media OGs & Legal Pioneers on What Actually Blew Up

The Discussion: A rare, filter-free fireside chat featuring fintech media veterans, legal trailblazers, and tech columnists. Combined, this panel carries decades of experience chronicling blockchain and setting legal precedents. From navigating legendary scandals to executing landmark litigation, they are laying bare the realities of the industry. What actually built trust, and what content and business models went straight to zero?

The Takeaway: The ultimate, unfiltered post-mortem on building influence, setting regulatory frameworks, and reporting the truth in the world's most volatile financial and psychological experiment.

This dynamic format invites attendees to engage in rapid-fire debates on the most contentious questions facing today's fintech and blockchain landscapes. ## Bitcoin Rails Unconference: Doing business on Bitcoin Rails

- Record: `luma-crypto-qdagAu8TQuz6IaW`

### About the event

The Bitcoin Rails Unconference is a collaborative, participant-driven gathering designed to bring together builders, operators, treasury leaders, founders, investors, and institutional strategists to explore the evolving infrastructure and financial frameworks shaping Bitcoin's role in the global economy. Rather than a traditional stage-and-keynote format, this unconference emphasizes open dialogue, shared learning, and practical discussions led by attendees themselves - from seasoned practitioners to emerging innovators.

As Bitcoin becomes an increasingly significant component of corporate balance sheets, payment networks, financial primitives, and institutional asset portfolios, this event provides a rare space for cross-sector engagement on the real-world challenges and opportunities of Bitcoin rails. Attendees will engage directly with pioneering companies and thought leaders across core functional areas - from "buying" and "custody" to "payments," "acceptance," "investment," "yield," and "borrowing" - shaping the future of Bitcoin adoption.

### What to Expect

Collaborative, Open Discussions

This unconference format empowers participants to shape conversations in real time. Sessions will emerge organically, informed by the expertise and interests of experienced practitioners, executives, and innovators in the Bitcoin ecosystem.

Strategic Insights Across the Bitcoin Value Stack

Designed for CFOs, treasurers, CIOs, and corporate decision-makers, the sessions explore Bitcoin through seven practical lenses:

Buying - How do we enter at scale, with liquidity, compliance, and minimal market impact?

Keeping - What does enterprise-grade custody and governance actually require?

Paying - Can Bitcoin improve cross-border settlement and treasury velocity?

Accepting - Does it reduce fees or unlock new revenue channels?

Investing - How does Bitcoin fit into corporate treasury and balance sheet strategy?

Yield - Can capital be deployed efficiently without compromising risk controls?

Borrowing - Can we unlock liquidity without selling strategic holdings?

Each discussion is grounded in real-world deployment -shared by leaders actively building and operating Bitcoin infrastructure today.

This is about operational clarity, governance, and capital efficiency -not speculation

Peer Exchange + Network Building

Beyond structured conversations, the unconference fosters high-signal networking. This setting is ideal for forging partnerships, exploring collaborations between finance and technology leaders, and engaging directly with companies at the forefront of Bitcoin rails innovation.

### Who Should Attend

This event is crafted for corporate finance leaders, treasury operators, institutional investors, founders, ecosystem builders, compliance professionals, and anyone focused on integrating Bitcoin into operational systems, balance sheets, and financial product strategies.

### Digital Capital, Digital Equity and Digital Credit

Understanding, Structuring, and Investing in the Institutional Bitcoin Revolution

A one-day executive training program that explains how Bitcoin is transforming from a monetary asset into a foundation for corporate finance, capital markets, and credit creation.

This program breaks down how institutional players are using Bitcoin across balance sheets, equity structures, and credit instruments, and how to assess and invest in these emerging frameworks.

### Program Overview (1 Day | 4 Sessions)

1. Bitcoin: From Magic Internet Money to Digital Capital

A foundational session on Bitcoin's evolution into institutional-grade digital capital and its role in modern balance sheets.

2. Digital Equity: From Bitcoin Treasury to Acceleration Strategy

How companies like Strategy, Metaplanet, and Strike use Bitcoin to drive equity performance.

Key frameworks include mNAV, Time to Cover, BTC Yield, and other core treasury metrics.

Lunch Break

3. 15 Innovations: From Digital Equity to Digital Credit

How Bitcoin enables new financial instruments and capital structures, including:

ATM issuance programs

WKSI structures

ROC dividends

- Convertible bonds
- Preferred shares and perpetuals
- Public debt frameworks
- Digital credit creation models
- Stable credit systems
- Credit localization
- Dollar reserve strategies
- Bitcoin derivatives
4. How Preferred Instruments Work and How to Assess Them

Deep dive into Bitcoin-linked preferred structures including STRK, MERCURY, STRF, STRD, STRE, STRC, SATA, MARS.

Evaluation frameworks:

BTC Rating, BTC Risk, BTC Credit, BTC Breakeven ARR, BTC Years of Dividends, USD Reserve Runway.

### Who This Is For

Owners and C-level executives from:

Banks, investment funds, corporations, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, brokers, central banks, regulators, and private companies

### About the event

CORGEAR Night vol.33 ~仮想NISHIと振り返る2026年のWeb3. コーギアナイト忘年会~ 昨年の年末回で大好評だった「仮想NISHIと振り返るWeb3」を、今年も開催します! 今回も暗号資産アナリストの仮想NISHI氏をお迎えし、2026年のWeb3・暗号資産市場を振り返ります。 暗号資産の制度整備や税制見直しに向けた動きが進み、ステーブルコインやRWAなど、既存金融との接点が広がった2026年。一方で、ビットコインをはじめとする暗号資産市場は大きく揺れ動き、期待と現実が交錯する一年となりました。 昨年に引き続き、チャートをもとに2026年の相場を振り返りながら、制度、技術、資金の流れ、そしてコミュニティの変化を読み解きます。 大幅な下落から夏場の反発まで、相場が大きく揺れた2026年。その一方で、ETFを通じた資金の流れや金融政策が市場を左右し、予測市場や資産のトークン化など、新たな動きも広がりました。相場の裏側では何が起きていたのか。仮想NISHI氏のチャート解説とともに一年を振り返り、2027年の暗号資産市場を展望します。 2026年を締めくくるこの夜は、年末恒例のコーギアナイト忘年会でもあります。 今年も少し早い乾杯とともに、クリプトの一年を振り返りましょう

### About the Workshop

Meet Manus 2.0 is an interactive, practical workshop focused on real-world implementations of the Manus 2.0 autonomous agent platform. Hosted at MAKTABI Business Center on the 18th floor of the Sheikh Rashid Tower at the Dubai World Trade Centre (DWTC), this meetup moves beyond high-level AI hype to examine what autonomous agents can accomplish in live production environments.

Led by advanced AI practitioner Cyrille C. Catel, the session features live demonstrations of custom agentic pipelines built with Manus 2.0, practical techniques for using agents as consulting copilots, and open architecture reviews of attendee workflows.

### Session Agenda

Welcome & Setup: Connecting laptops and local developer environments

Live Demonstration: Building and deploying autonomous agents with Manus 2.0

Consulting & Enterprise Workflows: Real-world case studies in client deliverables

- Q&A & Community Networking with Dubai AI builders

AI engineers, software developers, and technical founders

- Independent consultants and strategy advisors looking to automate workflows
- Product leaders exploring autonomous agent integration

### Venue Details

Location: MAKTABI Business Center, DWTC, Sheikh Rashid Tower (18th Floor), Dubai, UAE

- What to Bring: Bring your laptop to follow along and test workflows live.

### About the event

The Opening Night Digital Asset Summit ME networking evening on the opening night of Abu Dhabi Finance Week.

An evening for family offices, businesses, institutions, digital asset exchanges, remittance houses and corporate treasury teams to meet the people behind institutional custody and regulated stablecoins.

No stage, no panels. Just the right introductions, networking with good food and beverages.

### Monday 7 December 2026

- 5:30-8:30pm Four Seasons Hotel, ADGM Square, Al Maryah Island.

By invitation. Approved guests receive the venue details.

Co-Hosted by:

BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide.

For more information, visit www.bitgo.com (http://www.bitgo.com).

DDSC is the first fully licensed AED-backed stablecoin, built to bring regulated, dirham-denominated digital money into the modern financial system. Backed 1:1 by the UAE dirham and licensed by the Central Bank of the UAE under the Payment Token Services Regulation, DDSC stablecoin is designed to enable faster money movement, instant settlement and treasury workflows.

Launched by IHC, First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) and Sirius International Holding, DDSC stablecoin operates on ADI Chain and is designed to serve institutions, businesses and individuals as adoption of regulated, dirham-denominated digital value expands across the economy.

## Privacy as a Feature: a abordagem da Stellar para privacidade onchain

- Record: `luma-crypto-adMGPPQCUQehNTH`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-12-07T21:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/2h8kzpo2>

### About the event

Por que transparência total trava a adoção institucional: o que folha de pagamento, tesouraria e liquidação entre empresas não podem expor numa blockchain pública.

Privacidade como feature, não como chain: por que a Stellar mantém a base transparente e deixa a privacidade como camada opt-in e configurável por ativo e por aplicação.

As peças de ZK no protocolo: como as primitivas nativas do upgrade X-Ray (BN254 e Poseidon) e os verificadores ZK onchain viabilizam provas de conhecimento zero direto nos smart contracts.

Dois modelos de privacidade, lado a lado: Confidential Tokens, que escondem saldos e valores, e Privacy Pools (Stellar Private Payments), que escondem também quem paga e quem recebe.

Compliance sem abrir tudo: view keys, divulgação seletiva, association sets e controles do emissor, com privacidade para o público e visibilidade sob medida para auditores e reguladores.

Quem já está construindo: OpenZeppelin, Nethermind, Arcane e Remi, e os anúncios de privacidade do Meridian 2026.

Como escolher e começar: um guia rápido para decidir o nível de privacidade de cada caso de uso e por onde começar a construir.

### PROGRAMAÇÃO

18h00 Credenciamento e networking

18h40 Abertura

19h00 Privacy as a Feature: privacidade onchain na Stellar

20h30 Bate-papo

21h15 Encerramento

21h30 Happy hour com pizza

### About the event

The Big Whale (https://www.thebigwhale.io/) is the leading Market Intelligence provider on Digital Assets, serving 150+ institutional & corporate clients across banks, asset managers, fintechs and digital asset companies.

Join Flowdesk (https://www.flowdesk.co/), DFNS (https://dfns.co/), TRM (https://www.trmlabs.com/) and TBW (https://www.thebigwhale.io/) for an exclusive breakfast in Abu Dhabi during ADFW (https://www.adfw.com/).

Every dollar in the global financial system moves on rails built decades ago. It clears slowly, settles with counterparty risk, and loses efficiency at every intermediary step.

For sovereign wealth funds, private banks, and international asset managers, the question is now operational. Where does onchain infrastructure genuinely reduce cost, expand access, or unlock yield that traditional rails cannot?

During this exclusive morning, we'll bring together a room of global institutional decision-makers to examine the capital efficiency case for going onchain, with a clear-eyed view.

## Merkle Science Meet Abu Dhabi

- Record: `luma-crypto-0NZbyd12N5Bj1tT`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-12-08T09:30:00.000Z

### December 8, 2026 | 1:30 PM - 5:45 PM

Rosewood Abu Dhabi

Join Merkle Science and a distinguished group of industry leaders, institutional investors, regulators, and compliance professionals for an exclusive afternoon of discussions during Abu Dhabi Finance Week.

The event will bring together leading voices across digital assets, institutional finance, AI-driven compliance, emerging markets, and stablecoin infrastructure to explore the opportunities and challenges shaping the future of digital finance.

### Agenda

Speakers & Panel Details

### 2:00 PM - 2:40 PM

Stablecoins & Cross-Border Payments

Stablecoins are reshaping cross-border payments, with the UAE emerging as a key hub connecting the Middle East, Asia, Europe, and Africa. This session explores how stablecoins are transforming international payments and settlement, alongside the regulatory, AML, and compliance challenges of moving value across jurisdictions.

### Speakers

Jazib Malik - CEO & Founder, Thirdpay

Donato P. Giarnera - BD, Arf

Serena Sebastiani - VP, Fuze

Joseph Cleetus - VP Business Transformation, Lulu Financial Holding

Atif Shaikh - CRO, DDSC

Jonathan Rigg - CEO, BitOasis

Moderator: Tom Luo - Head of Sales, Merkle Science

Adrianus Schoorl - Partner, Head of Financial Services Regulatory (MENA), DLA Piper

Nicole Purin - Deputy General Counsel, Trustyfy (Former CCO, OKX)

Sharad Kumar - CCO, Cyant

Maryam Saeed - Global Head of Expansion, Sardine

Max Grabner - Head of Product, Range

Moderator: Kirill Lelchitskiy - CLO, Cyant

Tristan Wallaert - CEO, Request Network

Mehtap Onder - Managing Director, Fasset

Adam Wolstenholme - Simmons & Simmons

Moderator: Sheetal Bhardwaj - Compliance Director & MLRO MENA, HashKey

Karl Naim - CCO, XBTO

Ali Boukhalfa - Head of MENA & APAC, P2P.ORG

Karthik Mahalingam - CLO, Multipli.fi (https://Multipli.fi)

Nicholas Philpott - Co-Founder & CSO, Zodia Markets

Andrej Majcen - Co-Founder & Group CEO, Bitcoin Suisse

Moderator: Thibaut Gravelle-Vivien - Growth Lead, Merkle Science

Networking Reception

### 2:55 PM - 3:35 PM

AI-Driven Compliance: Building the Next Generation of Financial Crime Detection

As financial crime becomes increasingly sophisticated, AI is transforming how financial institutions, fintechs, and digital asset businesses detect suspicious activity, identify emerging threats, and strengthen compliance frameworks. This panel explores how AI-driven analytics, blockchain intelligence, and real-time transaction monitoring are shaping the next generation of financial crime detection across the MENA region and globally.

Speakers will discuss practical applications of AI in AML/CFT, cross-border payments, and digital asset investigations; the challenges of balancing innovation with regulatory expectations; and how institutions can improve detection accuracy, reduce false positives, and build scalable, intelligence-led compliance programs across jurisdictions.

### 3:55 PM - 4:10 PM

Fireside Chat with Dmitry Fedotov - ADGM

A conversation with Dmitry Fedotov, Head of Emerging Markets at ADGM, hosted by Mriganka Pattnaik, CEO & Co-Founder of Merkle Science.

### 4:10 PM - 4:50 PM

Crypto Compliance in Middle East and Emerging Markets: The Gulf, Africa, and South Asia

The UAE sits at the center of capital and payment flows connecting some of the world's fastest-growing digital asset markets, including South Asia, East Africa, and the broader Middle East. This panel examines the compliance challenges unique to these corridors: high-risk jurisdiction exposure, informal value transfer networks, hawala overlaps, and the growing role of stablecoins in markets with limited banking infrastructure. Speakers will discuss how firms operating in and through the Gulf are building compliance programs calibrated for this specific risk environment.

### 5:05 PM - 5:45 PM

Sovereign Wealth, Family Offices, and the Institutionalization of Digital Assets in the Gulf

Gulf sovereign wealth funds and family offices represent some of the largest pools of investable capital in the world, and their engagement with digital assets is deepening. This panel examines how these institutions are approaching digital asset allocation, from direct investment in crypto and tokenized assets to backing infrastructure and venture, what compliance and custody standards they are requiring from counterparties, and how service providers are building to meet the expectations of the region's most sophisticated capital allocators.

### 5:45 PM - 7:00 PM

An opportunity to continue conversations, exchange insights, and connect with fellow industry leaders and decision-makers.

### About the event

21 seats. One table. No panel, no pitch deck.

The Institutional Table is a private, invite-only dinner hosted by QuillAudits in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday, 8 December 2026, during Abu Dhabi Finance Week.

After Dubai, Singapore, and Mumbai, the table moves to Al Maryah Island. It sits on the evening of the week's asset management and private markets day, and the night before the conversation turns to fintech and digital assets.

Banks, asset managers, sovereign-linked funds, family offices, exchanges, tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers, in one room, talking about what it actually takes to put regulated assets on public chains without getting burned.

What we will talk about

Tokenization at scale: what breaks when a fund, bond or real estate structure moves onchain. Token standards including ERC-3643 and ERC-7518, ERC-4626 vaults, NAV oracles, transfer restrictions and the compliance layer around them.

Stablecoins as payment rails: reserve attestations, mint and burn controls, blacklist and freeze functions, and lessons from issuer exploits.

The institutional security bar: what a board, a regulator and a counterparty should be able to ask for before capital moves. Audits, formal verification, monitoring, key management and incident response.

What went wrong in 2026: a closed-door walkthrough of the year's institutional-grade incidents, and what teams should have caught earlier.

### Format

Seated dinner for 21. A short opening from QuillAudits, followed by moderated conversation under the Chatham House Rule. No recording, no press, no slides.

Who is at the table

Heads of digital assets, treasury and product at banks and asset managers. Founders and CxOs of tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers. Fund partners and family offices with RWA and stablecoin exposure. Regulators and policy leads by invitation.

When and where

### Tuesday, 8 December 2026

7:30 PM to 10:30 PM GST

Al Maryah Island, Abu Dhabi

Seats are confirmed personally. Registering here is a request, not a confirmation. The exact venue will be shared with confirmed guests.

### About QuillAudits

8+ years securing Web3. 1,500+ audits, 1M+ lines reviewed. 20+ RWA and tokenization protocols audited, including Plume, Lumia, Pharos and Zoth.

Full lifecycle security: AI and human audits, formal verification, OpSec, multisig review and monitoring.

## ブロックチェーン・ハッカソン 2026 \| XRPL Hackathon at Blockchain Kaigi 2026 (Tokyo)

- Record: `luma-crypto-Pw2KHoEp30Hlsz4`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)

### About the event

============== English Follows ==============

### ブロックチェーン・ハッカソン 2026

ハッカソンのテーマ：期限付き支援による災害救援金の給付

参加チームは、災害救援金を XRP Ledger（XRPL）上でプログラム可能・期限付き・監査可能な支援に変え、Ripple USD（RLUSD）で決済する、実際に動作する概念実証（PoC）を構築します。目指すのは、検証済みの被災者に支援が数か月ではなく数分で届き、1円・1ドルに至るまで端から端まで追跡でき、使われない資金が滞留せず自動的に再循環することを示すデモです。

地震、洪水、サイクロン、熱波の後、支援は遅く、不透明で、しばしば漏れが生じます。例えば、カナダでは災害支援が全額行き渡るまでに平均で約7年かかります。ドイツ・アール渓谷の300億ユーロの基金は、5年が経過しても配分済みは5分の1にとどまりました。米国連邦緊急事態管理庁（FEMA）は、本人確認と住所確認を事前に行わなかったため、ハリケーン・カトリーナおよびリタの申請において推定10億ドル（16%）を不適切または不正に支払いました。2024年の能登半島地震の後、石川県当局は支援を必要とする人を特定できませんでした。

### PoCは、以下の4つの失敗モードに対処する必要があります。

PoCで示すべきこと：コード化されたルールに基づく数分以内の給付

PoCで示すべきこと：被災者データベースと照合した、本人確認に紐づく受給資格の判定

PoCで示すべきこと：同一の受益者に届く各ドナー層の資金を個別に追跡可能

PoCで示すべきこと：期限付きの配分が自動的に失効し、返還される

- スピード
- 現状の問題点：被害認定・申請・承認が逐次的かつ手作業で行われる
- 対象の特定と漏出
- 現状の問題点：本人確認・住所確認が事前に行われない、あるいは確認が過剰で何も支払われない
- ドナーにとっての不透明性
- 現状の問題点：資金がプールされ、どのドナーも自らの資金の行き先を示せない
- 資金の滞留
- 現状の問題点：未請求の配分が、機能していない事業の中に固定されたままになる

### 実装すべき4つのレイヤーは以下のとおりです。

受給資格の検証。AIを活用した被害オラクルが、衛星・地理空間データによる評価（浸水範囲、震度、地表面温度）を、地上センサー、気象データ、位置情報付きの報告と統合し、ゾーンごとの被害スコアを算出します。模擬的な政府デジタルIDの照合により、申請者が被災ゾーンに居住していることを確認します。

プログラム可能な給付。XRPLのエスクローが、プログラムごとのルール（基本給付金、世帯あたりの上限、被害度に応じた区分、繰り返し被災した世帯への上乗せ）に従い、所定額のRLUSDを検証済みのウォレットに払い出します。

多層的なドナー資金フロー。国、都道府県、国際ドナーからの拠出金は、それぞれ固有の条件（地域、被災者区分、利用期間、使途）を伴い、個別に追跡可能な状態を保ったまま同一の受益者に決済されます。

失効と返還。すべての配分には期限があります。請求されなかったエスクロー資金は、期間終了時にプールまたは拠出元のドナーに返還されます。これこそが、本設計を単なる「速い銀行振込」と区別する特徴です。

### シナリオの例。いずれかを選ぶか、独自のシナリオを提案してください。

- 都市型地震：震度に基づくゾーンのスコアリング、高齢者や通信環境の乏しい受益者、繰り返し被災した場合の上乗せ給付、オフラインまたは代理による請求
- 河川洪水：迅速な少額給付と時間を要する高額給付を同一の基盤上で実行、条件の異なる市町村・州・連邦の各層
- 沿岸暴風雨：不正の圧力下での大量給付、重複する2つの災害にまたがる二重申請の検知
- 熱波：事前に特定された脆弱層、行動を促す少額給付、数日単位の失効期間、大規模な返還

### 成果物の目安

Testnetにデプロイされた、XRPLのエスクローおよび決済ロジック。テスト用資金はXRPLフォーセット（xrpl.org/resources/dev-tools/xrp-faucets）から取得できます。 (https://xrpl.org/resources/dev-tools/xrp-faucets）から取得できます。)

被害オラクルとIDブリッジ（使用したデータソースと、統合・スコアリングの手法を含む）

条件の異なる2者以上のドナーを扱う、多層ドナー・ルールエンジン

配分・給付・失効・返還を表示する、ドナーおよび管理者向けダッシュボード

前提条件、脅威モデル、および実運用に必要となる条件についての簡潔な説明文書

チームは、従来の決済システムでは同等に実現できない働きをXRPLのどのプリミティブが担っているのかを、一文で説明できる必要があります。データベース上でも同じように動作するソリューションは減点されます。

参加条件

本ハッカソンは、居住地を問わずどなたでも参加できます。参加登録は必須で、リモート参加も可能です。

チームは1～6名で構成し、産業界と学術界のメンバーの混成も可能です。チームの全メンバーは、共通のチーム名でLumaに個別に登録してください。

すべての参加者は、オープニング、ピッチ、クロージングの各セッションに必ず対面で出席しなければなりません。

PoCはXRPLプロトコルを使用し、XRPL Testnet上にデプロイしてください。メインネットでの価値の移転は禁止です。

チームは、審査員による審査のため、デモの画面録画（3～5分）を提出しなければなりません。

課題の4つのレイヤー（受給資格の検証、プログラム可能な給付、多層的なドナー資金フロー、失効と返還）のすべてがデモ動画に含まれている必要があり、少なくとも1回は失効と返還を実演してください。

チームは、コードベースのGitHubリポジトリのリンクを、前提条件と脅威モデルに関する説明文書とともに共有しなければなりません。

仮想マシンまたはコンテナ化されたビルドを推奨します。審査時のデプロイ作業を最小限に抑えたソリューションは、特に考慮されます。

審査員は、オフチェーンのロジックへの依存を最小限に抑えたうえでの機能の網羅性を評価します。ID情報には、模擬データまたは合成データのみ使用できます。

参加登録とスケジュール

- 12月1日 23:59：参加登録締切
- 12月9日 14:00～16:40：ハッカソン・キックオフ
- 12月10日～11日 10:30～17:00：コーディングセッション（メンターアワーあり）
- 12月11日 23:59：提出締切
- 12月12日 11:00～11:40：選抜された10チームによるピッチ
- 12月12日 12:50～13:20：ハッカソン表彰式

時刻はすべて日本標準時（JST、UTC+9）です。

XRPLプロトコルについて

XRP Ledgerは、決済のために設計された、パブリックかつ分散型のレイヤー1ブロックチェーンです。トランザクションは3～5秒で決済され、確定的なファイナリティを備えています。つまり、トランザクションは確定するか失効するかのいずれかであり、保留状態のまま残ることはありません。手数料は1セントに満たず、事前に把握できます。

以下のリソースは、開発を始める際やハッカソン期間中に役立ちます。

XRPLでのコーディングを学ぶ：learn.xrpl.org (https://learn.xrpl.org)

ドキュメント、およびTestnet・Devnetのフォーセット：xrpl.org (https://xrpl.org)

XRPL Commons（コミュニティ、GitHub、YouTubeチャンネル）：xrpl-commons.org (https://xrpl-commons.org)

XRPL Developer Discordでは、ハッカソン期間中にプロトコルに関する質問ができます。

XRPLの基礎：docs.xrpl-commons.org/xrpl-basics (https://docs.xrpl-commons.org/xrpl-basics)

また、Rippleが2026年6月9日に公開したXRPL AI Starter Kit（Agentic Transactions）も活用できます。AIエージェントやAIを活用する開発者が、コーディングツールから直接、XRPLのウォレットと決済を構築し、資金を供給し、運用できるようにするものです。詳細は https://xrpl.org/resources/dev-tools/ai-tools をご覧ください。

賞

12月12日にピッチを行う10チームの中から、3チームの受賞者が選ばれます。

1位：$2,500

2位：$1,500

3位：$1,000

ピッチを行う10チームすべてに参加証明書が授与されます。

主催・協賛

本ハッカソンは、京都ブロックチェーン研究センター，京都大学大学院総合生存学館，千葉工業大学が共催し、アジア太平洋地域におけるXRP Ledgerエコシステムの成長支援に取り組む非営利団体XRP Asiaの協力を得て開催されます。賞金はRippleの提供によるものです。

会場

本ハッカソンは、2026年12月9日～12日に千葉工業大学 東京スカイツリータウンキャンパス（東京ソラマチ8階、東京都）で開催されるBlockchain Kaigi 2026（https://www.blockchainkyoto.org/en/bck26）のサテライトイベントです。

お問い合わせは、Rafik HADFI（rafik dot hadfi at i.kyoto-u.ac.jp (https://i.kyoto-u.ac.jp)）までご連絡ください。

### Hackathon Theme: Disaster Relief Disbursement with Time-Bound Aid

Teams build a working proof of concept that turns disaster relief money into programmable, expiring, auditable aid on the XRP Ledger (XRPL), settled in Ripple USD (RLUSD).

The success consists in a demo in which aid reaches a verified survivor in minutes rather than months, every yen or dollar must be traceable end to end, and idle money recycles itself instead of sitting in a backlog.

After earthquakes, floods, cyclones and heatwaves, aid is slow, opaque and often leaky.

For example, full disaster aid takes about seven years on average to flow in Canada.

The €30 billion Ahr valley fund was one-fifth allocated five years on.

FEMA paid an estimated $1 billion (16%) in improper or fraudulent Katrina/Rita claims because identity and address were never validated upfront.

After the 2024 Noto earthquake, Ishikawa authorities could not identify who needed help.

Your proof of concept must address the four following failure modes:

1.

Speed

Problem: Assessment, application and approval are sequential and manual

- What the PoC must show: Release within minutes under encoded rules

2.

Targeting and leakage

Problem: No upfront identity or address validation, or so much that nothing is paid

- What the PoC must show: Identity-linked eligibility resolved against a victim database

3.

Donor opacity

Problem: Pooled funds, no donor can show where its money landed

- What the PoC must show: Each donor layer separately traceable to the same beneficiary

4.

Idle capital

Problem: Unclaimed allocations stay locked in dead programmes

- What the PoC must show: Time-bound allocations that expire and revert automatically

The four layers to implement are:

1.

Verified eligibility.

An AI-assisted damage oracle fuses satellite and geospatial assessments (flood extent, shake intensity, land surface temperature) with ground sensors, weather and geolocated reports into a per-zone damage score.

A mock government digital identity check confirms the claimant lives in an affected zone.

2.

Programmable disbursement.

XRPL Escrow releases a defined RLUSD amount to the verified wallet under per-programme rules: base grants, household caps, severity tiers, top-ups for repeat-hit households.

3.

Layered donor flows.

National, prefectural and international donor contributions each carry their own conditions (geography, victim category, spending window, permitted use) and settle into the same beneficiary while staying separately traceable.

4.

Expiry and reversion.

Every allocation is time-bound.

Unclaimed escrowed funds revert to the pool or originating donor when the window closes.

This is the feature that distinguishes the design from a faster bank transfer.

Tracks and example scenarios (pick one or propose your own)

### Track 1

Urban earthquake

Zone scoring from shake intensity, elderly and low-connectivity beneficiaries, repeat-disaster top-ups, offline or delegated claiming

### Track 2

Riverine flood

Fast small grant and slow large tranche on one rail; municipal, state and federal layers with different conditions

### Track 3

Coastal storm

High-volume disbursement under fraud pressure; duplicate-claim detection across two overlapping disasters

Tack 4.

Heatwave

Pre-identified vulnerable cohort, small behavioural payouts, days-long expiry windows, reversion at scale

Suggested deliverables

XRPL escrow and settlement logic deployed on Testnet.

Test funds can be obtained from the XRPL faucet at xrpl.org/resources/dev-tools/xrp-faucets (https://xrpl.org/resources/dev-tools/xrp-faucets).

Layered-donor rule engine with at least two donors carrying different conditions

- Damage oracle and identity bridge, with data sources and the fusion or scoring method used
- Dashboard for donors and administrators showing allocation, release, expiry and reversion
- Short written note on assumptions, threat model, and what would need to be true for a real deployment

Teams should be able to state in one sentence which XRPL primitive does work that a conventional payment system cannot do as well.

Solutions that would run equally happily on a database will be marked down.

### Participation Criteria

The hackathon is open to all, regardless of geographic location.

Registration is mandatory, and remote participation is allowed.

- The teams may have up to 1-6 members and may mix industry and academia.

All team members register individually on Luma under a common team name.

- All participants MUST attend the opening, pitching, and closing sessions in person.
- The proof of concept must use the XRPL protocol, deployed on XRPL Testnet.

No mainnet value transfer.

- Teams must submit a screen recording of their demo (3 to 5 minutes) for review by the judges.
- All four layers of the challenge (verified eligibility, programmable disbursement, layered donor flows, expiry and reversion) must be present in the demo video, including at least one live expiry and reversion.
- Teams must share a GitHub repository link for their codebase, together with the written note on assumptions and threat model.
- Virtual machines or containerised builds are recommended.

Solutions that minimise deployment effort during evaluation receive special consideration.

- The jury judges feature coverage with minimum reliance on off-chain logic.

Only mock or synthetic identity data may be used.

### Registration & Timeline

December 1, 23:59 - Registration closes

December 9, 14:00-16:40 - Hackathon Kickoff

December 10-11 10:30AM-5PM - Coding sessions with scheduled mentor hours

December 11, 23:59 - Submission deadline

December 12, 11:00-11:40 - Pitches from 10 shortlisted teams.

December 12, 12:50-13:20 - Hackathon Awards Ceremony

All times are Japan Standard Time (JST, UTC+9).

### Know About the XRPL Protocol

The XRP Ledger is a public, decentralised layer-1 blockchain designed for payments.

Transactions settle in 3 to 5 seconds with deterministic finality, meaning they either confirm or expire and never sit pending.

Fees are a fraction of a cent and are known in advance.

The following resources will help you get started and support you throughout the hackathon.

XRPL Commons offers a community along with GitHub and YouTube channels at xrpl-commons.org (https://xrpl-commons.org).

The XRPL Developer Discord is the place to ask protocol questions during the hackathon.

XRPL Basics at docs.xrpl-commons.org/xrpl-basics (https://docs.xrpl-commons.org/xrpl-basics).

- Learn to code on the XRPL at learn.xrpl.org (https://learn.xrpl.org).
- Documentation and the Testnet and Devnet faucets are available at xrpl.org (https://xrpl.org).

Teams may also wish to explore the XRPL AI Starter Kit (Agentic Transactions), released by Ripple on June 9, 2026.

It lets AI agents and AI-assisted developers build, fund and operate XRPL wallets and payments directly from their coding tools.

See https://xrpl.org/resources/dev-tools/ai-tools.

### Awards

Three winners are selected from the ten teams that pitch on December 12:

- First prize: $2,500
- Second prize: $1,500
- Third prize: $1,000

All ten pitching teams receive a certificate of participation.

This Hackathon is co-hosted by Kyoto University, Chiba Institute of Technology, with assistance from XRP Asia, a non-profit dedicated to supporting the growth of the XRP Ledger ecosystem in APAC.

### About the event

I The European financial landscape is changing rapidly. Stablecoins, tokenized deposits and tokenized securities are introducing new opportunities, challenging traditional business models and transforming how financial institutions operate.

But what does this mean for banks, fintechs, technology providers and the wider digital asset industry?

On December 10, EY and BCNL Foundation are joining forces in Amsterdam for the Digital Money & Markets Forum, bringing together financial institutions, regulators, fintechs and digital asset leaders to explore the future of Europe's financial ecosystem.

Expect an afternoon filled with expert insights, high-level discussions, interactive debates and valuable networking opportunities.

### From innovation to implementation

The digital asset industry is moving beyond experimentation. As adoption increases and European regulation continues to develop, organizations face important strategic decisions.

Where are the real business opportunities? How can Europe remain competitive? What does it take to implement digital asset solutions securely and successfully? And how can organizations navigate the growing complexity of regulation and compliance?

During the forum, we'll explore these questions from both a strategic and practical perspective, covering topics including:

Technology & implementation: Overcoming technical challenges, managing operational risks and meeting DORA requirements.

Regulation & compliance: Navigating MiCA, DORA and DAC8 while continuing to innovate.

Real-world adoption: Learning from practical experiences, successful implementations and challenges faced by industry participants.

- Digital money & tokenization: The opportunities emerging from stablecoins, tokenized deposits and tokenized securities.
- European competitiveness: Building a resilient and competitive European digital financial ecosystem.

### Interactive breakout sessions

Beyond the mainstage discussions, attendees will have the opportunity to participate in one of two interactive breakout sessions.

### Connect with the industry

The Digital Money & Markets Forum is not just about sharing knowledge. It's also about bringing together the people and organizations driving innovation across traditional finance and digital assets.

Connect with professionals from banks, fintechs, financial institutions, technology companies and the wider blockchain ecosystem.

We'll close the afternoon with networking drinks, giving everyone the opportunity to continue conversations, exchange ideas and build new relationships.

### Event details

Date: Thursday, December 10, 2026 Time: 13:00. 18:00 Location: EY, Amsterdam Ticket price: €37,70 inc VAT Limited capacity: 100 attendees

### Program

The detailed agenda and speaker lineup will be announced soon.

### Secure your spot

With only 100 places available, the Digital Money & Markets Forum offers an opportunity to connect with a focused group of professionals from across the financial and digital asset industry.

Whether you're working in traditional finance, fintech, compliance, technology or digital assets, join us for an afternoon of knowledge sharing, practical insights and meaningful connections.

Register now and join EY and BCNL Foundation on December 10 in Amsterdam!

### About the event

Quem consegue mover os fundos na sua aplicação? Se a resposta for "uma pessoa só", você tem um risco interno.

A maioria dos incidentes graves de custódia não vem de um atacante externo sofisticado. Vem de alguém com acesso demais: um desenvolvedor com a chave no ambiente, um operador que cria e aprova a mesma transação, um servidor online que assina o que lhe pedem.

Vamos mostrar na prática como desenhar isso fora do sistema, com uma demonstração na rede Stellar usando a DINAMO Cold Wallet:

Segregação de funções. Quem monta a transação (ambiente online) não é quem assina (estação fria air-gapped). Nenhum dos dois faz o trabalho do outro.

Divisão de responsabilidade. A chave nasce e vive dentro do HSM. Os fragmentos da cerimônia de chaves são distribuídos e conferidos por KCV. Ninguém, sozinho, tem a chave completa.

Verificação independente. A estação fria exibe os campos decodificados da transação e códigos de validação (AES-256-CMAC). Quem aprova confere o que realmente vai ser assinado, não que o sistema online diz que vai.

Sem superfície de rede. A estação de assinatura não tem conexão com o ambiente online. A única ponte são envelopes selados em QR code. Não há canal para um atacante interno explorar.

No fim, você vê uma transação Stellar ser montada online → validada e assinada offline → publicada → confirmada na rede.

Para quem desenvolve em fintech, blockchain, custódia ou segurança: é um exemplo concreto de secure by design, em que o controle está na arquitetura e não na confiança nas pessoas.

#DesenvolvimentoSeguro #SecureByDesign #AmeaçaInterna #SegregaçãoDeFunções #Stellar #Blockchain #HSM #ColdWallet #Custódia #DINAMO

CWC x Sosoul: A Breathwork Evening Two hours, n

: -, just space to breathe, slow down, and reset with the Crypto Women Collective community. About this event: When the week fills up, the first thing we drop is never the deadline. It's the twenty minutes we promised ourselves, the ones that don't belong to a client, a to-do list, or anyone but us. We thought this would be something for our members: a breathwork session hosted at the beautiful Sosoul Amsterdam (https://www.instagram.com/sosoul.nl/). No crypto talk, no networking pressure, just space to reset and be with other women from the community without a

:

attached. Never done breathwork before? It's a guided practice using conscious breathing patterns to shift your nervous system out of fight-or-flight and into actual rest. No experience needed, you just show up and breathe

:

Walk in between 19:30 and 20:00, doors close right at 20:00 when the breathwork starts. From there, our guide takes the group through a full breathwork practice designed to release tension you didn't even know you were holding, the kind that sitting still never quite reaches. Come as you are; loose, comfortable clothing helps. Mats and props are provided. Afterward, there's a few quiet minutes to notice how you feel, and time to talk with the person next to you or whoever's in the room, before we close out around 22:00. Your guide: Marieke Lintz (https://www.instagram.com/marieke.breathes/) is a breathwork coach and a CWC member herself.

She'll lead the group through the practice and hold space for whatever comes up in the room.  Details Thursday 10 December 19:30 doors

- 20:00 breathwork starts
- 22:00 end Sosoul, Anjeliersstraat 46-H, Amsterdam (https://www.instagram.com/sosoul.nl/) €27,50 for CWC members (usually €55) Max 12 spots Not yet part of the Crypto Women Collective? Crypto Women Collective is a growing community of 300+, from complete beginners to people already building careers in the space. FAQ: Do I need any experience with breathwork? No. This session works whether you've never tried it or you do it every week. What should I bring or wear? Comfortable, loose-fitting clothing. Mats and props are provided at the venue. Can I arrive a little later than 19:30? Please don't leave it too late, doors close at 20:00 sharp when the breathwork begins, and once the practice starts we can't let latecomers in without disrupting the group. Good to know Photo & Video: We may take photos and video at this event for our website and social media. Prefer not to be photographed? Just let our team know on arrival. More on how we handle your data in our Privacy & Cookie Policy (https://cryptowomencollective.com/privacy-cookie-policy?utm_source=luma). Refunds: Plans change, we get it. You can cancel for a full refund until 2 December (7 days before the event). After that, we can't refund your ticket. We book and pay for the venue in advance, and with only 12 spots, every seat counts. Can't make it after all? You're welcome to pass your spot on to a friend, just let us know who's coming in your place. If we ever need to cancel, you'll get a full refund. As tickets are for a specific date, the 14-day withdrawal right doesn't apply. Staying in touch: With your ticket, you'll also receive occasional updates about upcoming CWC events. Not for you? Just unsubscribe in any email. By getting a ticket, you agree to our Terms & Conditions. Questions? Reach out at contact@cryptowomencollective.com, we're happy to help.

Join the Bitcoin District Book Club! We meet every month to explore new rabbit holes by reading books that are popular with bitcoiners.

This December, we're reading Resistance Money: A Philosophical Case for Bitcoin by Andrew Bailey, Bradley Rettler, and Craig Warmke. We'll be joined by one of the authors, Andrew Bailey, for a live discussion.

The authors argue that bitcoin is "resistance money," a form of money that resists censorship, confiscation, and inflation. They make the case from philosophy, drawing on ideas about money, freedom, and justice.

### About the event

Welcome to The Studio Workshop Series: sessions designed for founders who are building right now. Each workshop takes one skill that directly affects how you fundraise, grow, or ship, and breaks it down into concrete steps you can apply to your own startup.:

- : Doors open 5:30 PM: Workshop 6:30 PM: Networkin

About the workshop Every team building onchain is a target. Attackers move fast, from wallet drainers and fake tokens to exploits that trick users into signing something different from what they saw. The better you understand how these attacks work, the better you can design against them. Join Meg Yodfat and Noah Newfield from Blockaid (https://www.blockaid.io/) to break down the threats hitting builders today and how to stop them. We'll walk through real attack patterns, map them to a security lifecycle for building dApps, from threat modeling and audits to deployment, and show how teams use real-time monitoring and transaction validation to protect protocols and users once they're live.

Bring your questions and a product or flow you'd like pressure-tested.  We'll use teams in the room as live case studies, and you'll leave with a practical security checklist for your own build

### About the speaker

Meg Yodfat (https://il.linkedin.com/in/megal-yodfat) Meg is Director of Customer Success at Blockaid, where she partners with every customer, from leading wallets and exchanges to chains and onchain protocols, to shape their security strategy and defend against threats ranging from wallet drainers and phishing to protocol exploits. She brings over a decade of experience in business development, partnerships, and revenue leadership. Before Blockaid, she was Head of Revenue at Infront Lab, led business development and partnerships at the blockchain startup Leeway, co-founded the startup Bobe

Noah Newfield (https://www.linkedin.com/in/noah-newfield-208a40129) Noah's been in crypto for 9+ years. He's worked on GTM at companies like Uniswap, Share, and Conduit. Prior to Blockaid he built a Stablecoin consumer company in YCombinator. He's now on the Customer Success team at Blockaid where he helps clients solve their most pressing security and business proble

About Blockaid (https://www.blockaid.io/) is the security layer behind the world's leading crypto platforms, protecting users, assets, and business operations from fraud, exploits, and malicious activity at scale

About The Studio The Studio (https://thestudio.monad.xyz/?utm_source=luma)is Monad Foundation's founder workspace in the heart of Manhattan, where early-stage teams building on Monad work side by side. It is 100% equity-free: zero equity, zero fees. Teams get dedicated desks, hands-on support on pitch, GTM, and fundraising, and direct access to the VCs, angels, and mentors who work from the space alongside them. Interested in building on Monad and want in? Learn more and apply at https://thestudio.monad.xyz

About Monad Foundation The Monad Foundation (https://www.monad.foundation/?utm_source=luma)is an independent organization dedicated to encouraging the development and adoption of the Monad blockchain protocol, an ultra-high-performant EVM L1 blockchain. Monad offers the best of both worlds: unrivaled performance (10,000 transactions per second) and portability (full-compatibility for Ethereum smart contracts)

### About the event

Em Dezembro de 2026, reinauguramos a Casa NUA como o 1o Museu permanente de Arte em Rede Descentralizada do Brasil, institucionalizando a fusão do tangível com o digital. Nossa missão é expor e valorizar as obras de arte digitais, conectando o público tradicional aos novos paradigmas da web3, e nesse processo, impulsionar a arte brasileira para o mundo. Através de curadorias cuidadosas e educativas, a Casa NUA se posiciona como um espaço onde a arte digital pode ser apreciada e compreendida em seu pleno valor, integrando cultura e propriedade de forma descentralizada e acessível.

Para a inauguração, relançamos NFT Sampa, evento bimestral para congregar a comunidade local em torno da descentralizção, cultura cripto e Arte em Rede, com exposições, talks, ativações e apresentações ao vivo.

A descentralização é uma tendência histórica que os NFTs intensificam, criando uma infraestrutura resistente à censura para a arte e outros bens digitais. A natureza não-permissionada dos NFTs permite a livre criação e troca de registros públicos com proveniência assegurada e transações sem intermediários. Isso fortalece a liberdade de transação e a disseminação de mitos culturais de maneira global e acessível, representando ainda uma oportunidade única para artistas de qualquer parte do mundo.

É com muita alegria que celebramos mais essa edição do NFT Sampa e recebemos a comunidade para uma noite de muita cultura, boas conversas, negócios e diversão!

Sejam bem vindas, bem vindos e bem vindes!

O NFT Sampa é realizado pela Casa NUA com recursos do #ProAC2024 CultSP (Programa de Ação Cultural da Secretaria de Cultura, Economia e Indústria Criativas) através da #PNAB (Política Nacional Aldir Blanc), do Ministério da Cultura.

Bitcoin Masterclass: Learn the Why Before You Buy Powered by Bitcoincierge

Join us in Gurugram for a BTC masterclass that breaks down Bitcoin from first principles and explores its role in financial world.

- Investors seeking diversification beyond traditional assets
- Working professionals and creators curious about how money is changing

About ZebPay We're ZebPay, one of India's oldest and most trusted crypto exchanges, serving over 6 million registered users since 2014.

ZebPay has a strong global presence, with four offices located across India in Mumbai, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, and Delhi.

ZebPay has facilitated over $22 billion in trading volume to date.

Our mission is simple -> to make Bitcoin and digital assets accessible, secure, and understandable for everyone.

About Bitcoincierge is a Bitcoin-focused concierge desk, supported by experienced Bitcoin mentors and educators.

Our role is not to sell hype or push products - but to walk individuals and families through their Bitcoin journey responsibly, step by step.

Bitcoincierge helps users:

1. Understand Bitcoin from first principles 2. Choose the right tools for buying and holding Bitcoin safely 3. Learn self-custody and security best practices 4. Think through inheritance, succession, and tax considerations 5. Avoid common mistakes that new users often make

This masterclass is an entry point into that journey - designed to replace confusion with clarity and empower attendees to make informed decisions with confidence.

## Snowfro: Press Start

- Record: `luma-crypto-e2QCeRofQ0RK7GU`
- Source: [luma-crypto-events.json](sources/luma-crypto-events.json)
- Starts: 2027-01-23T02:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/node-snowfro>

### About the event

NODE is pleased to announce Snowfro: Press Start, an interactive exhibition of Erick Calderon's art, code, and play.

Erick is a pioneering figure and a central node in the onchain generative art community. As artist and entrepreneur, he treats code as a living medium and dedicates himself to elevating this practice within the world of contemporary art.

At the center of Calderon's practice is a belief that art can be playful and interactive. This aligns with NODE's focus on digital art education through participation rather than mere observation. Five principal works, created between 2020 and 2026, were selected for the exhibition and reveal a carefully woven story across technology and time.

Snowfro: Press Start arrives at a moment of reflection and renewal. Across more than a decade of making art, and through the intense, formative years surrounding the creation of Chromie Squiggle and Art Blocks, Calderon's practice has evolved through experimentation, ambition, and persistence.

For the first time, NODE offers an opportunity to gather these threads and look back at the ideas that have shaped his path as an artist.

### About the event

Lunch will be provided. Submit your pitch here (https://keio-chainhack-2027.mailchimpsites.com).

A global AI & Web3 startup pitch competition bringing together students, aspiring entrepreneurs, early-stage founders, investors, and industry leaders.

Showcase your innovative ideas, gain direct exposure to venture capital investors and industry experts, and connect with decision-makers shaping the future of AI and Web3.

Date: Saturday, January 30, 2027

Time: 1:00 PM - 6:00 PM JST

Venue: TKP Garden City PREMIUM Tamachi, Tokyo, Japan & Online

Pitch Your Startup to Venture Capital Investors

Building something innovative in AI, Web3, or both?

Apply for the opportunity to pitch your project directly to venture capital investors, industry experts, and investment decision-makers.

Whether you're developing an AI-powered solution, blockchain infrastructure, a decentralized application, or an entirely new business model, we welcome innovative ideas addressing real-world problems.

Both early-stage concepts and existing startups are welcome. Prototypes and tokenomics are not required.

Application details and registration link to be announced.

### About Keio ChainHack 2027

Keio ChainHack 2027 is a collaborative initiative between Keio FinTEK Center and Taisu Ventures, designed to bridge academia and industry through a global startup pitch competition focused on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Web3.

The event brings together students, startup founders, researchers, investors, and industry professionals from Japan and abroad to showcase emerging technologies, exchange ideas, and explore new business opportunities.

Participants will present their business concepts to a panel of venture capital investors, with the top three teams earning the opportunity to present their projects directly to venture capital partners for further consideration.

Beyond the competition, attendees will hear directly from Taisu Ventures' portfolio companies, gain insights into emerging AI and Web3 investment trends, and connect with founders, investors, and industry leaders through dedicated networking sessions.

### About the event

東京大学ブロックチェーンイノベーション寄付講座 (https://www.blockchain.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp/)が主催する本イベントでは、『ビットコイン・スタンダード (https://www.minervashobo.co.jp/book/b577558.html?utm_source=luma)』(ミネルヴァ書房)の内容をもとに、参加者間での議論を行います。

会場には本書の翻訳者である練木照子 (https://www.amazon.co.jp/stores/練木照子/author/B09F3CC33B)氏をお招きし、また、本書の著者であり1月に新著 The Fiat Standard (https://thesaifhouse.com/products/tfs-hardcover) 邦訳版の出版を控えるSaifedean Ammous (https://saifedean.com/)氏からのビデオメッセージも上映する予定です。

### 著者への質問募集

イベントに先立ち、Saifedean Ammous (https://saifedean.com/)氏(X:@saifedean (https://x.com/saifedean))への質問を募集します。

質問は、Xでハッシュタグ「#bitcoinstandardUTokyo」を付けてご投稿ください。締切は11月30日です。

Ammous氏の回答は、イベント当日に上映するビデオメッセージに収録する予定です。

### タイムテーブル

Kensuke ITO(東京大学大学院工学系研究科 特任研究員)

ichinaka(日本ビットコイン産業株式会社)

Saifedean Ammous (https://saifedean.com/)氏(『ビットコイン・スタンダード』著者)

- 14:45 第1部 ディスカッション:参加者の発表をもとに、練木氏の私見を交えながら全員で議論

### About the event

Et si l'un des derniers grands réservoirs d'Alpha liquide se trouvait aujourd'hui dans les actifs numériques?

Le mercredi 3 février 2027 à 18h, Rcube Asset Management réunira à l'Hôtel Le Marois, à Paris, 100 investisseurs pour la troisième édition du Rcube Crypto Alpha Talk.

Cette année, nous explorerons l'un des quatre piliers de l'Alpha sur actifs numériques: la finance décentralisée (DeFi). Nous montrerons comment la gestion d'actifs on-chain peut générer de nouvelles sources de rendement liquide, décorrélés et diversifiantes.

La tokenisation fait entrer un nombre croissant d'actifs financiers et réels sur les marchés on-chain. Au-delà de la transformation des infrastructures financières, cette évolution crée de nouveaux marchés, de nouvelles inefficiences et, avec elles, de nouvelles opportunités de génération d'Alpha.

Comment identifier et capturer ces opportunités? C'est ce que nous vous proposons de découvrir le 3 février.

Après un panorama des opportunités d'Alpha dans les actifs numériques, nous donnerons la parole à deux équipes DeFi sélectionnées par Rcube, qui présenteront concrètement leurs stratégies de génération de rendement on-chain:

Steakhouse Financial. L'un des principaux curateurs DeFi au monde, avec 4,7 milliards de dollars d'actifs sous gestion. Sébastien Derivaux reviendra sur le développement de Steakhouse et expliquera comment son équipe génère du rendement tout en maîtrisant les risques.

Ellen Capital. Première équipe DeFi intégrée à Rcube. Nataniel Elkaim et Amaury Deny présenteront leur approche de l'investissement on-chain et les opportunités qu'ils exploitent.

Le Rcube Crypto Alpha Talk n'est pas une conférence crypto généraliste. Il réunit exclusivement des investisseurs et allocateurs. Family Offices, UHNWI, banques privées, CGP et institutionnels. souhaitant comprendre et accéder à ces nouvelles sources d'Alpha.

## Off the Beaten Vine: CWC wine tasting

- Record: `luma-crypto-3cQwJwuytLCWPrp`

### About the event

Most wine on our shelves comes from a handful of big names. Some of the best bottles never make it that far.

For our first evening of 2027, Crypto Women Collective is teaming up with Alyssa Gammoudy of Mijn Wijnproeverij. By day, Alyssa is a crypto journalist. Beyond that, she brings the same curiosity to wine. She works with smaller, lesser known wine houses in France: family producers making exceptional wine without access to the big markets. She finds them, tastes with them and brings their bottles to people who would never otherwise come across them.

This February, she's bringing seven of them to us.

### THE TASTING

Round 1: a bubble to start

Rounds 2 to 4: three whites

Rounds 5 and 6: two reds

Round 7: a dessert wine to finish

Alyssa will share the story behind each house and what to taste for, with bites to go with the wines. Like every CWC evening, it's also a room full of women to meet, catch up with and swap stories with.

### GOOD TO KNOW

Duration: about two hours

Ticket: €25, which comes back to you as credit on your first order with Alyssa

Food: bites are served alongside the wines, so come straight from work

Places: we're keeping it small, with 15 places, so there's room for real conversation

Experience: none needed with wine or with crypto. Just come curious

Gift: looking for a present? A ticket makes a lovely one

- Small producers: every order supports a small, independent wine house

We can't wait to raise a glass with you.

### About the event

ZIG Summit 2027 (https://summit.zig.finance)

Nothing compounds alone.

Capital. Products. Infrastructure. Distribution. Together.

On 25 March 2027, ZIG Finance (https://zig.finance/?utm_source=luma) brings together the people building, funding and powering the next era of onchain finance for one day in Dubai.

Why attend?

Capital, product, regulated infrastructure and distribution. ZIG Summit brings all four sides of the market to the same table, alongside the community driving onchain finance forward.

- Meet the capital: allocators, asset managers, family offices and institutions looking at investable onchain products.
- Find distribution: banks, platforms and distributors across the UAE and beyond.
- See what is launching: tokenized funds, private credit and structured yield brought to market.
- Get practical on regulation: the rules that decide where products can be issued, distributed and accessed, including the UAE and emerging markets.
- Keep the conversation going: a curated room built for business, with networking from stablecoins to custody one conversation away.

What we will cover

- Tokenized financial products: private credit, tokenized funds, structured yield and real-world assets
- Stablecoins and financial rails: payments, settlement, liquidity, custody and institution-ready access
- Institutional capital and distribution
- Regulation and market access
- Community and adoption

### Who should attend

The people shaping onchain finance, all in one room. From the people funding the future of onchain finance to those building its products, infrastructure and distribution, ZIG Summit brings together the businesses driving the industry forward.

- Capital allocators: asset managers, institutional investors, family offices and wealth platforms
- Financial institutions: banks, exchanges, custodians and payment firms building regulated rails
- Product originators and issuers: teams issuing tokenized funds, private credit, structured yield and real-world assets
- Builders and community: founders, developers and the wider onchain finance community

Last edition

The 2026 summit in Dubai (28 April 2026) brought together 2,000+ attendees in person, 50+ speakers and 30,000+ livestream views, with institutions representing over $3 trillion in assets.

### About ZIG Finance

ZIG Finance is the onchain finance ecosystem built on a single conviction: institutional investment opportunities belong onchain, open to everyone. That belief predates the chain. The founding team built Zignaly, an investment platform that grew past 600,000 users on the strength of better access alone. ZIG Finance represents that same conviction at a different scale. ZIG Chain provides the institutional-grade infrastructure. ZIG Markets structures and distributes financial products across onchain and offchain channels. $ZIG sits at the economic center of the ecosystem. Together, they connect the infrastructure, products and distribution needed to bring financial activity onchain.

Speakers and partners will be announced soon. Register now to secure your place.

What Comes Next? The Next Disruption in Asset Management? Asset management has evolved in distinct waves, each driven by structural innovation and enabled by technology: 1770s: Closed-End Funds 1920s: Open-End Mutual Funds 1970s: Index Funds 1990s: ETFs 2020s: A new paradigm emerging: Vaults? Technological innovations in digital trading and programmatic trading gave rise to ETFs in the 1990s, which now account for around $20 trillion in AUM. Technology continues to evolve, and with it comes the next major disruption in asset management. Is the next reinvention of asset management already unfolding before us?

The real question is not whether asset management will continue to be reinvented, but which investors will identify the next structural change early enough to benefit from it?  This forum will explore exactly that

### About the event

We look forward to welcoming you to our Swell 2026 Demo Day, hosted in Ripple's New York office.

Doors open at 1:45 PM, with the program beginning at 2:30 PM and a networking reception with light bites to follow.

Demo Day Agenda

1:45 - 2:30 PM - Doors open & arrival

2:30 - 2:55 PM - Welcome, keynote & program overviews

2:55 - 3:30 PM - Startup pitches (12 startups, 3 minutes each)

3:30 - 4:00 PM - Group Q&A with all founders

4:00 - 5:30 PM - Networking reception + light bites

Featured Startups

Blockpeer: End-to-end digital trade platform for issuing, financing, and managing MLETR-compliant electronic trade documents (like eBLs), with tokenized trade assets and stablecoin payments.

BlockVault: Financial infrastructure that lets XRP holders earn yield and access liquidity on their assets without selling them.

C9: Brazilian Web3 platform bringing tokenization, wallets, and crypto cards to everyday users and businesses on the XRPL.

Circles: Social feed-first investing app that lets people make micro-loans to local ventures and follow their progress like posts.

Exfil: Intelligence-led security platform that detects and disrupts scams, fraud, and threat infrastructure across the web and on-chain.

Mandla Money: WhatsApp-based stablecoin wallet enabling low-cost cross-border payments and remittances for underserved communities in emerging markets.

Mobile Wallet: Modular crypto on/off-ramp infrastructure connecting blockchains to local payment rails for the unbanked.

Regolda: Institutional-grade dashboard for tokenized recycled physical gold on the XRPL, with real-time ESG impact metrics and tax reporting.

Riskx: On-chain risk-scoring engine that writes live, machine-readable risk signals for DeFi protocols.

Straid: Decentralized credit-markets and leverage protocol on the XRPL enabling undercollateralized lending via on-chain risk scoring.

VS1: Institutional DeFi and tokenized capital-markets infrastructure on the XRPL, spanning compliant lending, swaps, and asset tokenization.

Zuvia - Crypto-as-a-Service and tokenization platform helping companies adopt Web3 and blockchain on the XRPL.

## BCNL x VBNL x PwC - CARF & DAC8 Roundtable

- Record: `luma-batch-evtMJacaICJiBqTU`
- Source: [luma-batch-events.json](sources/luma-batch-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-28T14:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/oz4zmqjc>

### About the event

The regulatory landscape for digital assets continues to evolve. With CARF and DAC8, crypto businesses and financial institutions face a new set of tax transparency, due diligence, data, and reporting requirements.

Together with PwC Netherlands, BCNL and VBNL are organizing an exclusive and highly interactive session focused entirely on what CARF and DAC8 mean in practice.

Date: 28-10-26

15:30 - 19:00

PwC Netherlands

Limited & curated attendance

### From regulation to implementation

The session will be led by PwC's team of operational tax experts, specializing in areas including FATCA/CRS, CESOP and Digital Services Taxes. The team includes a former OECD member who contributed to the development of CARF, complemented by operational tax professionals with more than 10 years of experience in the financial sector.

Rather than focusing solely on the technical regulation, this session is designed to answer the practical questions:

What does CARF/DAC8 actually mean for your organization? What do you need to prepare? Where are the known pitfalls? And what challenges are other organizations already encountering?

### The 5 Building Blocks of CARF

During the roundtable, PwC will take participants through five key areas:

1. Entity Management

Determining whether your organization falls within the scope of the regulation.

2. Product Analysis

Identifying which products and services are in scope.

3. Due Diligence

Understanding the requirements, how to implement them, and how they align with existing AML/KYC processes.

4. Reporting

What needs to be reported, where and when, which data points are required, and what this means for your organization and systems.

5. Governance Set-up

Establishing the right policies, procedures, responsibilities, and internal governance.

For each building block, we'll connect the regulatory requirements with real-world implementation, known pitfalls, and challenges PwC is seeing across the market.

### An interactive roundtable

This is deliberately a small-scale and interactive session, not a traditional conference.

The core roundtable will last approximately two hours, with plenty of room for discussion, practical cases, and questions from participants. Attendees will also have the opportunity to submit questions and topics in advance, allowing the PwC team to tailor the conversation to the challenges organizations are actually facing.

Following the session, we'll continue with drinks and networking, giving participants the opportunity to exchange experiences and connect with peers.

### Who should attend?

The session is particularly relevant for finance, tax, compliance and operational professionals working at:

Crypto exchanges - Brokers - Payment providers & PSPs - E-money institutions - Market makers - Banks & financial institutions - Other organizations active in or expanding into digital assets

Professionals from traditional financial institutions exploring or expanding their crypto activities are also very welcome.

### About PwC Netherlands

PwC Netherlands supports crypto businesses in navigating evolving tax transparency and reporting requirements, including CARF, CESOP, DAC7, and relevant domestic obligations. By combining tax, regulatory, and technology capabilities, PwC helps organizations assess their scope and build the data, systems, processes, and governance required for sustainable compliance.

### About BCNL Foundation

BCNL Foundation connects and strengthens the Dutch digital asset ecosystem by bringing together companies, financial institutions, policymakers, investors, and industry professionals through events, education, advocacy, and strategic collaboration.

About NVC (VBNL)

NVC is the Dutch CASP Association, formerly known as VBNL. Founded in 2014, NVC has a long history advocating for the interests of bitcoin- and crypto companies, promoting self-regulation, coordination with stakeholders such as legislators, regulators and law enforcement, and maintaining the highest standards of reputation and integrity. Members are: Bitvavo, MoonPay, Coinmerce, zerohash, Blockrise, BTC Direct, Bitmymoney, Blox, Fiat Republic, Acheron Trading & Finst.

Capacity is limited and registrations will be curated.

If CARF/DAC8 could impact your organization, this is an opportunity to discuss the implications directly with experts and peers before the requirements become part of day-to-day operations.

### About the event

Launchnodes and GSR Foundation co-host The Yield Layer of Social Impact on November 4, 2026, from 10:00 to 16:00 IST at IFBE, 10-12 Calicut Road, Ballard Estate, Fort, Mumbai. The organizer describes it as a half-day Devcon side event for donors, foundations, impact organizations, onchain capital providers and the protocols supporting onchain yield.

The central discussion is how staking and stablecoin yield could support social and environmental work while donors retain their principal. Sessions will examine infrastructure already built, the sources of donor capital, applications being developed on top of that infrastructure and the next steps for adoption. The planned format combines fireside conversations with yield protocols, an impact keynote and panels involving donors, foundations and builders.

The discussion includes Launchnodes' Lido Impact Staking and its Aave-based Stablecoin for Impact. These products form Impactstake.com, which connects donor capital with vetted impact organizations. The organizer describes a model in which yield goes to those organizations while principal remains staked and withdrawable. A further question is how institutions outside crypto can use this infrastructure and measure the resulting impact

Confirmed speakers

Jaydeep Korde, Launchnodes.

Christopher Fabian, UNICEF.

James Newell, GSR Foundation.

Aleksandra Gusakova, Lido Labs.

Registration is free and requires host approval. The organizer is selecting an audience that includes Indian corporate philanthropy teams, onchain capital providers, and impact organizations already using or considering onchain tools.

## Onchain Legal Summit :: Devcon India 2026

- Record: `luma-batch-kBSIe7BSMtDFldg`

- Starts: 2026-11-04T05:30:00.000Z

### About the event

Entity's third Onchain Legal Summit takes place during Devcon India on November 4, 2026, from 11:00 to 17:00 IST. The Legal & Governance Hub hosts this working summit for founders, lawyers, protocol designers and governance specialists examining the legal status of onchain entities, DAOs, AI agents and autonomous systems

Questions on the program

The announced subjects include:

How DAO governance and compliance tools fit together, and how legal text can become computable contracts.

- Agent personhood, ERC-8004 and Know Your Agent, including the legal status of autonomous protocols and whether AI agents can hold voting rights in a DAO.
- Decentralized justice and AI arbitration for real-world disputes, and the use of onchain courts to resolve disagreements within DAOs.
- Legal recognition of onchain entities, whether they can operate across borders, and the compliance obligations involved in forming and running them.
- Registry infrastructure and the design of legal entities in Solidity and other programming environments.
- Liability for autonomous code and the use of onchain civil records for marriages, death certificates and notarization.
- How lawyers might express legal processes through APIs.

The India edition also examines online dispute resolution, digital public infrastructure and what national registries can learn from open registries. The organizer has published these themes but has not yet released a detailed agenda or session timetable. Speaker and partnership inquiries can be submitted through the form linked on the event page

Admission

Participation in the summit is free for Devcon 8 attendees. A separate valid Devcon ticket is required to enter the conference venue; registering on Luma or another external site does not provide Devcon admission. The public listing gives Mumbai as the location and requires registration to see the exact event address.
