## Kundenschutz und Kryptowährungen

- Record: `luma-batch-evtzJSbBU29gOHYb`
- Source: [luma-batch-events.json](sources/luma-batch-events.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-26T11:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/5xp9r8xd>

### About the event

Die Funktion von Kryptowährungen hat sich in den letzten Jahren gewandelt. Ursprünglich als Zahlungsmittel konzipiert, werden sie heute vorwiegend zu Anlagezwecken eingesetzt. Investitionen in Kryptowährungen sind mit vielfältigen Risiken verbunden: Neben der hohen Volatilität können Sicherheitsvorfälle oder Konkurse von Dienstleistern sowie Formen des Marktmissbrauchs zu erheblichen Verlusten führen. Angesichts dieser Risiken stellt sich die Frage, wie bei Dienstleistungen mit Kryptowährungen ein angemessener Schutz von Investoren, insbesondere von Retail-Anlegern, gewährleistet werden kann.

Die beiden Referenten zeigen anhand ausgewählter Aspekte auf, wie der Kundenschutz nach geltendem Recht ausgestaltet ist und welche Weiterentwicklungen im Rahmen der geplanten Änderung des Finanzinstitutsgesetzes vorgesehen sind.

12.15 Einführung Ass.-Prof. Dr. Claude Humbel, ZIBR

12.20 Kundenschutz de lege lata Dr. Stefan Härtner, Finma

12.35 Kundenschutz de lege ferenda Dr. Fabrice Eckert, Homburger AG

12.50 Diskussion / Q&A Moderation: Ass.-Prof. Dr. Claude Humbel, ZIBR

### About the event

🇨🇭 The Wealth Tech Executive Forum (https://wealthtech-executiveforum.com/): Geneva Edition is an invite-only executive series for senior leaders in asset and wealth management shaping the future of capital allocation, digital assets, and institutional infrastructure.

On the 27th August 2026, in Geneva, a select group of Switzerland's leading institutional allocators and technology experts gather to discuss the latest innovations in asset and wealth management, how technology is reshaping the investment stack, and what it takes to stay ahead of the next wave of disruption.

The event series is brought to you by CV VC (https://www.cvvc.com/?utm_source=luma), with SCRYPT (https://www.scrypt.swiss/?utm_source=luma) as the main partner.

Participants will

gain actionable insights into the latest trends, and

expand their high-class network

### Why This Conversation Matters

As global financial markets transform, tokenization, programmable settlement, and AI-driven structuring are actively redefining institutional allocation strategies. A new investment era is emerging across digital asset products, market infrastructure, portfolio construction, distribution, and institutional access.

🇨🇭 Geneva, a leading financial center and a global hub for digital assets, DLT, and AI innovation, provides the ideal environment for this critical dialogue.

### Who is attending?

This edition is designed to convene a select cohort of senior decision-makers, including executives from:

Asset Managers and Institutional Allocators

Family Office Principals

Hedge Fund Portfolio Managers

CIOs and senior portfolio managers from leading Swiss & global Asset managers & Private banks

- Representatives from institutional-grade technology and infrastructure platforms
- Selected innovators shaping the future of asset management

### Core Themes for Discussion

The focused content will explore the following key areas:

Closed-door roundtable discussion among peers

- Allocator perspectives on digital asset exposure
- Market structure, trading access, and execution
- The evolution of asset management: from ETFs to on-chain vaults
- Innovation in practice: allocation, risk, and operating models
- Institutional readiness: infrastructure, governance, and regulation
- Portfolio implications for forward-looking allocators

### Event Format - Efficient and Focused

The evening format is intentionally compact and highly time-efficient.

This design allows participants to gain relevant and actionable insights, and forge meaningful connections in a high-calibre setting without requiring a full day away from the office.

### Attendance Note

Attendance is strictly limited and subject to approval to ensure a high-quality, peer-level exchange. Chatham rules apply.

### Other Editions in the Series

Zurich (https://luma.com/98662hny) (Concluded)

UAE (https://luma.com/09ucswsa )

Frankfurt (https://luma.com/icv7e9eu)

Find out more on our website: https://wealthtech-executiveforum.com/

### What Comes Next?

The Next Disruption in Asset Management? Asset management has evolved in distinct waves, each driven by structural innovation and enabled by technology:

1770s: Closed-End Funds 1920s: Open-End Mutual Funds 1970s: Index Funds 1990s: ETFs 2020s: A new paradigm emerging: Vaults?

Technological innovations in digital trading and programmatic trading gave rise to ETFs in the 1990s, which now account for around $20 trillion in AUM. Technology continues to evolve, and with it comes the next major disruption in asset management.

Is the next reinvention of asset management already happening in front of us?

The real question is not whether asset management will continue to be reinvented, but which investors will identify the next structural change early enough to benefit from it?

This forum will explore exactly that.

### Hosts CV VC - We invest in blockchain. Because it's more than tech

About the organiser: CV VC is an Early-Stage VC backing Pre-Seed & Seed founders leveraging AI, Blockchain & other Frontier Technologies. Connect with investors, industry leaders, & senior executives at one of our events

## A Global Living Lab: Light DAO's Next International Gathering

- Record: `luma-host-evt-evt-T1nhxzU2JSJPAgq`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-11T06:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://lu.ma/LightDAOEdgeCity>
- Original page: <https://luma.com/LightDAOEdgeCity>

### About the event

Members of Light DAO's leadership recently participated in Edge Esmeralda and came away feeling it was one of the most impressive, inspiring and transformative business gatherings we had ever experienced - because it was not a conference, retreat or summit.

It was a Society Incubator - an extraordinary integration of worlds that are rarely found in one place.

In a single day, you might:

Begin the morning with a tea ceremony, breathwork or yoga

Move into a talk with brilliant researchers, founders and investors on frontier science and emerging technology

Spend a few hours building software, testing experimental health wearables, collaborating in a maker space, or creating in a media lab

Head into nature, join a wellness session, or get absorbed in a discussion on the latest in AI agents, fintech or longevity

Continue the conversations over dinner late into the evening - or end the night with music, ecstatic dance or a calming sound bath

For families, dedicated programs for kids and teens, starting at age 4, offer opportunities to play, learn, create and build within their own community

Alongside all of this are deep conversations about consciousness, philosophy, society and human flourishing

It felt like stepping into a living laboratory for the future - a temporary village designed to explore and experiment with how we might live, work, learn, build and thrive differently.

It offered a glimpse of what the world could look like when innovation, human flourishing and community are developed together.

### This is Edge City

Edge Cities are 3-4-week Living Labs and Society Incubators - international popup villages where frontier technology, science, entrepreneurship, consciousness, culture, art, well-being and community are not separate tracks, but part of one shared environment.

Edge Cities have already taken place in Patagonia, Chiang Mai, Cape Town and Esmeralda, two hours north of San Francisco.

Edge Esmeralda - June 2026

Nearly 300 stayed for the full month

- 850 residents from 60+ countries
- 800+ sessions and experiments
- Families came with 48 kids

What made it so extraordinary was being surrounded by brilliant, conscious innovators genuinely committed to advancing humanity - with enough time together for real relationships, collaborations and radical ideas to develop.

[www.EdgeEsmeralda.com](https://www.EdgeEsmeralda.com)

That experience convinced us that Edge City offers something unusually valuable for the Light DAO community.

So this October, we're taking our community to the next Edge City.

### The Next Edge City: Goa, India

October 11 - November 1, 2026

We're taking our community to Edge India in Goa - a three-week Living Lab and Society Incubator with hundreds of participants, approximately 65% coming from outside India.

Light DAO will have our own RESIDENCY within the larger Edge India community, so our members can take part in the full Edge experience while also connecting more intimately with our own community.

### A Living Lab Created by Its Community

One of the things that make Edge Cities especially unique and powerful is their unconference-style format. Much of the experience is created by the participants themselves - through the talks, demos, experiments and working groups they lead around the ideas and projects they care most about.

Light DAO will also host more intimate gatherings within our own Residency, led by our guests.

Once registered, Light DAO Owner Members are welcome to contact us with ideas you might like to lead or contribute to. We can't guarantee a place in either the Light DAO or Edge programming, but we'd love to hear what you are most excited to share.

That participatory spirit is part of what makes Edge a true Living Lab: the community does not simply attend the experience - it helps create it.

### A Special Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency

We're delighted to be partnering with SingularityNET for a 3-week Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency at Edge India. This is the first collaboration of its kind we've run with the SingularityNET team.

Everyone racing toward AGI is making the same bet: that a bigger model gets there. SingularityNET is not.

Led by Dr. Ben Goertzel, who launched the term and concept of Artificial General Intelligence, the team scales Beneficial General Intelligence on Hyperon, a cognitive architecture with two decades of research behind it. It holds knowledge, goals and decisions in a form you can inspect, shows its reasoning, and runs under explicit permissions - which is what makes it deployable inside real institutions.

The residency puts you in the room with the people building it. Talks, working sessions and open build time for developers, founders, researchers, investors, and anyone serious about AGI, ASI and beneficial technology.

Bring what you are already building. Leave with something concrete: a technical integration, a partnership, an investment conversation, or a prototype you put together on-site at Edge India.

### Why Join the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency?

In addition to the full Edge India experience, our Residency gives you a more intimate community to connect, collaborate and build with throughout your stay, including:

Light DAO + SingularityNET talks, working sessions and open build time

More intimate conversations and collaborations within our residency group, particularly with SingularityNET's leadership and tech team.

Light DAO-organized meals, including opportunities for participants to lead topic conversations

Optional group outings and shared experiences

Opportunities for Light DAO Owner Members to propose topics they may want to lead or contribute to

A shared home base at our beachfront resort

Think of our residency as your home community within the larger Edge India Living Lab.

### What Makes Edge Cities a Unique Living Lab + Society Incubator

Hear Edge Cities co-founder Timour Kosters talk about the multidisciplinary, multigenerational and global vision behind Edge Cities - including its unconference format and experiments.

He shares how the experience stretches people's sense of what is possible, helps them embody that expansion, and activates new collaborations and directions. In 1-3 weeks, many participants accelerate results that might otherwise have taken months or longer.

The Edge experience is designed around focused work, collaboration, wellness, community and time to enjoy Goa.

Your Edge Pass includes the full Edge India experience - programming, coworking, wellness, community gatherings and more.

### Pricing

Edge India Pass

Prices increase weekly

- 2-3 weeks (same price): $1,500-$2,000
- 1 week: $750-$1,000
- Day pass: $150-$200
- Indian citizens: 50% discount

Our Beachfront 4-Star Resort

[www.RivaResorts.com](https://www.RivaResorts.com)

Our Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency will be based at Edge India's central hotel.

Lunch + dinner: approximately $30 - 50/day

- Private room + breakfast: $100 per room/night
  Your choice - at the resort or anywhere in Goa

Yes - you get your own private room. At $100/night including breakfast, this is an exceptional value for a beachfront 4-star resort.

If you're coming as a couple, it is the same $100/night including breakfast for 2!

Roommates also the same $100/night!

Lunches, dinners and excursions are paid for individually, giving you the flexibility to join our residency plans, other Edge activities, or your own plans in Goa.

### Joining the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency

Edge Cities are curated communities with an application and approval process.

Light DAO Owner Members and friends we already know:

Please RSVP here on Luma. You will automatically be approved for Edge India through our Residency.

If you are new to us:

Please RSVP here on Luma and complete the registration questions thoughtfully. Thank you.

Once approved through the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency, you will not need to complete a separate Edge City application.

Ready to Join?

Choose one of the two ticket options above.

Once approved, we'll send you:

the direct link to purchase your Edge ticket at the current lowest price

the resort reservation link

Come experience our collaboration between Edge Cities, SingularityNET and Light DAO - where frontier ideas, deep community and real opportunities to build and collaborate come together in one Living Lab.

You may leave with a partnership, a prototype, a new collaborator, or an entirely new direction you had not imagined before joining this unique Society Incubator.

## AI & Fintech XRPL Hackathon in New York

- Record: `w3v-xrp-ledger-hackathon`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-24T12:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/xrpl-hackathon-nyc>

### About the event

Developers, product managers, designers, and business minds: team up and ship a working product in one weekend, from AI agents to new financial apps, with mentors and judges from across the AI, tech, blockchain, and finance world.

Hosted by XRPL Commons (https://www.xrpl-commons.org), with partners Ripple (https://www.ripple.com), XRPL Foundation (https://www.xrpl.foundation/), Mastercard (https://www.mastercard.com), Ledger (https://www.ledger.com/), AWS (https://aws.amazon.com/) and Quicknode (https://www.quicknode.com/). Whether it's your first hackathon, your fiftieth, or you want to sprint to launch a new feature, there's a place for you.

Join NYC's builder community for a weekend of shipping, then walk into Swell (https://swell.ripple.com/), Ripple's flagship conference, where institutions, investors, and decision-makers are already gathered, with a story to tell.

### Who it's for

Developers: no need to learn a new coding language. Build with the ones you already know, like JavaScript or Python.

Product, business, and finance profiles: you don't need to code. Great teams need people who shape the idea, design the user experience, build the business case, and pitch the demo.

AI-native builders welcome: use your favorite AI coding tools and agent frameworks to move faster.

- Come solo and find a team on site, or bring your own.

4 Tracks All projects must be built on the XRP Ledger (https://xrpl.org), a fast, low-cost blockchain designed for payments and digital finance. New to it? Mentors will help you get started.

Agentic Finance: build the tools that let AI agents make payments and manage money on the XRP Ledger, autonomously, safely, and at machine speed.

Lending & Borrowing: build lending apps and savings vaults on brand-new financial infrastructure (XRP Ledger Lending Protocol and Single Asset Vaults), before it goes live.

Protocol Innovation: for C++ and systems engineers who want to work on core infrastructure, clients, and developer tooling. Paired with a 3-day Core Dev Bootcamp (Oct 20-22) (http://luma.com/xrpl-core-dev-bootcamp2) as your on-ramp.

Why Not: the open lane. Bring the XRP Ledger project you can't stop thinking about.

Already building? Bring an existing project, AI app, or startup and use the 36 hours to ship a new feature on XRP Ledger. Only what you build during the hackathon counts toward judging.

What you get: $40,000+ in prizes, including stackable sponsored-track prizes, plus hands-on mentorship, fast-track access to grants and incubation, and a direct line to hiring teams.

Mentors & Judges Ripple (https://ripple.com) - XRPL Foundation (https://xrplf.org) - Mastercard (https://www.mastercard.com) - Ledger (https://www.ledger.com) - Quicknode (https://www.quicknode.com) - AWS (https://aws.amazon.com/) - t54.ai (https://www.t54.ai/) - Evernorth (https://www.evernorth.xyz/) - Soil (https://soil.co/) and more

Registration details By registering for this event, you consent to being photographed and filmed, and to the use of these photos/videos for promotional purposes. All participants are required to agree with and adhere to the code of conduct (https://swell.ripple.com/code-of-conduct).

## Hacker House Goa 2026

- Record: `w3v-hacker-house-goa-26-10-28`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-10-28
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://hacker-house-goa-2026.devfolio.co/>

### About the event

Builders and founders gather in Goa ahead of Devcon India for a multi-day residency focused on product development, smart contracts and community collaboration. The house brings together developers, designers and protocol contributors to prototype decentralized applications, conduct technical peer reviews and prepare for the upcoming Ethereum hackathons in Mumbai

### What to expect

Participants take part in daily co-working sprints, technical workshops and evening demo circles. The program covers smart contract security, account abstraction, layer-2 infrastructure and decentralized finance integrations. Seasoned mentors provide feedback on architecture and project roadmaps. High-speed connectivity, ergonomic workstations, and communal meals are provided throughout the residency

### Who should attend

The residency welcomes Web3 developers, Solidity engineers, UX designers and founders actively building open-source projects or preparing submissions for Devcon and India Blockchain Week hackathons

Venue and schedule

The hacker house runs in Goa from October 31 to November 4, 2026. The exact residential villa address is shared directly with accepted participants upon application approval

Registration and admission

Participation is free with application review required. Applications are evaluated based on project proposals, GitHub contributions, and community impact. Confirmed guests receive onboarding packages and arrival instructions.

- Starts: 2026-10-30T09:30:00.000Z

- Original page: <https://luma.com/ndrr1yqe>

### About the event

ETHMumbai hosts MIP-20: Road to Devcon on Friday, October 30, 2026, from 15:00 to 18:00 IST. The pre-conference developer meetup introduces the Mumbai Improvement Proposal 20 and highlights local Ethereum contributions

### What to expect

The session features technical presentations and community discussions:

An introduction to the MIP-20 specification and its role in developer tooling, node operations, and ecosystem standards for Mumbai's developer community.

- Workshops on building decentralized applications with modern Ethereum stacks, account abstraction (ERC-4337), and zero-knowledge toolkits.
- Hackathon readiness briefings, offering advice on forming teams, identifying bounties, and preparing for ETHIndia and Devcon hackathons.
- Q&A with experienced hackathon winners and local community mentors, followed by high-chai refreshments and networking

### Who should attend

The meetup is tailored for software engineers, blockchain developers, university students, and hackathon participants looking to level up their technical skills before Devcon 8 begins

Venue and schedule

The meetup takes place in Mumbai on Friday, October 30, running from 15:00 to 18:00 IST (09:30-12:30 UTC)

Registration and admission

Registration is completely free and requires approval on Luma. Laptops are encouraged for developers wishing to participate in interactive code walkthroughs.

- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/3doehm1b>

### About the event

Orviq Labs presents Run & Rave in Mumbai on Sunday, November 1, 2026, from 06:00 to 08:00 IST. The morning wellness activation blends distance running, electronic music, and community networking ahead of India Blockchain Week and Devcon 8

### What to expect

Run & Rave kickstarts the week with a sunrise run through the coastal streets of Bandra. A mobile DJ rig guides the group with upbeat house beats, creating an energetic and uplifting rhythm. The route is paved and scenic, offering views of the Arabian Sea. Following the run, participants gather for freshly brewed artisanal coffee, electrolyte drinks, healthy breakfast bites, and relaxed networking with founders, builders, and creators

### Who should attend

All runners, joggers, and walkers of any pace are welcome, from seasoned marathoners to casual morning runners. It is perfect for crypto founders, developers, and creators who want to prioritize health and movement before a hectic week of conferences

Venue and schedule

The run starts and finishes in Bandra, Mumbai, on Sunday, November 1, beginning at 06:00 IST and concluding by 08:00 IST

Registration and admission

Registration is free via Luma. Running shoes and comfortable sports clothing are required. Hydration points are stationed along the route, with baggage storage available at the start point.

### About the event

The BORN UP community hosts the India Blockchain Week Mumbai Community Networking Meetup on Sunday, November 1, 2026, from 17:00 to 20:00 IST. The gathering serves as an energetic community kickoff welcoming domestic and international builders to India Blockchain Week

### What to expect

The meetup highlights the momentum of India's developer ecosystem:

Traditional Mumbai tea, coffee, and refreshments with casual community networking

- Keynote panel featuring Indian Web3 founders sharing lessons on building global products from India.
- Showcase of community hackathon winners and rising student builders.
- Open mic and networking sessions connecting local software engineers with international protocol teams hiring in India.

### Who should attend

The gathering is open to Indian blockchain developers, student builders, startup founders, global protocol teams looking to hire in India, and international delegates arriving for India Blockchain Week

Venue and schedule

The event takes place at a centrally located tech community space in Mumbai on Sunday, November 1, running from 17:00 to 20:00 IST

Registration and admission

Registration is free via Luma and requires approval to manage room capacity. Laptops are welcome for developers wishing to demo their projects.

- Record: `w3v-catalyst-founder-residency-devcon-26-11-01`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)

### About the event

Web3 Events hosts Catalyst: Founder Residency during Devcon week in Mumbai, running from Tuesday, November 3, through Saturday, November 7, 2026. The residency provides a curated co-living and collaborative headquarters for active crypto startup founders

### What to expect

Catalyst creates an intensive, high-support environment where founders can work, sleep, and connect throughout Devcon week:

- Dedicated high-speed fiber internet work desks, private phone booths, and meeting rooms for investor calls.
- Daily peer masterminds and founder circles addressing hiring, token design, and growth challenges.
- Private office hours with visiting venture capitalists, angel investors, and experienced operators.
- Daily catered breakfast, coffee, late-night brain food, and quiet workspaces away from the noisy conference floors

### Who should attend

The residency is strictly reserved for founders, CEOs, and technical co-founders of venture-backed or bootstrapped Web3 startups building core protocol infrastructure or breakthrough consumer applications

Venue and schedule

The residency operates 24 hours a day from November 3 through November 7 at a private hospitality facility in Mumbai located near major conference transit lines

Registration and admission

Applications are evaluated based on project traction, team background, and stage of development. Approved founders receive check-in credentials, residency passes, and room details.

## BORN UP — Devcon Mumbai Community Networking Meetup

- Record: `luma-evt-VMyghZX4k8su1uQ`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-03T06:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://lu.ma/4al1ai5x>

### About the event

The BORN UP community hosts the Devcon Mumbai Community Networking Meetup on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, from 17:00 to 20:00 IST. The meetup empowers grass-roots builders, student developers, and emerging Web3 talent visiting Devcon 8

### What to expect

The three-hour program is designed to foster community growth and collaboration:

- Lightning talks highlighting grass-roots Web3 projects, open-source developer tooling, and community initiatives in India.
- Mentorship speed-dating connecting experienced blockchain founders with early-stage developers and student hackathon teams.
- Portfolio reviews, smart contract security tips, and career advice for engineers transitioning into decentralized technology.
- Open networking with snacks, tea, and refreshments in an inclusive, welcoming setting

### Who should attend

The meetup is tailored for early-career developers, university blockchain club members, hackathon participants, open-source contributors, and community leaders

Venue and schedule

The event takes place at a community coworking hub in Mumbai on Wednesday, November 4, running from 17:00 to 20:00 IST

Registration and admission

Admission is free of charge via Luma. RSVP approval is required to manage venue capacity. Approved guests receive the full address and transit directions.

## Zyhperpunks Dinner @Devcon

- Record: `luma-evt-Mr3xwAWeAXMdGam`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-03T13:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/jlisaxzz>

### About the event

Zcash and Harsh Bajpai host the Zyhperpunks Dinner in Mumbai on November 3, 2026, from 19:30 to 22:30 IST during Devcon week. The evening brings together privacy researchers, cryptographers and cypherpunks for an intimate dinner and technical conversation on zero-knowledge privacy

### What to expect

The program begins with a 30-minute overview of recent Zcash technical developments, network scalability improvements, and user-facing privacy tools. Attendees participate in an interactive onboarding clinic using the Zashi shielded wallet to experience private transactions firsthand. The presentation transitions into a multi-course dinner with open roundtable discussions on financial sovereignty, regulatory compliance through selective disclosure, and the state of client-side ZK-proofs

### Who should attend

This gathering is tailored for privacy advocates, zero-knowledge engineers, cryptography researchers, and open-source contributors passionate about preserving privacy and freedom in decentralized networks

Venue and schedule

The dinner takes place in the Ram Krishna Nagar neighborhood of Khar West / Bandra, Mumbai, on Tuesday, November 3, running from 19:30 to 22:30 IST

Registration and admission

Attendance is free and requires host approval to maintain an intimate table size conducive to deep technical discussions. Venue address and directions will be shared directly with approved guests.

## EVA Symposium III

- Record: `w3v-eva-symposium-iii-26-11-04`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-04T11:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/ai6owvhz>

### About the event

EVA Research hosts the EVA Symposium III in Mumbai on Monday, November 2, 2026, from 10:00 to 16:00 IST during Devcon week. The formal academic and research symposium gathers leading cryptographers, computer scientists, and zero-knowledge researchers

### What to expect

The full-day symposium features peer-reviewed paper presentations, invited keynotes, and technical whiteboard panels:

Zero-Knowledge Virtual Machines (zkVMs): comparing proof recursion, lookup arguments, and constraint system efficiency.

- Formal verification of smart contracts and consensus state transition systems.
- Cryptographic primitives for verifiable computation, polynomial commitments, and folding schemes.
- Open whiteboard workshops where researchers collaborate on unsolved problems in protocol security.

A catered luncheon and coffee breaks provide ample networking time between sessions

### Who should attend

The symposium is aimed at cryptography researchers, computer science faculty and graduate students, formal verification engineers, and zero-knowledge protocol architects

Venue and schedule

The symposium takes place at a conference auditorium in Mumbai on Monday, November 2, from 10:00 to 16:00 IST

Registration and admission

Attendance is free with registration approval required. Applicants are asked to share their academic affiliation, research papers, or GitHub profiles when requesting admission.

The three-hour happy hour offers a relaxed, social atmosphere with complimentary drinks, craft cocktails, and passed appetizers:

- Conversations on Chain Abstraction, cross-chain messaging, and unified liquidity infrastructure on NEAR.

### Who should attend

### About the event

The Money Layer Consortium presents Money Layer @Devcon Week in Mumbai on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, from 14:00 to 18:00 IST. The four-hour conference explores digital cash, programmable payments, and decentralized settlement infrastructure

### What to expect

The afternoon conference brings together leaders from monetary protocol design, banking, and crypto-native commerce:

- Keynote on the evolution of digital cash: from sovereign stablecoins to privacy-preserving ecash (Cashu, Fedimint).
- Panel on scalable payment channels: Lightning Network, state channels, and Layer 2 payment streaming protocols.
- Merchant adoption case studies: deploying point-of-sale crypto payments across retail and e-commerce platforms with zero chargeback risk.
- Regulatory frameworks for programmable payments, automated tax withholding, and programmable escrow.

The presentations conclude with an open tea and networking reception

### Who should attend

The conference is tailored for payments product managers, fintech executives, monetary economists, stablecoin developers, and Web3 engineers building consumer checkout flows

Venue and schedule

The event takes place at a conference auditorium in Mumbai on Wednesday, November 4, from 14:00 to 18:00 IST

Registration and admission

Attendance is free with registration approval required on Luma. Registered attendees receive presentation decks and speaker summaries following the conference.

### About the event

HyprEarn hosts Perps & Chai with HyprEarn @Devcon 8 in Mumbai on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, from 15:00 to 18:00 IST. The afternoon meetup combines traditional Mumbai chai culture with cutting-edge discussions on decentralized perpetual contracts and yield generation

### What to expect

The session brings together derivatives traders and DeFi developers over traditional afternoon tea:

- Live demonstration of HyprEarn's perpetual yield strategies, automated vault rebalancing, and delta-neutral earning vaults.
- Discussions on perpetual DEX liquidity fragmentation, funding rate arbitrage, and oracle latency mitigation.
- Freshly brewed authentic Mumbai cutting chai, masala chai, herbal infusions, and traditional savory snacks like samosas and kachoris.

### Who should attend

The meetup is tailored for perpetual DEX traders, DeFi yield farmers, smart contract engineers, liquidity providers, and quantitative finance enthusiasts

Venue and schedule

Admission is free and approval-based on Luma. Space is limited to ensure a comfortable cafe setting. Approved attendees will receive the venue address upon confirmation.

## Bluechip26: The Crypto Safety Conference

- Record: `w3v-bluechip26-crypto-safety-conference-26-11-10`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)

### About the event

Bluechip26 - The Crypto Safety Conference Get Tickets Nov 10-11, 2026 -> AM STADTPARK 9, 1030 VIENNA Bluechip26 The Crypto Safety Conference presented by in partnership with The Crypto Safety Conference Submit your email for Bluechip26 updates. Thank you! Your submission has been received! Oops! Something went wrong while submitting the form. Nov 6-7, 2025 Vienna The Crypto Safety Conference Register NOw About Billions have been lost to depegs, hacks, and exploits. Not only in obscure altcoins, but also in billion dollar assets that people once trusted. Bluechip26 is our collective step toward changing that. This is the first global conference dedicated to crypto safety.

It is hosted by Bluechip, the first independent stablecoin rating agency. The forum brings together leaders from traditional finance companies and crypto-native protocols - including developers, investors, auditors, regulators, and founders. Designed as a highly curated gathering, we prioritize depth over scale to ensure meaningful dialogue and high quality connections. Our goal is simple: to make crypto safer for everyone.

## Scale or Die

- Record: `w3v-scale-or-die`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-14T09:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/scale-or-die-26>

### About the event

Scale or Die | London | November 14 Back by popular demand, we're bringing Solana's developer-focused Scale or Die event to London on November 14th, leading into Breakpoint. Scale or Die is Solana's application-only summit for the engineers, validators, protocol developers, infrastructure teams, and researchers pushing the network to its limits. This is not a general crypto event. No marketing decks. No sales pitches. Just deep technical programming, hands-on workshops, and focused time with the teams building and scaling Solana's future.

Expect talks and conversations across validator performance, consensus, transaction landing, RPC, Firedancer, post-quantum readiness, agentic infrastructure, high-performance onchain applications, and more. A dedicated DevCave space will run throughout the day for technical discussion, debugging, collaboration, and direct access to the people shipping core infrastructure. If you are building on Solana, operating infrastructure, writing protocol code, or working at the frontier of Solana, this is the room you want to be in. For Sponsorship opportunities, please reach out to events@solana.org Still need to book a hotel?

Book with Nomadz (https://nomadz.xyz/breakpoint)and save up to 30% Interested in speaking? Please fill out this form. (https://airtable. com/appCy7M2j24UF6QqT/pag8nSnDP4LUKD13W/form)

### About the event

BlockZero 2026 returns as a community-led summit for the Solana validator ecosystem.

Taking place in London on November 15, 2026, the event will bring together validators, infrastructure operators, protocol contributors, and teams building validator-adjacent technology for a focused day of discussion, coordination, and shared learning.

BlockZero is designed as a small, high-signal gathering for the people working closest to blockchain infrastructure. The program will focus on the operational, economic, and governance questions shaping the future of validator networks, with space for technical sessions, working groups, and open community-led dialogue.

More details on speakers, agenda, and participation will be announced soon.

Attendance is limited and subject to approval to preserve the collaborative format of the event.

## Pr1me London Series - Exclusive Dinner for Web3 Finance

- Record: `w3v-pr1me-london-series-exclusive-dinner-web3-26-11-16`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-16T19:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/aqntywn2>

### About the event

Join us for the [London edition of the PR1ME Series, during Solana Breakpoint](https://solana.com/breakpoint) powered by the Onchain Finance Institute (OCF), [Solana Foundation](https://solana.org/), [Lukka](https://lukka.tech/) [and Breezing](https://breezing.io/).

This invite-only, community-driven gathering brings together leading minds in web3 accounting and finance.

This event is exclusively for finance professionals - CFOs, COOs, Controllers, Heads of Finance, or equivalent. We're unable to accept applications outside these roles.

Important: Only confirmed guests with a QR code will be allowed entry. Please note that walk-ins or unapproved registrations will not be possible.

### About Solana Foundation

[The Solana Foundation](https://solana.org/) is a non-profit organisation based in Zug, Switzerland, dedicated to the decentralisation, growth, and security of the Solana network. Solana is a proof-of-stake blockchain built for mass adoption. Fast, composable, green, and globally distributed.

### About Lukka

[Lukka](https://lukka.tech/) is the institutional data backbone for digital assets, transforming fragmented on-chain and off-chain activity into audit-ready intelligence. Trusted by global financial institutions, asset managers, custodians, exchanges, and regulators, Lukka delivers the trust, truth, and transparency needed to power pricing, valuation, compliance, risk management, accounting, and reporting across digital and tokenized assets.

### About Breezing

[Breezing](https://breezing.io/) is a crypto subledger built specifically for accounting professionals managing digital assets. It connects directly to blockchains, exchanges, and accounting systems like Xero and QuickBooks, eliminating the manual work of exporting CSVs and posting journal entries by hand.

[Used by 200+ businesses including ht.digital](https://ht.digital), BDO, ETH Global, Safe, and Dune.

SOC 2 certified and Swiss-made🇨🇭.

### About Onchain Finance Institute (OCF)

Onchain Finance Institute (OCF) (https://www.onchainfinanceinstitute.com/) is an education and community platform helping finance professionals build real-world onchain finance skills for accounting, treasury, and finance roles.

Join 150+ alumni and 400+ community members from organizations such as Solana Foundation, a16z, Ava Labs, Starknet, and more, upskilling with digital assets and transitioning into the future of onchain finance.

[Apply to join community platform](https://www.onchainfinanceinstitute.com/community).

> For sponsorship inquiries, you can reach out to hello@theaccountantquits.com

### About the event

Render Network and Solana are bringing an immersive art activation to Breakpoint 2026 London at FRAMELESS, one of the UK's most striking immersive art venues.

Get immersed in original works from a curated lineup of world-class 3D artists who have imagined a world where the digital and physical dissolve into one another, and the systems shaping our future bend, blur, and beautifully collide.

Guests will be treated to bespoke immersive 3D art, rendered on the Render Network specifically for immersive galleries at FRAMELESS.

Complimentary cocktails and hors d'oeuvres will be served.

### Details

Date - Monday, November 16, 2026

Time - 7:30-10p

Venue - FRAMELESS

Address - 6 Marble Arch, London, W1H 7AP

RSVP required - space is limited

## CryptoMondays Wall Street, Fort Lauderdale and Miami Chapters come together to bring you the Official Blockchain Futurist Conference Kickoff

- Record: `luma-evt-pJHThGT11BBYohC`

### About the event

CryptoMondays Wall Street, Fort Lauderdale & Miami Chapters Host The Official Blockchain Futurist Conference Kickoff Social

CryptoMondays isn't just a meetup; it's a global decentralized movement energizing Web3 and crypto communities through learning, networking, and inspiration.

CryptoMondays Wall Street, Fort Lauderdale and Miami Chapters are proud to host the [official opening event for the Blockchain Futurist Conference](https://www.futuristconference.com/) Florida for the 2nd year. This iconic global conference is coming to the USA and to Florida!

Join us Monday, November 16, 2026, as we welcome attendees, innovators, and the global Web3 community before the main event at the Hard Rock Guitar Hotel.

### 6:00 PM - 9:00 PM

Location Revealed Upon

CryptoMondays is a proud Community Partner of Blockchain Futurist Conference, working alongside the Futurist team to make this an unforgettable launch in Florida.

We're [also excited to announce our media partner Blockchain North](https://blockchainnorth.ca/), joining us to amplify the energy, stories, and innovation coming out of South Florida's crypto scene.

Why Attend?

Be part of the official kickoff for the 2nd Futurist Conference in the USA.

- Network with industry leaders, investors, founders, and innovators.
- Get early access to community-driven insights before the main conference.
- Score free drink tickets just for sharing your experience on social media.
- Connect with sponsors and potential partners in a relaxed, fun setting.

This is the OFFICIAL Opening Event of Blockchain Futurist Conference; don't miss it!

RSVP now, bring your friends, and let's set the tone for the future of blockchain, right here in South Florida! Get updates as we confirm more speakers, special guests, and surprises.

By RSVPing to any of our events, you agree to be added to our future correspondence. You confirm that the email provided is active and in good standing, and you consent to opt into receiving updates and communications from us.

### About the event

WHAT IS THEBORNEO BLOCKCHAIN CONFERENCE 2026? The Borneo Blockchain Conference 2026 marks the shift from a launch event into a recognised regional platform for blockchain, AI and digital infrastructure.

Following the successful 2025 debut (which hosted 30+ speakers and 500+ delegates), the 2026 edition will scale to 1,500+ attendees, focusing on the theme: "From Vision to Execution: Building a Secured Digital Future."  This focus enables digital transformation through the integration of Trusted Digital Infrastructure, Artificial Intelligence and Post-Quantum Cryptography BBCON2026 will leverage Sarawak's unique blend of green energy and tech-readiness to attract global VCs, regional startups and policy-makers

### Event details

Date: Nov 18 - 19, 2026, 00:00

Venue: Voco Hotel

## University Blockchain Conference 2026

- Record: `luma-evt-mPCGxeHyKlTeEgN`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)

### About the event

UBC: Where Talent Meets Opportunity

The University Blockchain Conference (UBC) - formerly the Midwest Blockchain Conference - is the leading access point connecting top university talent with the blockchain industry across the U.S. and beyond.

What started in the heartland of Ann Arbor has grown into a national movement and global network, now spanning 100+ universities including schools in South America and Europe. This year, we're evolving - new name, new home, same mission.

Built by students for students, UBC brings together university clubs, high schools, alumni, and industry leaders, all focused on pushing crypto forward through student leadership.

Connecting Top Talent with Leading Companies

If you're a student or faculty member passionate about blockchain, this is your gateway. This November, connect with dozens of hiring companies, VCs eager to invest, and thought leaders excited to share knowledge with the next generation of builders.

If you're an industry professional, UBC offers unmatched exposure to over 1000+ ambitious students and dozens of elite university programs, many of which have traditionally been difficult to reach. Grow your user base, recruit standout talent, and shape the future of the space.

Bigger Than Ever - Real Outcomes

UBC 2026 is set to surpass every prior year in every dimension: More speakers. More sponsors. More opportunities.

And it's working. Past attendees landed roles at:

Coinbase, Circle, Gemini, Galaxy, Polymarket, and many leading companies in blockchain, fintech, and policy.

This year, expect world-class speakers from industry and government, a major hackathon and research competition, tons of networking opportunities, massive side events, and as always, fire merch.

Hosted at The University of Texas at Austin

Set in Austin, one of America's fastest-growing tech and innovation hubs, UT Austin is a national leader in engineering, finance, and entrepreneurship. Its leading blockchain club, Texas Blockchain, and its thriving blockchain community make it the perfect host for UBC 2026.

Get Your Ticket

Early bird tickets are just $10 for students and $25 for industry. This small fee ensures attendees are committed and helps us better plan for an exceptional experience. UBC is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, student-run effort.

** IMPORTANT NOTE: If you are a student, make sure to apply for a travel subsidy here: https://forms.gle/GohTNo6bbxkGesXx7

Subsidy requests are approved by the team on a case-by-case basis. We aim to subsidize every student who travels to Austin for this event.

[Reserve your spot now]

### About the Organizers

College.xyz is a student-led 501(c)3 nonprofit connecting top university talent with the blockchain industry.

Beyond our flagship conference, we support students year-round through travel subsidies to events like Solana Breakpoint, sponsor hackathon tracks, and host side events at major conferences - all with the goal of onboarding more talent into the industry. We're building the next generation of blockchain leaders, on campus and beyond.

Contact Us

Interested in sponsoring, speaking, or volunteering?

Reach out at: uniblockchainconferences@gmail.com

Follow Us for Updates

Website: https://www.universityblockchain.org/

https://www.college.xyz/

## Toronto Blockchain Week 2026

- Record: `luma-evt-13WH0lUCgcznSeW`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)

- Description: Source-backed

### About the event

Toronto Blockchain Week 2026 is one of Canada's premier gatherings for digital assets, institutional finance, and Web3 technology, taking place November 24-25, 2026 in Toronto, Ontario. Over two days, the summit unites leaders from finance, government, policy, blockchain infrastructure, and venture capital.

### Tuesday, November 24. Digital Asset Summit

- **Time:** 9:00 AM. 5:00 PM EST
- **Focus:** A full-day summit bringing together decision-makers from government, financial institutions, capital markets, and the digital asset industry.
- **Key Themes:** Stablecoin adoption, real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, regulatory frameworks, cross-border payments, and institutional market infrastructure.

### Tuesday Evening. VIP Executive Dinner

- **Audience:** An exclusive evening for speakers, sponsors, institutional investors, and ecosystem executives to connect and discuss strategic market initiatives.
- **Access:** Included with VIP conference passes.

### Wednesday, November 25. Build The Future Canada

- **Time:** 9:00 AM. 5:00 PM EST
- **Focus:** A dedicated builder day shifting the spotlight to the founders, protocol engineers, and developers creating next-generation architectures.
- **Key Themes:** Blockchain infrastructure, on-chain AI agents, DeFi protocols, smart contract security, and venture capital financing for early-stage Web3 startups.

### Why Attend

Toronto Blockchain Week provides an essential forum for builders, institutional investors, and policymakers navigating Canada's evolving digital financial landscape. Attendees gain direct access to regulatory dialogues, high-signal developer networking, and emerging technology showcases across Canadian and global ecosystems.

### About the event

BlockCon Punta Cana is a Web3 business retreat at Barceló Bávaro Beach in the Dominican Republic from November 25 to 28, 2026. It covers finance, iGaming, venture capital, startups and the digital economy, including payments, stablecoins, tokenized assets and regulation. The announced format includes panels, startup and VC matchmaking, banking and Web3 roundtables and networking. The Community Pass covers the conference and exhibition but excludes accommodation and retreat activities.

Business passes add daytime activities and meetings; VIP All-Inclusive includes a hotel stay and additional experiences.  Check the organizer's current pass comparison for meal, activity and invitation-only access conditions

### Event details

Date: Nov 25 - 28, 2026, 13:00 Venue: Barcelo Bavaro Beach Event page: https://www.blockcon.co/

## Bitcoin Japan 2026

- Record: `w3v-bitcoin-japan-26-11-27`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-27
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://btc-jpn.com/en>

### About the event

Bitcoin Japan 2026 takes place on 27-28 November 2026 in Akihabara, Tokyo, under the theme "From HODLing to Spending. Experience the New Era of Bitcoin." The organisers describe the event as three distinct formats for different audiences

Summit, festival and expo The Summit on 27 November is a conference for business leaders, decision-makers and business development professionals, where industry experts share real-world use cases and explore Bitcoin's potential in business. The Festival on 28 November is an interactive area where visitors can try Bitcoin through games, entertainment and activities for all ages. The Bitcoiner Expo, also on 28 November, is a conference track with expert insights, discussions and hands-on activities for people deepening their understanding of Bitcoin

Venue and tickets The venue is Bellesalle Akihabara, in the Sumitomo Fudosan Akihabara Building at 3-12-8 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, a three-minute walk from JR Akihabara Station (Electric Town Exit) and two minutes from the Tsukuba Express Exit A3. The general pass is free admission, although some activities inside the venue require a ticket. The Bitcoiner Pass is listed at 19,800 yen including tax, with final block pricing of 27,500 yen until 22 November. Paying with Lightning gives a 10% discount on the tax-inclusive prices. The Bitcoiner Pass covers the Lounge, Entertainment Area, Bitcoin Marche, Sats giveaway entry, networking reception and exclusive merchandise.

## Blockchain Conference Brasil

- Record: `ma-blockchain-conference-brasil`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-11-28T00:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://www.blockchainconferencebrasil.com/ >

### About the event

Blockchain Conference Brasil reúne profissionais do setor cripto, investidores, desenvolvedores, empreendedores e representantes de instituições públicas e de ensino. A programação anunciada inclui painéis, debates, apresentações, workshops, podcasts e uma área de exposição. Os temas incluem infraestrutura blockchain, Web3, regulação, finanças digitais e novas aplicações da tecnologia. Consulte a página oficial para a agenda e os ingressos da edição atual; os números, patrocinadores e registros identificados como BCB25 referem-se à edição anterior.

### O evento

O Blockchain Conference Brasil (BCB) é apresentado como o maior evento sobre Bitcoin, cripto e blockchain do Brasil, conectando as principais lideranças, empresas e investidores do ecossistema. Mais do que um evento, é um ponto de encontro real do ecossistema para quem constrói, investe e lidera o setor no país.

### Conteúdo e experiência

Conteúdo de alto nível: um ambiente que conecta empresas, investidores, desenvolvedores e empreendedores em busca de parcerias, investimentos e novos negócios, com painéis, debates e apresentações com líderes do ecossistema cripto.

Inovação e tecnologia: discussões sobre infraestrutura blockchain, Web3, regulação, finanças digitais e novas aplicações da tecnologia.

Comunidade e builders engajados: uma comunidade ativa e relevante, impulsionada por uma forte rede de KOLs e criadores, que amplificam o alcance do evento.

Espaços dedicados: palcos Ethereum e Bitcoin, área VIP, zona de podcast e área de exposição.

### Networking e negócios

O evento combina networking estratégico e geração de negócios, reunindo o ecossistema em um ambiente de alto nível técnico, estratégico e comercial.

### Perfil do público

Fundadores e startups: executivos e tomadores de decisão que lideram empresas do setor financeiro e tecnológico, além de empreendedores construindo novos produtos, protocolos e empresas.

Builders e desenvolvedores: responsáveis por construir a infraestrutura Web3.

Investidores estratégicos: fundos, venture capital e investidores focados em inovação, blockchain e ativos digitais.

Setor público e reguladores: representantes de órgãos públicos, reguladores e especialistas do setor.

Investidores individuais e instituições de ensino.

Comunidade engajada e ativada por KOLs: creators, educadores e líderes de comunidade que ampliam o alcance e a relevância do ecossistema.

- Description: Source-backed

### About the event

Proof of Talk Abu Dhabi takes place at the Louvre Abu Dhabi on December 3 and 4, 2026, focused on capital, AI and digital assets. This is the series' inaugural Gulf edition.

Attendance is application-based: the organizer says every guest is individually approved rather than admitted through open ticket sales. The room is capped at 2,000 participants. Speaking slots are selected by the program team and are not sold.

The website currently displays speakers and statistics from previous Paris editions. The Abu Dhabi lineup will be announced to the priority list; those past names should not be treated as confirmed Abu Dhabi speakers.

This listing reflects the organizer's published information for Proof of Talk Abu Dhabi on Dec 3 - 4, 2026 in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Register and confirm ticket inclusions on the official event page.

### About the event

Following extensive discussions with our local partners, we have decided to reschedule Bitcoin MENA to 2027. We will share the precise dates in the upcoming months.

### Organizer update

The organizer is committed to returning to the UAE in Winter 2027. Exact new dates have not been announced. The previous December 2026 dates should not be used for travel planning.

### Existing tickets

Your ticket automatically carries over to the new dates. You do not need to do anything. Ticket holders may also request a refund through the organizer's contact form.

### Sponsors

Your commitment carries forward to 2027, and our team will be in touch directly to walk through the details and make sure everything you planned for still delivers.

<a id="event-3179a55bc68f7c20"></a>

## Abu Dhabi Finance Week

- Record: `w3v-abu-dhabi-finance-week-2026`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-12-07T04:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://www.adfw.com/event/2026/home>

### About the event

Abu Dhabi Finance Week (ADFW) 2026 is the fifth edition of the flagship financial convention hosted by the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) in Abu Dhabi from 7 to 10 December 2026. ADGM describes ADFW as the largest financial and investment convention in the Middle East and North Africa, convening policymakers, institutional investors, asset managers, entrepreneurs, and technology leaders under the theme "The Capital Community, Powered by Partnerships".

### What to expect

ADGM's published programme spans four thematic days:

Day 1: Abu Dhabi's Falcon Economy, global markets, and macroeconomic megatrends.

Day 2: Asset management, private markets, and wealth.

Day 3: Artificial intelligence, fintech, digital assets, and financial innovation.

Day 4: Sustainable finance and long-term economic resilience.

Flagship programmes named for 2026 include Asset Abu Dhabi (8 December), Fintech Abu Dhabi and Blockchain Abu Dhabi (9 December), and the Abu Dhabi Sustainable Finance Forum (10 December). The Milken Institute's Middle East and Africa Summit runs on 7 to 8 December during ADFW week.

The 2026 edition expands to about 75 events across eight stages, up from 60 events and six stages in 2025, with additional platforms spanning real estate, hedge-fund leadership, health finance, AI capital markets, and cross-border investor dialogues.

Strategic and official partners named in ADGM releases contribute dedicated tracks across asset management, fintech, digital assets, private wealth, and venture growth, including institutions such as Mubadala, First Abu Dhabi Bank, Binance, Hub71, and UBS. Satellite networking dinners, private roundtables, and Luma-listed side events across Abu Dhabi and Dubai are listed separately on Hashtag Web3 under the ADFW tag.

### Who should attend

ADFW is built for sovereign wealth and family-office principals, bank and asset-management executives, hedge-fund and private-markets allocators, regulators, fintech operators, and Web3 teams scheduling institutional meetings in the UAE during early December.

### Registration

Passes, agendas, and venue updates are published on the official ADFW site at adfw.com. Speaker names and partner activations continue to be announced ahead of December 2026.

## Merkle Science Meet Abu Dhabi

- Record: `luma-evt-0NZbyd12N5Bj1tT`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2026-12-08T09:30:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://luma.com/v1z81ldc>

### December 8, 2026 | 1:30 PM - 5:45 PM

Rosewood Abu Dhabi

Join Merkle Science and a distinguished group of industry leaders, institutional investors, regulators, and compliance professionals for an exclusive afternoon of discussions during Abu Dhabi Finance Week.

The event will bring together leading voices across digital assets, institutional finance, AI-driven compliance, emerging markets, and stablecoin infrastructure to explore the opportunities and challenges shaping the future of digital finance.

### Agenda

Speakers & Panel Details

### 2:00 PM - 2:40 PM

Stablecoins & Cross-Border Payments

Stablecoins are reshaping cross-border payments, with the UAE emerging as a key hub connecting the Middle East, Asia, Europe, and Africa. This session explores how stablecoins are transforming international payments and settlement, alongside the regulatory, AML, and compliance challenges of moving value across jurisdictions.

### Speakers

Jazib Malik - CEO & Founder, Thirdpay

Donato P. Giarnera - BD, Arf

Serena Sebastiani - VP, Fuze

Joseph Cleetus - VP Business Transformation, Lulu Financial Holding

Atif Shaikh - CRO, DDSC

Jonathan Rigg - CEO, BitOasis

Moderator: Tom Luo - Head of Sales, Merkle Science

Adrianus Schoorl - Partner, Head of Financial Services Regulatory (MENA), DLA Piper

Nicole Purin - Deputy General Counsel, Trustyfy (Former CCO, OKX)

Sharad Kumar - CCO, Cyant

Maryam Saeed - Global Head of Expansion, Sardine

Max Grabner - Head of Product, Range

Moderator: Kirill Lelchitskiy - CLO, Cyant

Tristan Wallaert - CEO, Request Network

Mehtap Onder - Managing Director, Fasset

Adam Wolstenholme - Simmons & Simmons

Moderator: Sheetal Bhardwaj - Compliance Director & MLRO MENA, HashKey

Karl Naim - CCO, XBTO

Ali Boukhalfa - Head of MENA & APAC, P2P.ORG

Karthik Mahalingam - CLO, Multipli.fi (https://Multipli.fi)

Nicholas Philpott - Co-Founder & CSO, Zodia Markets

Andrej Majcen - Co-Founder & Group CEO, Bitcoin Suisse

Moderator: Thibaut Gravelle-Vivien - Growth Lead, Merkle Science

Networking Reception

### 2:55 PM - 3:35 PM

AI-Driven Compliance: Building the Next Generation of Financial Crime Detection

As financial crime becomes increasingly sophisticated, AI is transforming how financial institutions, fintechs, and digital asset businesses detect suspicious activity, identify emerging threats, and strengthen compliance frameworks. This panel explores how AI-driven analytics, blockchain intelligence, and real-time transaction monitoring are shaping the next generation of financial crime detection across the MENA region and globally.

Speakers will discuss practical applications of AI in AML/CFT, cross-border payments, and digital asset investigations; the challenges of balancing innovation with regulatory expectations; and how institutions can improve detection accuracy, reduce false positives, and build scalable, intelligence-led compliance programs across jurisdictions.

### 3:55 PM - 4:10 PM

Fireside Chat with Dmitry Fedotov - ADGM

A conversation with Dmitry Fedotov, Head of Emerging Markets at ADGM, hosted by Mriganka Pattnaik, CEO & Co-Founder of Merkle Science.

### 4:10 PM - 4:50 PM

Crypto Compliance in Middle East and Emerging Markets: The Gulf, Africa, and South Asia

The UAE sits at the center of capital and payment flows connecting some of the world's fastest-growing digital asset markets, including South Asia, East Africa, and the broader Middle East. This panel examines the compliance challenges unique to these corridors: high-risk jurisdiction exposure, informal value transfer networks, hawala overlaps, and the growing role of stablecoins in markets with limited banking infrastructure. Speakers will discuss how firms operating in and through the Gulf are building compliance programs calibrated for this specific risk environment.

### 5:05 PM - 5:45 PM

Sovereign Wealth, Family Offices, and the Institutionalization of Digital Assets in the Gulf

Gulf sovereign wealth funds and family offices represent some of the largest pools of investable capital in the world, and their engagement with digital assets is deepening. This panel examines how these institutions are approaching digital asset allocation, from direct investment in crypto and tokenized assets to backing infrastructure and venture, what compliance and custody standards they are requiring from counterparties, and how service providers are building to meet the expectations of the region's most sophisticated capital allocators.

### 5:45 PM - 7:00 PM

An opportunity to continue conversations, exchange insights, and connect with fellow industry leaders and decision-makers.

### About the event

FutureFinance Connect

On December 8th, FutureFinance Connect returns once again, taking place alongside Abu Dhabi Finance Week 2026. This invitation-only networking evening brings together the people building, investing in, and regulating the future of digital finance.

Hosted by XBTO, in partnership with Bitcoin Suisse Middle East, the evening offers a curated space to connect away from the noise of a conference floor.

Set at Loca in the elegant Four Seasons Abu Dhabi, expect a Mexican themed evening of relaxed conversation, unparalleled networking, and the kind of dialogue that tends to happen once the formal agenda is over.

### Event Details

Date: December 8, 2026

Time: 6:30 PM - 11:00 PM

Venue: Loca, Four Seasons Abu Dhabi, Galleria Mall

### About XBTO

Founded in 2015 as a proprietary trading firm, XBTO built its foundation through over a decade of active participation in digital asset markets.

Since 2023, XBTO has expanded into a full-service crypto quantitative investment firm. With a strong focus on BTC, XBTO deliver risk-adjusted strategies across the alpha-beta continuum designed to perform across market cycles and regulatory environments. With decades of experience earned at the world's leading financial institutions and deep expertise in digital markets, we bring a rare combination of financial discipline and digital-native insight.

XBTO operates under robust regulatory oversight, with operating entities regulated by the Bermuda Monetary Authority and the Financial Services Regulatory Authority in Abu Dhabi. XBTO has a presence in 6 locations: Bermuda, Miami, New York, London, Paris, and Abu Dhabi. https://www.xbto.com/

### About Bitcoin Suisse

Bitcoin Suisse stands for premium virtual asset services. BTCS (Middle East) Ltd. provides Professional Clients with OTC spot trading, tailored derivatives and institutional-grade custody of accepted virtual assets, regulated by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM. Based in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, it is part of the Bitcoin Suisse Group, which is built on Swiss crypto-native roots dating back to 2013 and today employs more than 200 professionals across Switzerland, the European Economic Area, the United Arab Emirates and Bermuda.

### About Soter Insure

Headquartered in Abu Dhabi and operating out of Bermuda, with offices in London, New York and Dubai, Soter Insure was incubated by Further Ventures and WebN Group. The company offers specialized digital asset insurance products for financial institutions, including Directors & Officers (D&O), Professional Indemnity (PI), Crime, Specie, Slashing and Smart Contract Failure coverage, uniquely denominated in both fiat and native digital assets.

X (https://x.com/soter_insure) | Website (https://www.soter.insure/) | LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/soter-insure/)

### About Galaxy

https://www.galaxy.com/

Galaxy Digital Inc. (NASDAQ: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com (http://www.galaxy.com).

X (https://x.com/galaxyhq) | Website (https://galaxy.com/) | LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/galaxyhq/)

### About the event

Bringing together senior leaders for a private social mixer.

Join us for an elegant evening reception with drinks, canapés and the opportunity to connect during the Abu Dhabi Finance Week.

### What to expect

An elegant outdoor venue: Patio deck on a beach at The Club Abu Dhabi.

Drinks & canapés: Enjoy a selection of refreshments and canapés throughout the evening.

- Meaningful conversations: Meet fellow executives, investors and professionals working across finance, investment and business.

### Who should attend

This gathering is designed for senior leaders across:

Financial Services: Banking, capital markets, asset management, wealth management, insurance and FinTech.

Investments: Private equity, venture capital, family offices, institutional investors, sovereign wealth funds and investment management.

Business & Technology: C-suite executives, founders, entrepreneurs, strategy, operations and technology leaders.

Professional Services: Management consulting, transaction advisory, legal, accounting.

Attendance is subject to registration approval.

Space is limited to maintain an engaging and high-quality guest experience. Please include your job title, company and LinkedIn in the registration form.

Event hosts:

AI That Delivers and Canadian Business Council Abu Dhabi

AI That Delivers (aithatdelivers.ai (https://aithatdelivers.ai)) is a private network of 600+ senior leaders in financial services, tech and AI across Canada and UAE.

Elena D. Kaiache (https://linkedin.com/in/elenadk) is a fractional CFO and Strategic Advisor with experience in Canada and USA across FinTech, B2B AI SaaS and private equity consulting, having led 40+ M&A and value creation deals for investment funds. Founder of AI That Delivers.

Ramzi Kaiache (https://linkedin.com/in/ramzikaiache) is an executive responsible for AI transformation in financial services with experience across UAE, USA and Canada. He oversees a $1B+ portfolio and global operations of 750+ people. Founder of AI That Delivers.

Pratik Gaad (https://linkedin.com/in/pratikgaad) is a strategy and operations executive with experience across North America, APAC and MEA in AI, cybersecurity and financial services. He launched an AI pentesting platform, scaled AI businesses and delivered $20M+ in efficiencies. Founder of Veridex Email Security. UAE Chapter Lead - AI That Delivers.

Canadian Business Council Abu Dhabi embarked on its journey in March 2005 with the aim of smartly connecting business people from Canada and UAE to opportunities in the region today and tomorrow. Our membership includes Canadians as well as interested non-Canadian members which are leading corporates, executives, decision makers and professionals working in a wide array of industries.

Disclaimer: By registering for this event, you agree to receive events & marketing communication and be added to an email newsletter (you can opt out at any time).

Photos and videos will be taken during the event.

- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)

### About the event

Step out of the conference and onto the court.

Join us during Abu Dhabi Finance Week for a Padel Social friendly competition and new connections.

We're playing Americano style, with a new partner every round and individual scores throughout. Between games, catch up over refreshments, explore partner activations and recharge before your next rally.

Co-organised by WLTH and Monarch Holding, with the support of Abu Dhabi Sports Council.

### WLTH

Based in ADGM, WLTH is building digital infrastructure for global private markets, connecting investors with private-company opportunities through tokenisation and digital ownership.

Monarch Holding

An Abu Dhabi-based holding company working across technology, infrastructure, sustainable energy and wellness, building businesses and long-term partnerships across the region.

Abu Dhabi Sports Council supports the development of sport across the emirate, encouraging community participation, nurturing talent and bringing international sporting events to Abu Dhabi.

### About Event

Hey!

Get ready to dive into the world of Solana with our Community Call happening first Thursday on the every Quarter.

Hosted by Simon, this is your golden ticket to connect, learn, and have a blast with fellow enthusiasts. Whether you're a seasoned pro or just starting out, there's something for everyone.

Join us in a Google Meet for 30 minutes packed with insights, advice, and all things Superteam Canada.

Got questions? Bring 'em on! Want to get more involved? This is your chance!

Can't wait to see you there!

## BlockDown Festival Dubai 2027

- Record: `w3v-blockdown-dubai-27-01-26`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2027-01-26
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://blockdownfestival.com/>

### About the event

BlockDown Festival Dubai 2027 marks the Middle East debut of the premier Web3, AI, and digital culture festival. Organized by EAK Digital in partnership with the Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC), the two-day flagship conference convenes 3,000+ global founders, investors, builders, enterprise leaders, and creators at The Plaza, Uptown Dubai on January 26-27, 2027.

Following successful editions across Europe (including Portugal and Croatia), BlockDown expands to the UAE to unite decentralized infrastructure, real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, autonomous AI agents, robotics, Web3 gaming, and creative digital culture in one immersive setting.

### What to expect

Keynotes & Fireside Chats: High-signal discussions with top protocol founders, tier-1 venture capitalists, and digital asset policy leaders.

Immersive Stages & Content Tracks: Dedicated technical and executive programming covering decentralized finance (DeFi), autonomous AI models, physical robotics, gamefi, and tokenomics.

Startup & Technology Showcases: Interactive exhibition booths and demo arenas featuring breakthrough Web3 and AI projects.

Executive VIP Lounges & Networking: Curated 1-on-1 meeting zones, bilateral deal-making tables, investor roundtables, and VIP awards gala.

Culture & Music: Live DJ performances, digital art installations, experiential community activations, and evening afterparties that define the festival spirit of BlockDown.

### Who should attend

AI researchers, robotics innovators, and autonomous agent builders.

Web3 founders, CEOs, and executive operators scaling digital asset startups.

- Protocol engineers, core blockchain developers, and smart contract architects.
- Venture capital partners, family offices, and institutional digital asset allocators.
- Ecosystem heads, corporate innovation teams, and enterprise technology executives exploring Dubai's forward-thinking regulatory framework.

### Venue and schedule

Dates: Tuesday, January 26 - Wednesday, January 27, 2027

Timing: Doors open at 08:00 AM GST daily

Venue: The Plaza at Uptown Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates (DMCC Tech District)

### Registration and tickets

Official festival passes - including General Admission, Business Passes, and VIP All-Access passes - are available directly through the official event portal at https://blockdownfestival.com/.

## Digital Assets Forum 2027

- Record: `ma-digital-assets-forum-2027`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2027-02-01T00:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://eblockchainconvention.com/digital-assets-forum/>

### About the event

Digital Assets Forum 2027 is the premier event for the institutional digital assets industry in London, returning on February 10-11, 2027. The 2027 edition doubles the format to two days, with more speakers and panels than ever.

### What's new in 2027

Exclusive 1:1 meeting area: browse the attendee list and schedule 1:1 meetings in advance to maximize your time on site.

VIP night: kick off the event with an exclusive VIP night designed for premium networking and unwinding in style.

More LPs and GPs: more allocators, institutional investors, family offices, and wealth managers than ever.

- Two days instead of one, featuring more speakers and panels than ever.
- Press room: connect with top speakers in a private space reserved for media insights.
- Private roundtables: a new format designed for direct, meaningful exchanges with top industry peers.
- New venue: a more spacious and stylish setting, perfect for connecting and exploring.
- Greater exhibition area.

### Speakers

Announced speakers include Sasha Mills (Bank of England) and leaders from institutions including HSBC, NatWest, Revolut Digital Assets Europe, Deutsche Bank, State Street, Caisse des Dépôts, London Stock Exchange, BBVA, Theta Capital Management, Blockchain Capital, SkyBridge Capital, DWS Group, and Arche Capital.

### Tickets

Ticket tiers start at £699 (excl. 20% VAT), with a VIP option at £2,199 that adds access to the VIP Night Party with speakers, sponsors and media at the 5-star venue, and a team option at £9,999 - the best return is achieved by bringing a team.

## TEAMZ Web3/AI Summit 2027

- Record: `ma-teamz-web3-ai-summit-2027`
- Source: [events-cache.json](sources/events-cache.json)
- Starts: 2027-04-06T00:00:00.000Z
- Description: Source-backed
- Original page: <https://www.teamz.co.jp/>

### About the event

TEAMZ SUMMITは、日本最大級・アジア有数の国際テックカンファレンス。約1万人が集結し、最前線のテクノロジーとビジネス機会を通じて、新たな産業とグローバル連携を生み出します。

TEAMZ Web3/AI Summit 2027 is Japan's premier international technology conference bringing together over 10,000 attendees, entrepreneurs, engineers, institutional investors, and global Web3 and AI ecosystem leaders. Taking place at Happo-en in Tokyo, the two-day summit combines keynote stages, enterprise exhibitions, bilateral networking sessions, side events, and VIP roundtables exploring the convergence of artificial intelligence, autonomous agents, and decentralized protocols.

### Robots, agents & tradition

TEAMZ SUMMIT (AI EDITION) では、AI分野を中心に、世界中から起業家、技術者、投資家、業界リーダーが集結します。最先端のテクノロジーと日本の文化・伝統が融合する特別な空間で、メインステージでの講演や文化パフォーマンス、展示会、テラスでのネットワーキング、サイドイベント、VIPプログラムなど、多彩な体験を提供します。新たなアイデア、人、ビジネスがつながり、次の未来を生み出す場を創出します。

### Innovative speakers shaping the future

TEAMZ SUMMIT (AI EDITION) では、世界をリードする業界のリーダーやイノベーターが登壇し、AIや最先端テクノロジーの現在と未来について語ります。第一線で活躍する専門家の知見やビジョンに直接触れ、新たなアイデアと可能性を発見できる貴重な機会です。

### Sponsors, VC, community, and media partners

TEAMZ Web3/AIサミットは、スポンサーやVC、メディアなどが集結する特別なネットワーキングの場。業界のキーパーソンとつながり、Web3とAIの未来を共に切り拓きましょう。

### Tickets

チケットは一般パスからVIPパスまで複数の tiers を用意しています。最安価格でチケットを購入し、行列をスキップ。到着したらすぐにイベントへご入場いただけます。TEAMZ 2027では、待ち時間を限りなくゼロに近づけることを目指した改善施策を実施します。

### About the event

Dutch Blockchain Week 2027 One of Europe's leading Business events for digital assets, blockchain and Web3, Dutch Blockchain Week brings together professionals from exchanges, banks, payment providers, funds, market makers, regulators, infrastructure companies and global technology leaders in Amsterdam.

At the heart of the week, the DBW Main Summit brings the industry together for two days of high-level content, business development and networking.  The DBW Summit on May 19 & 20 in the Johan Cruijff ArenA offers two full days of Web3 insights, panels, deep dives, and high-level networking, designed for institutions, founders, policymakers, and professionals shaping the future of digital assets

Attended by industry leader

Decision Maker

Internationa

NPS scor

We bring together top experts to shape the future of blockchain & digital assets

Where the digital asset industry comes together Our partners and participants represent the companies and institutions that are the future of digital assets. From exchanges, banks and payment providers to market makers, funds, regulators, infrastructure companies and technology leaders, Dutch Blockchain Week brings the ecosystem together in Amsterdam. Throughout the week, and especially during the DBW Main Summit on May 19 & 20, these organisations come together to exchange knowledge, build partnerships, explore new opportunities and move the industry forward. Connect with the people behind the companies, products and infrastructure shaping the next generation of finance and digital assets.

New to Dutch Blockchain Week?  Discover our story, international community and what makes DBW one of Europe's leading digital asset business events

Europe's premier week for digital assets, blockchain, and institutional Web3

Why Atten

One week. Countless opportunities to connect. Dutch Blockchain Week 2027 is more than a two-day conference. From May 17-23, Amsterdam becomes a meeting point for the digital asset industry, creating an entire week to meet the people you want to do business with. At the DBW Main Summit on May 19 & 20, high-level content and industry insights are combined with dedicated networking, breakout sessions and partner activations. But many of the most valuable conversations happen beyond the stages. Across side events, private dinners, networking drinks, partner events and informal gatherings throughout the week. There is enough time to meet, reconnect and continue conversations.

Because business doesn't always start in a meeting room. Partnerships begin over coffee, introductions turn into opportunities and deals are made when the right people meet.  Whether you're looking for new clients, investors, partners or simply want to strengthen your network, Dutch Blockchain Week gives you a full week to make the connections that matter

### About the event

ETHConf 2027 takes place at the Javits Center in New York City from June 14 to 16. The program brings Ethereum builders, founders, institutions, investors and policymakers together for main-stage discussions, technical sessions and product showcases.

Announced themes include stablecoins and payments, DeFi markets, Ethereum's protocol roadmap, scaling infrastructure, institutional adoption, and policy and governance. The site's past-speaker section describes earlier editions.

General passes cover conference stages and the exhibition. Pro passes add the networking app and lounge, catering and coworking; VIP passes add further hospitality and access. Sessions are to be recorded and made available to ticket holders within three weeks. Check the official pass comparison for current conditions.
